We thus finetune an MLLM-based embedder exclusively on synthetic attribute-binding text. Despite the absence of image supervision, the gains transfer to cross-modal and image--image retrieval while preserving general multimodal embedding performance. Our model achieves SOTA results on SABER while also improving on negation and instance-retrieval benchmarks, demonstrating broader benefits of our binding-focused supervision.

AI.title_translation: 困于乱序：论视觉-语言模型中的属性-对象绑定
AI.tldr: 本文通过提出新基准SABER揭示了视觉-语言模型在属性-对象绑定上的缺陷，并证明了仅使用合成文本监督即可高效解决该问题，取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有基准无法全面评估视觉-语言模型在不同模态配对和复杂设置下的属性-对象绑定（attribute-object binding）能力，且多模态图像监督数据收集成本高昂，因此需要更全面、高效的评估与提升方案。
AI.method: 引入了一个名为SABER的受控基准，涵盖所有四种图像和文本模态配对、多样化的属性类型及多达十个对象的场景；并提出仅使用合成属性绑定文本来微调基于MLLM的嵌入器。
AI.result: 评估表明CLIP式双编码器和最新MLLM嵌入器均存在严重的绑定失败；而仅通过合成文本进行微调的模型不仅在SABER上取得了SOTA结果，还将收益泛化到了跨模态、图像-图像检索以及否定和实例检索基准中。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入SABER基准和纯文本微调方法，论文展示了解决视觉-语言模型属性-对象绑定难题的有效路径，且无需高昂的图像数据收集成本。
AI.translation: 检索是多模态系统中的一项基础任务：给定图像或文本查询，其目标是在集合中最相关的图像或文本，通常使用共享的嵌入空间。可靠的检索要求这些嵌入不仅能捕获存在哪些概念，还要捕获它们的组合方式。一个关键的组合挑战是属性-对象绑定：编码哪些属性属于哪些对象。现有的基准对这种能力的评估视角有限，通常只涵盖一部分模态配对、简单的双对象交换或小的属性集。因此，目前尚不清楚当前模型在不同模态配对和更复杂的设置下如何稳健地保持属性-对象绑定。为此，我们引入了SABER，这是一个用于评估所有四种图像和文本模态配对的属性-对象绑定的受控基准，跨越了不同的属性类型和最多包含十个对象的场景。在SABER上评估模型揭示了CLIP式双编码器和最近的基于MLLM的嵌入器都存在显著的绑定失败。这些发现促使我们探讨如何高效地改进绑定。虽然多模态监督可能是有效的，但收集合适的图像困难且成本高昂。另一方面，文本非常适合绑定监督：它生成成本低，支持更广泛的属性，并能实现精确控制的难负例。因此，我们专门在合成的属性绑定文本上微调了一个基于MLLM的嵌入器。尽管缺乏图像监督，这些增益仍能转移到跨模态和图像-图像检索中，同时保持了通用的多模态嵌入性能。我们的模型在SABER上取得了SOTA结果，同时改进了否定和实例检索基准，证明了我们的绑定聚焦监督的广泛优势。
AI.summary: 本文针对视觉-语言模型中的属性-对象绑定难题，提出了全新的基准SABER，并创新性地利用廉价且可控的合成文本数据对MLLM嵌入器进行微调，实现了在不依赖图像监督的情况下显著提升检索与组合泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 视觉-语言模型, 属性-对象绑定, 跨模态检索, 合成文本监督, 多模态嵌入
AI.comments: 该论文聚焦于视觉-语言模型中长期被忽视的属性-对象绑定（Attribute-Object Binding）问题，创新性地提出了全面且复杂的基准SABER，并证明了仅使用合成文本监督就能高效且显著地提升模型的多模态组合泛化能力。具有很高的实用价值和理论启发意义。

title: At the Limits of Computability: Steps Towards Autonomous AI Discovery on the Busy Beaver Frontier
summary: Recent breakthroughs in AI for mathematics---ranging from Olympiad medal performances to resolving long-standing open conjectures---have rapidly expanded what automated systems can achieve. Yet these successes primarily concern predefined, human-formulated problems, leaving open how AI systems can autonomously uncover mathematical structure and formulate new questions. To push beyond static challenges, we explore the Busy Beaver (BB) domain, an uncomputable frontier that is fundamentally open-ended. Because no algorithm can compute the Busy Beaver number $\mathrm{BB}(n)$ for every $n$, this domain provides a natural setting for sustained exploration through mathematical conjecture and proof. In this paper, we introduce a Gemini-based agentic pipeline that automatically discovers accelerations of Turing machines, expressed as compact mathematical rules summarizing many execution steps. Our system integrates pattern recognition, automated conjecturing, informal mathematical reasoning, and formal theorem proving in Lean. With this framework, our system autonomously discovered and formally verified novel Collatz-like accelerations for eleven machines in $\mathrm{BB}(6)$. Subject to community acceptance, we provisionally classify these machines as Cryptids, namely machines whose blank-tape executions admit exact, compact mathematical descriptions but whose halting behavior remains unresolved. These results advance the analysis of $\mathrm{BB}(6)$ holdouts on the Busy Beaver frontier and demonstrate the potential of autonomous AI systems for open-ended mathematical discovery in fundamental computer science.

AI.title_translation: 在可计算性的边界：迈向忙碌的海狸前沿的自主人工智能发现之路
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种基于Gemini的智能体管道，用于在忙碌海狸（BB）领域自主发现加速图灵机的数学规则，并成功发现了11个BB(6)机器的新型Collatz类加速，这些机器被初步归类为Cryptids。
AI.motivation: 现有AI在数学领域的成功主要局限于预定义的人类问题，而AI自主发现数学结构和提出新问题的能力仍有待探索。忙碌海狸（BB）领域因其不可计算和开放性，为AI自主探索和数学发现提供了理想的平台。
AI.method: 研究引入了一个基于Gemini的智能体管道，该管道集成了模式识别、自动猜想、非正式数学推理和Lean形式定理证明，用于自动发现和加速图灵机。
AI.result: 该系统在BB(6)中自主发现了11台机器的加速，并以紧凑的数学规则形式进行了总结和形式化验证。这些机器被初步命名为Cryptids，因为它们的空白带执行可以被精确的数学描述，但其停机行为仍未解决。
AI.conclusion: 该研究展示了自主AI系统在基本计算机科学领域进行开放式数学发现的潜力，并通过分析BB(6)中的遗留问题，推动了忙碌海狸前沿的分析。
AI.translation: 近期人工智能在数学领域的突破，从奥林匹克竞赛奖牌表现到解决长期存在的公开猜想，极大地扩展了自动化系统的能力。然而，这些成功主要涉及预定义的人类制定问题，而AI系统如何自主发现数学结构和提出新问题仍然悬而未决。为了超越静态挑战，我们探索了忙碌海狸（BB）领域，这是一个本质上开放的不可计算前沿。由于没有算法可以计算出每个n的忙碌海狸数BB(n)，该领域为通过数学猜想和证明进行持续探索提供了自然的设置。在本论文中，我们引入了一个基于Gemini的智能体管道，该管道自动发现图灵机的加速，这些加速被表达为总结多个执行步骤的紧凑数学规则。我们的系统集成了模式识别、自动猜想、非正式数学推理和Lean形式定理证明。利用这个框架，我们的系统自主地发现了11台BB(6)机器的加速，并进行了形式化验证，这些加速类似于Collatz猜想。在获得社区认可的前提下，我们将这些机器暂时归类为Cryptids，即它们的空白带执行可以被精确、紧凑的数学描述所解释，但它们的停机行为仍未解决。这些结果推动了对忙碌海狸前沿BB(6)遗留问题的分析，并展示了自主AI系统在基本计算机科学领域进行开放式数学发现的潜力。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新颖的基于Gemini的智能体管道，用于在计算前沿的忙碌海狸（BB）领域实现自主数学发现。该系统能够自动识别、总结和形式化验证图灵机的加速行为，特别是在BB(6)领域，成功发现了11台机器的Collatz类加速，并将它们归类为“Cryptids”。这标志着AI在解决开放式、不可计算问题以及自主探索数学结构方面迈出了重要一步。
AI.keywords: 忙碌海狸,自主AI发现,图灵机加速,形式化验证,Cryptids
AI.comments: 这项研究在利用AI进行自主数学发现方面取得了显著进展，特别是在计算理论的“前沿”领域。将Gemini等大型语言模型与形式化验证相结合，为探索不可计算问题开辟了新途径。然而，“Cryptids”的定义和分类仍需社区的进一步验证和接受。此外，虽然该方法展示了潜力，但其在更广泛的数学问题上的可扩展性和效率仍有待考察。

title: Rarity of Singletons Matters & Supplementary Materials
comments: supplementary for the main paper has been added as well
summary: Estimating missing-mass and unseen-species counts from finite samples relies heavily on rare-event occupancy statistics, particularly singletons. In small-sample regimes, these statistics can be highly variable, making classical estimators sensitive to sampling fluctuations and potentially unreliable. We propose a fragility-aware (FA) framework that explicitly quantifies this sensitivity and adaptively regularizes conventional missing-mass and unseen-species estimators. Using singleton-based fragility measures derived from probability mass and occupancy counts, we formulate an entropy--Kullback--Leibler (KL) optimization that adjusts the reliance on base estimates according to their fragility. The resulting objectives are strictly concave, admit unique closed-form solutions, and require no Poissonization or asymptotic approximations. The framework provides a lightweight correction to classical estimators, including Good--Turing and Good--Toulmin, while reducing reliance on potentially unstable rare-event statistics. Across 360 experimental configurations spanning synthetic distributions and real-world language corpora, our method remains competitive in stable regimes while improving estimation accuracy and stability in fragmented, long-tailed, and small-sample settings. The findings demonstrate that accounting for the fragility of rare observations can improve the reliability of inference about unobserved species and their associated probability mass.

AI.title_translation: 单子的稀有性至关重要与补充材料
AI.tldr: 提出了一种脆弱性感感知框架，通过自适应正则化稀有事件统计量，显著提升了小样本和长尾分布下未见物种与缺失质量估计的准确度与稳定性。
AI.motivation: 在有限样本中估计缺失质量和未见物种数量高度依赖于单子等稀有事件的统计量，但在小样本情况下这些统计量极易产生波动，导致经典估计器（如Good-Turing和Good-Toulmin）对采样波动极为敏感且不可靠，因此需要一种能考虑这种脆弱性的正则化框架。
AI.method: 提出了一种脆弱性感感知（FA）框架，利用基于概率质量和占用计数的单子脆弱性度量，构建了熵-Kullback-Leibler（KL）优化问题，以自适应地根据基础估计的脆弱性调整其权重，从而无需泊松化或渐近近似即可得到唯一闭式解。
AI.result: 在涵盖合成分布和真实语言语料库的360种实验配置中，该方法在稳定区保持竞争力的同时，显著提高了碎片化、长尾和小样本设置下的估计准确性和稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入基于脆弱性的自适应正则化，该框架有效解决了传统估计器在小样本和长尾分布中对稀有事件波动敏感的问题，提升了未见物种和缺失质量估计的可靠性。
AI.translation: 从有限样本中估计缺失质量和未见物种数量在很大程度上依赖于稀有事件的占用统计量，尤其是单子（singletons）。在小样本情况下，这些统计量可能具有高度的变异性，使得经典估计器对采样波动非常敏感且可能不可靠。我们提出了一种脆弱性感感知（FA）框架，显式地量化了这种敏感性，并自适应地正则化了传统的缺失质量和未见物种估计器。利用从概率质量和占用计数中导出的基于单子的脆弱性度量，我们构建了一个熵-Kullback--Leibler（KL）优化问题，根据基础估计的脆弱性调整对其的依赖程度。由此产生的目标函数是严格凹的，具有唯一的闭式解，且不需要泊松化或渐近近似。该框架为经典估计器（包括 Good--Turing 和 Good--Toulmin）提供了一种轻量级的校正，同时减少了对可能不稳定的稀有事件统计量的依赖。在涵盖合成分布和现实世界语言语料库的360种实验配置中，我们的方法在稳定区域保持竞争力的同时，提高了在碎片化、长尾和小样本设置中的估计准确性和稳定性。研究结果表明，考虑稀有观测的脆弱性可以提高关于未观测物种及其相关概率质量推断的可靠性。
AI.summary: 论文提出了一种脆弱性感感知（FA）框架，用于自适应正则化传统的缺失质量和未见物种估计器。通过基于单子脆弱性的熵-KL优化，该方法有效克服了小样本和长尾分布中稀有事件波动带来的不稳定性，在保持经典估计器优势的同时显著提升了准确性与鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 未见物种估计, 缺失质量, 单子稀有事件, 脆弱性感感知框架, Good-Turing估计器
AI.comments: 该论文针对统计学和机器学习中经典的未见物种估计问题，提出了一种新颖的“脆弱性感感知（FA）”框架。其创新点在于显式地量化了单子（singleton）稀有事件统计量的波动性，并通过熵-KL优化自适应地正则化经典估计器。该方法具有严格的数学保证（严格凹性、唯一闭式解），且无需泊松化或渐近近似，在小样本和小尾分布场景下显著提升了估计的稳定性和准确性。

title: Three LiDARs, Twenty-Five Datasets: Cross-Source Generalization in Tree-Species Recognition
summary: FOR-species20K is the largest public LiDAR benchmark for tree-species classification, pooling 25 independently collected terrestrial, mobile, and airborne laser-scanning datasets across 33 species. We introduce a multi-resolution, multi-view ConvNeXtV2 model that improves official hidden-test accuracy from 79.5% to 85.0%, ranking first at the time of submission. We then examine what this score measures. Because the hidden test is species-balanced, its overall accuracy is more comparable to a macro metric than to accuracy under the public set's long-tailed distribution. Moreover, the official random split places every source dataset in both training and evaluation. A logistic probe recovers source identity from out-of-fold model probabilities with 69% accuracy, while geometric features identify the source above 90% within two widely shared species; 18 of the 33 species occur in only one source. Under a source-species-cell holdout, evaluated on 5,566 trees from eight eligible species that retain the same LiDAR-type training support in other sources, the unweighted species mean falls from 82% to 36%, and tree-weighted accuracy falls from 95% to 60%. Count-matched retraining and experiments with two alternative backbones indicate that this gap is not explained by reduced training support alone, while an external PureForest experiment shows a smaller but consistent grouped-split effect. These results establish the 85% leaderboard score as strong in-distribution performance, but not as an estimate of source-disjoint generalization, motivating balanced metrics and source-aware evaluation. The code is available at: https://github.com/JaeLee18/FOR20K-lidar-tree-species

AI.title_translation: 三个激光雷达，二十五个数据集：树种识别中的跨源泛化
AI.tldr: LiDAR树种分类模型在随机划分下表现优异，但面对未知数据源时泛化能力显著下降，凸显了源感知评估的重要性。
AI.motivation: 探索在使用 25 个独立采集的 LiDAR 数据集组成的 FOR-species20K 基准测试时，高树种分类准确率究竟测量的是什么，并检验模型在面对跨源（cross-source）泛化时的真实表现。
AI.method: 引入了一个多分辨率、多视角的 ConvNeXtV2 模型，并使用逻辑探测（logistic probe）、几何特征以及源-物种-单元留出（source-species-cell holdout）等方法来评估模型对源数据的依赖性和跨源泛化能力。
AI.result: 尽管提出的多分辨率多视角ConvNeXtV2模型将官方隐藏测试准确率从79.5%提升至85.0%，但在源-物种-单元留出验证下，未加权的物种平均准确率从82%急剧下降至36%，树木加权准确率从95%降至60%，证明该模型存在显著的源数据依赖性。
AI.conclusion: 当前排行榜上的高准确率反映的是强的同分布性能，而不是源不相交的泛化能力，凸显了在三维点云分类中采用平衡指标和源感知评估的必要性。
AI.translation: FOR-species20K 是最大的公开 LiDAR 树种分类基准，它汇集了 25 个独立采集的地面、移动和机载激光扫描数据集，涵盖 33 个树种。我们引入了一个多分辨率、多视角的 ConvNeXtV2 模型，将官方隐藏测试准确率从 79.5% 提高到 85.0%，在提交时排名第一。然后我们检验了这个分数所衡量的东西。由于隐藏测试集是物种平衡的，其整体准确率比公开集的长尾分布下的准确率更具宏观指标的可比性。此外，官方的随机分割将每个源数据集同时置于训练和评估中。逻辑探测从折外模型概率中以 69% 的准确率恢复源身份，而几何特征在两个广泛共享的物种中以高于 90% 的准确率识别源；33 个物种中有 18 个仅出现在一个源中。在源-物种-单元留出（source-species-cell holdout）下，对在其他源中保持相同 LiDAR 类型训练支持的 8 个合格物种的 5,566 棵树进行评估，未加权的物种平均值从 82% 下降到 36%，树木加权准确率从 95% 下降到 60%。计数匹配的重新训练和使用两个替代主干网络的实验表明，这一差距不能仅仅用减少的训练支持来解释，而外部的 PureForest 实验显示出较小但一致的分组分割效应。这些结果确立了 85% 的排行榜分数是强的同分布性能，但不是对源不相交泛化的估计，这促使了平衡指标和源感知评估的发展。代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/JaeLee18/FOR20K-lidar-tree-species
AI.summary: 该论文针对FOR-species20K这一最大公开LiDAR树种分类基准，提出了一个改进的ConvNeXtV2模型，并深入揭示了现有随机数据划分方法导致模型对特定数据源产生偏差，从而无法准确评估真正的跨源泛化能力。
AI.keywords: LiDAR, 树种分类, 跨源泛化, 点云, 数据集偏差
AI.comments: 该论文深入剖析了当前最大公开LiDAR树种分类基准（FOR-species20K）中的泛化能力问题，揭示了常规随机划分下高准确率主要源于对源数据的过拟合而非真正的跨源泛化能力，对未来三维遥感和点云分类算法的评估具有重要的警示和推动意义。

title: ProactGen: Learning Proactive Clarification for Video Generation
summary: Recent advances in video generation let users create high-quality videos from natural language descriptions, yet obtaining results that match user intent remains time-consuming: individual generations are computationally expensive, and underspecified prompts force repeated cycles of generation, inspection, and revision. Existing video prompt optimization methods improve generation through automatic rewriting, but cannot supply the ideas and preferences that were not in the initial description. We propose ProactGen, a video generation framework that learns proactive clarification, eliciting user intent through questions grounded in generated video drafts. Specifically, we train a vision-language model as a questioning policy with reinforcement learning: observing the initial prompt and a video draft, it learns to ask the questions most valuable to downstream generation, rewarded by the alignment between the final generated video and a target reference. We further find that effective questioning does not require drafts of final-output quality, and exploit this property by generating drafts with fewer denoising steps, keeping the added cost of clarification low. Experiments show that ProactGen improves target alignment over direct generation by at least 1.8x the gain of the strongest baselines. Moreover, a single round of ProactGen already exceeds the alignment that the strongest baseline reaches after four refinement rounds, in 29% of its time.

AI.title_translation: ProactGen：学习用于视频生成的主动澄清机制
AI.tldr: ProactGen 通过生成低成本视频草图并向用户主动提问，高效获取用户意图，大幅提升了视频生成与目标意图的对齐效果并减少了迭代轮数。
AI.motivation: 由于现有的视频生成提示词优化方法无法自动补充用户未在初始描述中提及的想法和偏好，且单独生成视频计算成本高、迭代繁琐，因此需要一种能够主动澄清用户意图的框架以减少反复修改的开销。
AI.method: 提出 ProactGen 框架，训练一个视觉语言模型作为问答策略（通过强化学习），该策略结合初始提示词和视频草图生成有价值的问题以获取用户意图；同时利用去噪步数较少的低质量草图来保持较低的澄清成本。
AI.result: 实验表明，ProactGen 的目标对齐度提升幅度至少是最强基线的 1.8 倍；单轮 ProactGen 的对齐效果超越了最强基线经过四轮精炼后的效果，且耗时仅为其 29%。
AI.conclusion: ProactGen 通过学习主动提问机制，能够高效引导用户意图，显著提升视频生成模型与真实意图的对齐度，同时保持较低的计算成本。
AI.translation: 近来视频生成的进展允许用户从自然语言描述中创建高质量视频，然而要获得符合用户意图的结果仍然很耗时：单独生成计算成本高昂，且描述不足的提示词迫使人们进行反复的生成、检查和修改循环。现有的视频提示词优化方法通过自动重写来改善生成效果，但无法提供初始描述中没有的想法和偏好。我们提出了 ProactGen，这是一个视频生成框架，它学习主动澄清机制，通过基于生成的视频草图提出的问题来引导用户意图。具体而言，我们通过强化学习训练了一个视觉语言模型作为问答策略：观察初始提示词和视频草图，它学习提出对下游生成最有价值的问题，并以最终生成的视频与目标参考之间的对齐度作为奖励。我们进一步发现，有效的提问并不需要最终输出质量的草图，并利用这一特性，通过使用较少去噪步数生成草图，保持了较低的澄清附加成本。实验表明，ProactGen 将目标对齐度的提升提高到了最强基线增益的 1.8 倍以上。此外，单轮 ProactGen 的对齐效果就已经超过了最强基线经过四轮精炼后达到的效果，且耗时仅为其 29%。
AI.summary: ProactGen 是一个视频生成框架，它通过基于强化学习训练的视觉语言模型来学习主动澄清机制，在观察初始提示词和低成本视频草图的基础上向用户提出有价值的问题，从而高效准确地对齐用户意图，显著降低了视频生成的迭代时间和成本。
AI.keywords: 视频生成, 主动澄清, 视觉语言模型, 强化学习, 提示词优化
AI.comments: ProactGen 创新性地引入了主动澄清机制（Proactive Clarification），通过多模态问答与低成本草图生成有效解决了视频生成中提示词模糊和迭代成本高的问题，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Shift-Reliance Alignment: Ranking Vision-Language Models by the Cues They Trust
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) are usually chosen from leaderboards, which give one ranking for every application. On questions about objects that a scene suggests but does not contain, however, the model with the lowest error on the POPE hallucination benchmark is not the one with the lowest error on such questions. For yes/no questions about object presence, we show that the best model for a target domain can be predicted without running any candidate on that domain, given 650 to 1,200 labeled target items that calibrate a detector. We measure each model's reliance on a cue, a feature such as scene context or text in the image, by editing 100 labeled source images so that the cue suggests the wrong answer, and comparing with a matched control edit. Reliance predicts which VLMs are misled by physical sticker attacks (Spearman .93 on nine models not used to design the score) and which hallucinate on unedited COCO photographs, beyond what their tendency to answer yes explains. Shift-Reliance Alignment (SRA) scores a model by its source error on the labeled source questions plus its reliance multiplied by the shift. The shift is the proportion of target questions on which the cue misleads, and a detector estimates it on the unlabeled target images. SRA selects the model with the lowest score. In pre-registered tests on new images where most questions mislead, it lowered the error of the selected model from 30.4% under selection by source error to 18.8% on Objects365 and OpenImages but, against its prediction, not on COCO. On CueDial, a benchmark we release that varies how often a cue misleads, selection by model confidence falls more than 40 percentage points behind the best model when overlaid text denies a visible object, and SRA stays within 3 points.

AI.title_translation: 移位-依赖对齐：根据模型信任的线索对视觉语言模型进行排序
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为SRA的新方法，无需在目标域运行候选模型即可准确预测并选择最适合特定视觉语言任务的模型，有效解决了模型幻觉和线索误导问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉语言模型排行榜无法针对特定应用给出准确的排名，POPE等基准测试的最优模型在特定误导性问题上表现不佳，因此需要一种无需在目标域运行所有候选模型就能预测并选择最佳目标域模型的方法。
AI.method: 提出Shift-Reliance Alignment (SRA)评分方法，通过在源图像上编辑特定线索来测量模型对线索的依赖度，并结合目标域上由检测器估计的线索误导比例（移位），来计算并选择最优模型。
AI.result: 在预注册测试中，SRA将目标图像上的选择误差从30.4%降低至18.8%（在Objects365和OpenImages上）。在新的CueDial基准测试中，当图像文字与可见物体冲突时，SRA的选择结果与最佳模型差距在3个百分点以内，远优于基于模型自信的选择方法。
AI.conclusion: 移位-依赖对齐（SRA）方法能够有效预测模型在目标域上的表现，在多数测试中显著降低了选择误差，优于传统的源误差选择和基于置信度的选择方法。
AI.translation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）通常是从排行榜中挑选出来的，排行榜为每个应用提供单一排名。然而，对于场景暗示但并不包含的物体的问题，在POPE幻觉基准测试中错误率最低的模型并不是此类问题中错误率最低的模型。对于关于物体存在的“是/否”问题，我们表明，给定650到1200个校准检测器的标记目标项，无需在目标域上运行任何候选模型，就可以预测出目标域的最佳模型。我们通过编辑100张标记的源图像（使线索暗示错误答案）并与匹配的控制编辑进行比较，来测量每个模型对线索（如场景背景或图像中的文本）的依赖程度。依赖度可以预测哪些VLM会被物理贴纸攻击误导（在未用于设计该评分的九个模型上Spearman相关系数为0.93），以及哪些VLM会在未编辑的COCO照片产生幻觉，超出了其倾向于回答“是”的解释范围。移位-依赖对齐（SRA）通过标记源问题上的源误差加上依赖度乘以移位来对模型进行评分。移位是目标问题中线索产生误导的比例，检测器在未标记的目标图像上对其进行估计。SRA选择评分最低的模型。在大多数问题具有误导性的新图像的预注册测试中，它将所选模型的错误率从源误差选择下的30.4%降低到Objects365和OpenImages上的18.8%，但与其预测相反，在COCO上没有降低。在CueDial上（我们发布的一个改变线索误导频率的基准测试），当叠加文本否认可见物体时，基于模型自信度的选择比最佳模型落后40个百分点以上，而SRA则保持在3个百分点以内。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了移位-依赖对齐（SRA）方法，这是一种通过评估视觉语言模型对特定线索的依赖度以及目标域的线索偏移来对VLM进行排名的技术，能够在无需目标域运行模型的前提下有效选择出抗幻觉和抗干扰能力最强的模型。
AI.keywords: 视觉语言模型, 模型选择, 幻觉, 线索依赖, 领域泛化
AI.comments: 本文提出了一种新颖的方法（SRA），通过测量视觉语言模型对特定线索的依赖程度和领域转移，无需在目标域上运行候选模型即可预测并选择最优模型。该方法在对抗幻觉和特定干扰场景下表现出强大性能，对VLM的可靠评估具有重要意义。

title: When Does Uncertainty Measure RAG Hallucination Risk?
comments: 6 pages. Accepted for oral presentation at ICNLSP 2026
summary: Uncertainty can measure hallucination risk in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), but only when retrieved evidence constrains the answer. When evidence is present, unsupported factual claims become less likely; when retrieval coverage is poor, the model can answer from internal knowledge and assign high probability to unsupported claims. We test this across four instruction-tuned models on HotpotQA and SQuAD. After matching faithful and hallucinated answers within word-count bins, length-only classifiers fall near chance, while perplexity reaches 0.81--0.91 AUROC on targeted unsupported edits. Varying retrieval depth shows why the score changes meaning: detection can weaken with only the top-ranked passage, then recover after adding a second passage. A combined uncertainty and semantic-drift score improves calibration, and measurements remain above chance on RAGTruth QA. Results support a conditional view of uncertainty as a useful measure of RAG hallucination risk.
comment: 6 pages. Accepted for oral presentation at ICNLSP 2026

AI.title_translation: 不确定性何时能衡量RAG的幻觉风险？
AI.tldr: 只有在检索证据能够约束答案的前提下，不确定性才能有效衡量RAG系统的幻觉风险。
AI.motivation: 明确不确定性何时以及如何在检索增强生成（RAG）中有效衡量幻觉风险，解决传统不确定性度量在检索覆盖率差或依赖内部知识时的局限性。
AI.method: 在HotpotQA和SQuAD数据集上对四种指令微调模型进行了测试，通过在词数箱内匹配忠实和幻觉答案，对比了长度分类器和困惑度（Perplexity）的AUROC，并测试了不同检索深度及组合不确定性与语义漂移得分的效果。
AI.result: 在匹配长度后，困惑度在针对性不支持编辑上的AUROC达到了0.81-0.91；增加第二个段落有助于恢复检测能力；结合不确定性和语义漂移的得分改善了校准效果，并在RAGTruth QA上也保持了高于随机猜测的性能。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性可以作为衡量RAG幻觉风险的有效指标，但这一前提是检索到的证据能够充分约束答案，且需要结合语义漂移等指标进行综合校准。
AI.translation: 不确定性可以衡量检索增强生成（RAG）中的幻觉风险，但前提是检索到的证据约束了答案。当证据存在时，不支持的事实性声明变得不太可能；而当检索覆盖率较差时，模型可以利用内部知识进行回答，并为不支持的声明分配高概率。我们在HotpotQA和SQuAD的四个指令微调模型上对此进行了测试。在词数箱内匹配忠实回答和幻觉回答后，纯长度分类器的表现接近随机，而困惑度（perplexity）在有针对性的不支持编辑上达到了0.81–0.91的AUROC。改变检索深度展示了分数改变含义的原因：仅使用排名第一的段落时检测能力可能会减弱，但在添加第二个段落后会恢复。结合不确定性和语义漂移得分可以改进校准，并且在RAGTruth QA上的测量结果仍然高于随机水平。结果支持了一种有条件的观点，即不确定性是衡量RAG幻觉风险的有用指标。
AI.summary: 本文研究了不确定性何时能有效衡量检索增强生成（RAG）中的幻觉风险。研究发现，只有当检索到的证据约束了答案时，不确定性才是一个好的度量指标。通过在多个模型和数据集上的实验，证明了结合困惑度与语义漂移分数的综合方法能够有效检测RAG幻觉。
AI.keywords: 检索增强生成, 幻觉风险, 不确定性, 证据约束, 语义漂移
AI.comments: 该论文探讨了检索增强生成（RAG）中不确定性与幻觉风险之间的条件关系，揭示了检索证据对约束模型回答的关键作用，方法严谨且对RAG系统的不确定性量化具有重要指导意义。

title: Trajectory-Guided Steering: Mitigating Spurious Feature Bias in Clinical Classification
summary: Large language models rely on spurious features in clinical classification: swapping a single gender token in clinical notes alters gender-irrelevant diagnoses in up to 53.5% of cases. Existing inference-time corrections either need counterfactual data built around the specific spurious feature or behave unpredictably. We observe that how a model's preference between answers evolves across layers, its prediction trajectory, indicates for each document whether a correction is likely to help. We propose Trajectory-Guided Steering (TGS), which decides from the trajectory alone whether to correct each prediction and in which direction, with no counterfactual data and no knowledge of the spurious feature. On 16 clinical classification tasks from i2b2, TGS fixes 17.7% of errors while breaking only 1.3% of correct predictions and stays net-positive across all tested hyperparameter settings; all baselines are net-negative or near zero. The same corrections reduce reliance on the spurious feature: on the most affected diseases, gender-swap inconsistency falls sharply (hypertension 53.5% -> 38.0%, diabetes 35.1% -> 21.5%). Applying the correction to every document instead raises breaks on correct positive predictions from 0.1% to 6.4%, so per-document selection is essential. TGS also transfers to three model families and three other clinical and biomedical datasets.

AI.title_translation: 轨迹引导引导：减轻临床分类中的虚假特征偏见
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为TGS的推理时纠偏方法，仅利用模型的层间预测轨迹，即可在无需反事实数据的情况下有效消除大语言模型在临床分类中的虚假特征偏见。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在临床分类中严重依赖虚假特征（如通过替换单个性别词就能改变不相关疾病的诊断结果），而现有的推理时纠正方法要么需要针对特定虚假特征构建的反事实数据，要么表现不可预测。
AI.method: 提出轨迹引导引导（Trajectory-Guided Steering, TGS）方法，通过观察模型预测偏好在不同层之间的演化（即预测轨迹），在无需反事实数据和伪特征知识的情况下，决定是否对每个文档的预测进行纠正及其纠正方向。
AI.result: 在16个i2b2临床分类任务中，TGS修复了17.7%的错误，仅破坏了1.3%的正确预测，并在所有超参数设置下保持净正收益；同时，它显著降低了性别交换的不一致性（高血压从53.5%降至38.0%，糖尿病从35.1%降至21.5%），并且能够泛化至三个模型家族以及其他三个临床与生物医学数据集。
AI.conclusion: 基于模型层间预测轨迹的 Trajectory-Guided Steering (TGS) 方法能够有效缓解大语言模型在临床分类中的伪特征偏见，在无需额外先验数据的情况下显著提升了预测的鲁棒性和准确性。
AI.translation: 大型语言模型在临床分类中依赖于虚假特征：在临床记录中交换单个性别令牌会改变高达 53.5% 的案例中与性别无关的诊断。现有的推理时纠正要么需要围绕特定虚假特征构建的反事实数据，要么表现出不可预测的行为。我们观察到模型在不同层之间对答案偏好的演变（即其预测轨迹）表明了每个文档是否可能从纠正中受益。我们提出了轨迹引导引导（Trajectory-Guided Steering, TGS），它仅从轨迹中决定是否纠正每个预测以及纠正的方向，而无需反事实数据和虚假特征的知识。在来自 i2b2 的 16 个临床分类任务中，TGS 修复了 17.7% 的错误，同时仅破坏了 1.3% 的正确预测，并且在所有测试的超参数设置下保持净正收益；所有基线都是净负数或接近零。相同的纠正措施减少了对虚假特征的依赖：在受影响最严重的疾病中，性别交换的不一致性急剧下降（高血压从 53.5% 下降到 38.0%，糖尿病从 35.1% 下降到 21.5%）。相反，将纠正应用于每个文档会将对正确阳性预测的破坏从 0.1% 提高到 6.4%，因此逐个文档的选择至关重要。TGS 还可转移到三个模型系列以及其他三个临床和生物医学数据集。
AI.summary: 该论文针对大语言模型在临床分类中对虚假特征的依赖问题，提出了一种名为“轨迹引导引导”（TGS）的新方法。该方法无需反事实数据或虚假特征的先验知识，仅通过分析模型在各层间的预测轨迹来决定是否及如何进行纠正。实验表明，TGS能有效减少虚假特征偏见，显著提高临床分类任务的准确性与鲁棒性，并具有良好的跨模型和跨数据集泛化能力。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 临床分类, 伪特征偏见, 轨迹引导引导, 推理时纠偏
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种创新的、无需反事实数据和 spurious 特征先验知识的推理时纠偏方法（TGS），通过观察模型在不同层之间的预测轨迹来决定是否及如何纠正偏差，在临床分类任务中展现了极高的鲁棒性和有效性。

title: FCTS: Failure-Guided Curriculum Tree Search Over Generated Terrain for Legged Parkour
comments: 9 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Under review. Project page with videos: https://narayananpp.github.io/fcts/
summary: Quadruped parkour policies handle canonical obstacles well, but their training curricula often miss the irregular, compound geometry of industrial and disaster-response sites, where agile locomotion matters most. Such environments pose a hard generalization problem: even training directly on reconstructed geometry from the target site does not reliably yield policies that traverse it. Hand-designed curricula span only a few terrain families, and recent LLM-generated curricula offer little control over which policy weaknesses they target. We propose FCTS, a failure-conditioned terrain curriculum framework that uses localized traversal failures to automatically generate the terrains a policy should train on next. Each failure's location, termination mode, robot state, and surrounding terrain geometry condition this generation, and Monte Carlo Tree Search explores alternative curriculum trajectories under a fixed training budget. On terrains built from scanned real-world construction sites, FCTS raises success rate from 28.4% to 85.8% on a medium-difficulty course and from 14.9% to 44.7% on a hard course relative to the strongest parkour or LLM-curriculum baselines, and maintains higher progress on extreme terrains where full traversal is rare. Hardware experiments on a quadruped robot confirm that the learned FCTS policies transfer to the real world.
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Under review. Project page with videos: https://narayananpp.github.io/fcts/

AI.title_translation: FCTS：面向四足跑酷的、基于生成地形的失败引导课程树搜索
AI.tldr: 本文提出了FCTS框架，利用机器人的失败反馈和蒙特卡洛树搜索自动生成针对性的训练地形，大幅提升了四足机器人在复杂非结构化环境中的跑酷能力与泛化性。
AI.motivation: 现有的四足跑酷策略在处理规范障碍时表现良好，但其训练课程往往无法覆盖工业和灾难响应现场的不规则、复合几何形状，导致策略在真实复杂环境中的泛化能力不足，而手工设计或现有LLM生成的课程缺乏对策略弱点的精准针对和控制。
AI.method: 提出FCTS框架，利用局部遍历失败（位置、终止模式、机器人状态及周围地形几何特征）作为条件，通过蒙特卡洛树搜索在固定训练预算下探索替代的课程轨迹，自动生成针对性的训练地形。
AI.result: 在基于真实世界建筑工地扫描构建的地形上，FCTS在中等难度课程上的成功率从基线的28.4%提升至85.8%，在困难课程上从14.9%提升至44.7%，并在极端地形上保持了更高的通行进度，真实硬件实验也证实了该策略的有效迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: FCTS框架通过结合失败引导的地形生成与蒙特卡洛树搜索，有效解决了四足机器人在复杂非结构化地形上的泛化难题，在仿真和真实硬件实验中均展现出卓越的性能。
AI.translation: 四足跑酷策略能够很好地处理规范障碍，但其训练课程往往错过了工业和灾难响应现场的不规则、复合几何形状，而这些正是敏捷移动最为关键的地方。此类环境提出了一个艰难的泛化问题：甚至直接在目标地点的重建几何体上进行训练，也不能可靠地产生能够遍历它的策略。人工设计的课程仅涵盖少数地形系列，而最近的大语言模型（LLM）生成的课程对它们所针对的策略弱点几乎没有控制力。我们提出了FCTS，一个失败条件地形课程框架，它利用局部遍历失败来自动生成策略接下来应进行训练的地形。每个失败的位置、终止模式、机器人状态和周围的地形几何形状构成了这一生成的条件，并且蒙特卡洛树搜索在固定的训练预算下探索替代的课程轨迹。在由扫描的真实世界建筑工地构建的地形上，相对于最强的跑酷或LLM课程基线，FCTS将中等难度课程的成功率从28.4%提高到85.8%，将困难课程的成功率从14.9%提高到44.7%，并在难以完全遍历的极端地形上保持了更高的进展。四足机器人的硬件实验证实，学习到的FCTS策略可以迁移到现实世界中。
AI.summary: 论文提出了FCTS（Failure-Guided Curriculum Tree Search），一个用于四足跑酷的失败条件地形课程框架。它通过分析机器人的遍历失败来自动生成定制化训练地形，并利用蒙特卡洛树搜索优化课程轨迹，显著提高了机器人在复杂、不规则现实场景中的运动成功率和Sim-to-Real迁移能力。
AI.keywords: 四足机器人, 跑酷, 课程学习, 地形生成, 蒙特卡洛树搜索
AI.comments: 本文创新性地提出了一种基于失败引导的课程树搜索（FCTS）方法，用于四足机器人的复杂地形跑酷训练。它利用实际遍历失败的位置、状态和几何特征作为条件，通过蒙特卡洛树搜索自动生成具有针对性的训练地形，显著提升了机器人在极端和不规则工业/灾难场景中的泛化能力与鲁棒性。

title: Noise-shaped Sampling and Annealing for Scalable On-the-edge Training of Binary and Ternary AI Models
summary: The training loss of binary and ternary neural networks, expanded as a multilinear polynomial over the discrete weights, is structurally equivalent to the energy of a hierarchical high-order Ising model. We exploit this equivalence to apply Ising solvers to discrete-weight network training, while accounting for a fundamental difference in objectives: an Ising solver seeks the ground state of a fixed energy function, whereas training seeks solutions that generalize to unseen data. Our key contribution is $ΣΔ$-Sampler, an optimizer that reconciles these objectives by embedding a stochastic sampling-and-annealing step as a noisy quantizer inside a first-order $ΣΔ$ noise-shaping loop. The loop pushes noise from weight quantization, high-order frustration, and mini-batch sampling out of the low-frequency adaptation band, so that discrete weight updates follow the smooth descent trajectories embedded in the rugged loss landscape. We validate the framework on a planted quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) benchmark with a known minimizer; on CIFAR-10, where a $13$M-parameter ternary model comes within $1\%$ of full-precision accuracy; on ImageNet-1k, where a ternary ResNet-18 comes within $0.4\%$ Top-5 accuracy of a ternary baseline; on class-incremental continual learning, where prior-task accuracy is preserved; and on MatMul-free language models up to $2.7$B parameters, where it outperforms a straight-through-estimator baseline under matched continued pre-training. Compared with standard quantization-aware training, $ΣΔ$-Sampler reduces the training memory footprint by over $50\%$, delivers an order-of-magnitude speed-up, and reduces weight-update memory traffic by four orders of magnitude, making it attractive for on-device training and fine-tuning of large binary and ternary models.

AI.title_translation: 面向二值与三值AI模型可扩展边缘端训练的噪声整形采样与退火技术
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为$\Sigma\Delta$-Sampler的优化器，利用噪声整形和Ising模型求解理论，实现了二值和三值神经网络的高效、低内存边缘端训练。
AI.motivation: 二值和三值神经网络的训练损失等价于高阶Ising模型的能量，然而Ising求解器旨在寻找固定能量函数的基态，而神经网络训练追求对未见数据的泛化，两者存在目标上的根本差异，需要进行有效调和以实现可扩展的边缘端离散权重训练。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为$\Sigma\Delta$-Sampler的优化器，将随机采样与退火步骤嵌入一阶$\Sigma\Delta$噪声整形循环中作为有噪量化器，将量化、高阶 frustration 和小批量采样引入的噪声推到低频适应带之外。
AI.result: 在QUBO基准、CIFAR-10、ImageNet-1k、类增量持续学习以及高达27亿参数的MatMul-free语言模型上验证了框架的有效性。相比标准量化感知训练，训练内存占用减少超过50%，速度提升一个数量级，权重更新内存流量减少四个数量级。
AI.conclusion: $\Sigma\Delta$-Sampler通过结合噪声整形采样与退火策略，成功克服了离散权重神经网络训练中的景观崎岖与目标冲突问题，在大幅减少内存和计算开销的同时保持了极高的模型精度，非常适合边缘端的大规模二值/三值AI模型训练。
AI.translation: 二值和三值神经网络的训练损失，在离散权重上展开为多线性多项式，在结构上等价于层次化高阶Ising模型的能量。我们利用这一等价性，将Ising求解器应用于离散权重网络的训练，同时考虑了目标上的一个根本差异：Ising求解器寻求固定能量函数的基态，而训练则寻求泛化到未见数据的解。我们的核心贡献是$\Sigma\Delta$-Sampler，这是一种优化器，它通过将随机采样-退火步骤作为有噪量化器嵌入到一阶$\Sigma\Delta$噪声整形循环中，从而调和了这些目标。该循环将权重量化、高阶 frustration和小批量采样带来的噪声推出低频适应带，从而使离散权重更新能够遵循嵌入在崎岖损失地形中的平滑下降轨迹。我们在具有已知最小化器的planted QUBO基准上验证了该框架；在CIFAR-10上，一个1300万参数的三值模型精度达到了全精度精度的1%以内；在ImageNet-1k上，三值ResNet-18的Top-5精度达到了三值基线的0.4%以内；在类增量持续学习中，保持了先前任务的精度；在高达2.7B参数的无矩阵乘法（MatMul-free）语言模型上，在匹配的持续预训练下，它优于直通估计器（STE）基线。与标准的量化感知训练相比，$\Sigma\Delta$-Sampler将训练内存占用减少了50%以上，实现了数量级的加速，并将权重更新内存流量减少了四个数量级，使其对大型二值和三值模型的设备端训练和微调极具吸引力。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种名为$\Sigma\Delta$-Sampler的新型优化器，通过将Ising模型求解与一阶噪声整形循环相结合，成功实现了二值和三值AI模型的可扩展边缘端训练。该方法在保持高模型精度的同时，显著降低了内存 footprint、加速了训练过程，并减少了内存流量。
AI.keywords: Binary Neural Networks, Ternary AI Models, Ising Solvers, Noise-shaped Sampling, On-the-edge Training
AI.comments: 该论文巧妙地将二值/三值神经网络的训练损失与层次化高阶Ising模型的能量等价起来，并创新性地提出了$\Sigma\Delta$-Sampler优化器，通过噪声整形技术解决了离散权重训练中泛化与能量极小化目标的冲突。其在多个基准测试和超大规模模型上表现优异，显著降低了内存占用和通信开销，为边缘端大模型的训练与微调开辟了新途径。

title: Understanding Stability of Outer Nesterov Momentum on Stochastic Pseudo-Gradients
summary: Large neural networks are commonly trained across many workers, and communication between them is a major cost. Workers therefore take several local optimization steps before sending their net parameter displacements, or pseudo-gradients, to an outer optimizer, which often applies Nesterov momentum. We study how the outer momentum, the number of local steps and the averaging over workers control the training dynamics, and in particular their stability. For random quadratics, we derive an exact mean-square stability criterion in any dimension, which reveals that the inner batch size determines whether increasing the number of local steps eventually stabilizes or destabilizes the outer iteration. Moreover, while averaging the pseudo-gradients of independent workers can make larger outer momentum values admissible, the number of workers required for stability can grow exponentially with the number of local steps. Finally, we show that the mean-square dynamics governing stability can be probed directly at intermediate neural-network checkpoints using shared-minibatch perturbations. We test our theoretical findings across networks, and measure their consequences for training loss.

AI.title_translation: 理解外层 Nesterov 动量在随机伪梯度上的稳定性
AI.tldr: 本文研究了分布式训练中外层 Nesterov 动量在随机伪梯度下的稳定性，发现内层批大小和工作节点数是决定局部优化步骤能否保持稳定性的关键因素。
AI.motivation: 在大规模神经网络的分布式训练中，为了减少通信成本，工作节点通常会进行多次本地优化步骤，然后将伪梯度发送给应用了外层 Nesterov 动量的外层优化器。然而，外层动量、本地步数和工作节点平均如何共同控制训练动态及其稳定性尚不清楚。
AI.method: 针对随机二次型推导了任意维度下的精确均方稳定性判据，并提出在神经网络中间检查点使用共享小批量扰动来直接探测均方动力学，最后通过网络实验验证理论。
AI.result: 研究揭示了内层批大小决定了增加局部步数最终是稳定还是破坏外层迭代的稳定性；同时发现虽然平均独立工作节点的伪梯度可允许更大的外层动量，但所需的工作节点数可能随局部步数呈指数增长。
AI.conclusion: 内层批大小决定了局部步数对稳定性的影响，而增加工作节点数虽然允许更大的外层动量，但为了稳定性所需的工作节点数可能会随局部步数的增加呈指数级增长。
AI.translation: 大型神经网络通常在多个工作节点之间进行训练，而节点之间的通信是一个主要的成本。因此，工作节点在向外层优化器发送其网络参数位移（即伪梯度）之前，会采取几个本地优化步骤，外层优化器通常应用 Nesterov 动量。我们研究了外层动量、本地步数和工作节点平均如何控制训练动态，特别是它们的稳定性。对于随机二次型，我们在任意维度下导出了一个精确的均方稳定性判据，该判据表明内层批大小决定了增加本地步数最终是会稳定还是会破坏外层迭代。此外，虽然对独立工作节点的伪梯度进行平均可以允许更大的外层动量值，但为了稳定性所需的工作节点数可能会随着本地步数的增加而呈指数级增长。最后，我们表明控制稳定性的均方动力学可以直接在中间神经网络检查点使用共享小批量扰动进行探测。我们在多个网络上测试了我们的理论发现，并测量了它们对训练损失的影响。
AI.summary: 该论文研究了分布式训练中外层 Nesterov 动量、本地步数和工作节点平均对随机伪梯度训练动态稳定性的影响。通过对随机二次型的精确均方稳定性分析以及神经网络实验，揭示了内层批大小和工作节点数对稳定性的关键调节作用。
AI.keywords: Nesterov momentum, Distributed training, Stability analysis, Local optimization steps, Stochastic pseudo-gradients
AI.comments: 该论文深入研究了分布式训练中外层 Nesterov 动量对随机伪梯度的稳定性影响，结合了理论分析（随机二次型）与神经网络实验验证，对于理解联邦学习或大规模分布式训练中的通信效率与稳定性权衡具有重要意义。

title: StratFL: Countering Covert Model Poisoning Attacks with Strategic Federated Learning
summary: Advanced persistent threats (APTs) are a major concern in federated learning (FL) deployments in critical sectors such as healthcare, and finance. Traditional defense mechanisms fail to contain APTs due to their intermittent attacking behavior. This paper addresses a specific type of APT called covert model poisoning (CMP) where the attacker intermittently injects poisoned model updates in a covert manner. The interaction between the FL server and a CMP attacker is modeled as an imperfect repeated game where both players cannot observe each other's actions. A novel adversarial search algorithm called StratFL is designed alongside novel belief update algorithms at both the server and adversary. Experiments are designed using MNIST and CIFAR-10 datasets to evaluate and compare StratFL's performance against state-of-the-art methods. Empirical convergence of belief update algorithms is demonstrated across various security vignettes. At the same time, StratFL is found to exhibit an improved accuracy of 10% compared to state-of-the-art methods.

AI.title_translation: StratFL：利用策略联邦学习对抗隐蔽模型投毒攻击
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为StratFL的策略联邦学习框架，通过博弈论建模有效对抗隐蔽模型投毒攻击，准确率较现有方法提升10%。
AI.motivation: 传统防御机制由于无法应对高级持续性威胁（APT）中间歇性的攻击行为（特别是隐蔽模型投毒攻击CMP），在医疗和金融等关键领域的联邦学习部署中失效。
AI.method: 将联邦学习服务器与攻击者的交互建模为不完美重复博弈，并设计了名为StratFL的新型对抗搜索算法以及服务器和攻击者的信念更新算法。
AI.result: 在MNIST和CIFAR-10数据集上的实验表明，信念更新算法具有经验收敛性，且StratFL相比现有最先进方法提高了10%的准确率。
AI.conclusion: StratFL能够有效应对联邦学习中的隐蔽模型投毒攻击，在保持模型收敛的同时显著提升了准确率。
AI.translation: 高级持续性威胁（APT）是医疗和金融等关键领域联邦学习（FL）部署中的主要担忧。传统的防御机制由于APT间歇性的攻击行为而无法遏制它们。本文研究了一种特定类型的APT，称为隐蔽模型投毒（CMP），攻击者以隐蔽的方式间歇性地注入有毒的模型更新。FL服务器与CMP attacker之间的交互被建模为一个不完美重复博弈，双方都无法观察到对方的行动。本文设计了一种名为StratFL的新型对抗搜索算法，以及服务器和敌手的信念更新算法。利用MNIST和CIFAR-10数据集设计了实验，以评估和比较StratFL与最先进方法的性能。在各种安全场景下验证了信念更新算法的经验收敛性。同时，研究发现StratFL的准确率比最先进的方法提高了10%。
AI.summary: 该论文针对联邦学习中隐蔽模型投毒攻击这一高级持续性威胁，提出了一种基于博弈论的防御框架StratFL，通过不完美重复博弈建模和新型对抗搜索与信念更新算法，显著提升了联邦学习在面对间歇性攻击时的安全性和准确率。
AI.keywords: 联邦学习, 隐蔽模型投毒, 重复博弈, 对抗攻击防御, 高级持续性威胁
AI.comments: 该论文将联邦学习中的隐蔽模型投毒攻击建模为不完美重复博弈，设计了StratFL对抗搜索算法及信念更新算法，在提高模型防御能力方面具有重要创新和实际应用价值。

title: Network-Wide Freeway Speed Nowcasting and Forecasting from Sparse Fixed Sensors with a Probe-Supervised Graph Convolutional Recurrent Network
summary: Traffic agencies need current and near-future speeds on every link of their network, but their fixed sensors cover only part of it. We study joint nowcasting and next-hour forecasting of hourly speeds on all 4{,}127 directional freeway links of the Dallas--Fort Worth region from sensors on 643 links (15.6%). Historical probe-vehicle data supervise every link in training; only sensor readings are used at inference. We call this setting probe-supervised sparse sensing. We propose GCRN+, a graph convolutional recurrent network that predicts deviations from a historical speed profile. It combines a parameter-free, direction-aware kernel interpolation of sensor anomalies, used as input features and as an output baseline, with a diffusion-convolutional GRU on the directed road graph, a low-rank adaptive graph and learnable link embeddings. It scales linearly with network size and trains on a CPU. Sensor readings are emulated from probe speeds, which isolates spatio-temporal inference from detector calibration. On four held-out test days, GCRN+ attains an RMSE of 2.21~mph for the current hour and 2.39~mph for the next hour on unsensored links, against 3.23~mph for the historical average. The best baselines that use the same interpolation features reach 2.53 and 2.75~mph. Adapted recent models without these features (STID, STAEformer, ImputeFormer, MoGERNN) reach at best 2.54 and 2.53~mph; this comparison is between complete pipelines rather than architectures. GCRN+ is best in every distance band except links not connected to any sensor through the road graph. Ablations within one recurrent backbone attribute most of the gain to the link embeddings and the adaptive graph, which can be trained because probe labels exist for every link. For congestion detection on unsensored links, recall rises from 77\% (historical average) and 86% (best competitor) to 89% at aprecision of 0.94.

AI.title_translation: 基于探针监督图卷积循环网络的稀疏固定传感器全路网高速公路车速即时与未来预测
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为GCRN+的图卷积循环网络模型，通过引入“探针监督稀疏传感”策略，利用仅占15.6%的稀疏固定传感器实现了全路网高速公路车速的高精度即时与未来预测。
AI.motivation: 交通机构需要获取路网中每个路段当前及近未来的车速，但固定传感器的覆盖率通常有限（如达拉斯-沃斯堡地区的643个传感器仅覆盖15.6%的路段），因此需要探索如何利用稀疏传感器结合历史探针数据实现全路网的车速即时预测与未来预测。
AI.method: 提出GCRN+模型，结合了参数无关、方向感知的传感器异常核插值（作为输入特征和输出基线）、有向路网上的扩散卷积GRU、低秩自适应图以及可学习的路段嵌入，使用历史车速剖面的偏差进行训练。
AI.result: 在四个测试日上，GCRN+在未安装传感器的路段上，当前小时的RMSE达到2.21 mph，下一小时达到2.39 mph（历史平均为3.23 mph），优于所有对比基线模型。在拥堵检测方面，精确度为0.94时，召回率达到89%。
AI.conclusion: GCRN+模型成功实现了利用稀疏固定传感器进行全路网的车速即时和未来预测，显著优于传统方法和现有先进模型，证明了探针监督策略和图神经网络在交通预测中的有效性。
AI.translation: 交通机构需要其路网中每个路段当前和近未来的车速，但其固定传感器只覆盖了部分路网。我们研究了达拉斯-沃斯堡地区所有4127个定向高速公路路段的联合即时预测（nowcasting）和下一小时预测（forecasting），数据来源于643个路段（15.6%）的传感器。历史探针车辆数据在训练期间监督每个路段；推理时仅使用传感器读数。我们将此设置称为探针监督稀疏传感。我们提出了GCRN+，一个预测历史车速剖面偏差的图卷积循环网络。它将传感器异常的无参数、方向感知核插值（用作输入特征和输出基线）与有向道路图上的扩散卷积GRU、低秩自适应图和可学习路段嵌入相结合。它随路网规模线性扩展，并可在CPU上进行训练。传感器读数由探针车速模拟，这隔绝了时空推理与探测器校准的影响。在四个保留的测试日上，GCRN+在无传感器路段上当前小时的RMSE达到2.21 mph，下一小时达到2.39 mph，而历史平均值为3.23 mph。使用相同插值特征的最佳基线达到了2.53和2.75 mph。没有这些特征的适配近期模型（STID, STAEformer, ImputeFormer, MoGERNN）最好也只达到2.54和2.53 mph；这种比较是完整管道之间的比较，而不仅仅是架构。GCRN+在除了通过道路图没有连接到任何传感器的路段之外的所有距离带中都是最好的。在一个循环骨干网内的消融实验将大部分增益归因于路段嵌入和自适应图，这由于每个路段都有探针标签而是可训练的。对于无传感器路段的拥堵检测，在精确度为0.94时，召回率从77%（历史平均值）和86%（最佳竞争者）上升到89%。
AI.summary: 本文研究了利用稀疏固定传感器和浮动车（探针）监督数据进行全路网车速即时与未来预测的问题，并提出了GCRN+图卷积循环网络模型。该模型在训练时利用探针数据监督所有路段，推理时仅依赖传感器，通过核插值、扩散卷积GRU、自适应图和路段嵌入的结合，在测试中表现出优异的预测精度和计算效率。
AI.keywords: 交通预测, 图卷积循环网络, 稀疏传感, 浮动车监督, 即时预测与预测
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了“探针监督稀疏传感”的新设定，在训练时利用浮动车数据监督所有路段，而推理时仅依赖稀疏的固定传感器。通过GCRN+模型结合参数无关的核插值、扩散卷积GRU、低秩自适应图和可学习路段嵌入，有效解决了路网范围内的车速即时预测（nowcasting）与未来预测（forecasting）难题。具有极高的实用价值和计算效率。

title: A Plausible Explanation Is Enough to Mislead Multimodal Judges
summary:
Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) increasingly serve as judges in training and evaluation pipelines, often assessing answers together with explanations. Although AI judges are sensitive to textual factors, it remains unclear whether ordinary plausible explanations can sway judgments requiring visual verification. We introduce JUPE, a visual-question-answering (VQA)-style benchmark that fixes answers while varying explanations.
  Across 14 MLLM judges, ordinary explanations that sound plausible mislead judges, with effects comparable on average to deliberately persuasive arguments. Plain justifications and chain-of-thought rationales reduce rejection of incorrect answers by 12.7 and 13.8 percentage points, respectively. We call this failure plausibility capture. Using signal detection theory, we find a significant mean shift in decision criterion toward acceptance, without a clear change in mean discriminability. Explanations sway judgments across domains, explanation generators, and judging protocols, while tested mitigations offer limited, model-dependent protection. Such shifts can inflate performance estimates when judges evaluate answers with explanations.

title: ToMStories: Interpreting Theory-of-Mind in Synthetic Narratives
summary: Understanding people often requires inferring what they feel or want from how they behave rather than from what they state outright. We ask whether language models can make these inferences, and how they do so. We introduce Theory-of-Mind Stories (ToMStories), an evaluation dataset of ~6,000 short synthetically generated narrative vignettes, each paired with a multiple-choice or open-ended question about a character's emotion, fear, motivation, or emotional wound. These psychological states are conveyed implicitly (showing), explicitly (telling), or with conflict between dialogue and description. Evaluating thirteen open-weight models (1B-72B parameters), we find that the largest models match humans on multiple choice but not open-ended questions. Our analyses point to simplifications models make in both interpretation and generation of implicit psychological states, indicating that synthetic data can help us understand how models perform interpretation, but likely overestimates how well models interpret humans.

title: Alert-List Concordance for Evaluating Imputation Strategies in ICU Sepsis Prediction
comments: 8 pages, 2 figures. Accepted at the 14th Workshop on Data Mining in Biomedical Informatics and Healthcare (DMBIH 2026), held in conjunction with IEEE ICDM 2026
summary: Preprocessing is an under-measured reliability risk in clinical prediction: a model can keep a similar AUROC and still change who receives an alert. Imputation quality is commonly evaluated using reconstruction error or aggregate discrimination, neither of which directly measures agreement on which patients are flagged. At a matched alert rate, pipelines with similar aggregate performance can produce different patient lists. This question is especially relevant under the frequent, structured missingness of real ICU records. We therefore introduce alert-list concordance, which asks whether two pipelines identify the same high-risk patients, measured by the Jaccard similarity of their top-k% alert sets with patient-level bootstrap confidence intervals. On PhysioNet/CinC 2019 (40,336 patients, 71.9% missingness), we compare nine imputation strategies and a native-missingness baseline using a fixed XGBoost configuration, fitted and Platt-calibrated separately for each strategy. After Bonferroni correction, 22 of the 28 reconstruction-method pairs showed no statistically significant difference in patient-level AUROC, yet their alert lists overlap at Jaccard 0.518 to 0.750. Similar aggregate discrimination can therefore accompany different patient selections. ForwardFill is a separate outlier, pairing higher discrimination with the lowest overlap in the matrix, 0.40 to 0.45. The broad pattern holds within each hospital system and under six patient-level aggregation rules. At the row level, eight of ten methods fall within an AUROC range of 0.011. In this row-level pipeline, deep imputers did not outperform mean imputation on discrimination, and the sequential implementations cost 5 to 12 times mean imputation in total pipeline wall-clock time on our hardware.

title: Measuring Mechanistic Uncertainty in Large Language Models via Causal Robustness
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in critical domains, where their susceptibility to hallucinations makes reliable and interpretable uncertainty quantification essential. We introduce the concept of mechanistic uncertainty, which characterizes uncertainty through the stability of the internal mechanisms supporting a model's response. We propose the causal robustness margin, defined as the minimum internal intervention required to deviate the model's output, and operationalize it using Jacobian Lens (Jlens) concept steering vectors. Across three open-source models and five question-answering datasets, we show incorrect and uncertain responses exhibit smaller margins, indicating greater sensitivity to internal interventions, and the causal robustness margin complements conventional output-based uncertainty methods. Finally, in a controlled knowledge injection experiment, correctly learned facts show increased margins after training, suggesting that causal robustness provides a mechanistically grounded signal of uncertainty.

title: Hard Instances on Demand
comments: Full version of a paper accepted to ALENEX 2027
summary:
The conclusions of an experimental study of algorithms are only as good as the instances they are run on. Benchmark libraries for well-studied problems took decades to curate, while evaluations of new problems often fall back on random instances, which are known to be misleading: they may say more about the random generator than about the algorithmic question at hand.
  We treat instance generation as an optimization problem: parameterize the instance space, take the solver's running time as the objective, and let a black-box optimizer search for hard instances. We develop a widely applicable workflow built on the Nevergrad optimization platform and demonstrate it on four NP-hard problems: satisfiability, traveling salesperson, Hamiltonian cycle, and non-permutation flow-shop scheduling. The search needs only the solver, an instance encoder, and a compute budget. Our evolved instances beat the hardest instance of a budget-matched random draw in all four case studies, by an order of magnitude or more in three. They are often competitive with long-curated benchmark sets: our SAT champion is harder (for a three-solver portfolio) than 78% of the 498 SAT Competition formulas in its size class; our 20-city TSP champions take several times longer than the hardest measured classical TSPLIB instance (229 cities); and our flow-shop champion takes 238.6 seconds of CP Optimizer time to solve to proven optimality (versus 4.5 seconds for the hardest of 100,000 random draws) while denying CP-SAT an optimality proof. The optimizer even recovers known structure from running time alone: it locates a SAT clause/variable ratio near the phase transition and finds structurally different champions for the two scheduling engines.

title: Inductive Learning of Concept Embeddings from Cross-Linguistic Colexification Patterns with Textual Attributes
summary: The advent of distributional semantics as a framework for computational semantics marked a paradigm shift in the nature of representations, by which meanings are represented as dense vectors commonly known as word embeddings. Computational approaches to historical or typological language comparison, on the other hand, still mostly rely on discrete representations, while the potential of embedding-based methods remains largely untapped in this context. Recent studies have proposed concept embeddings as a language-independent, onomasiological counterpart to word embeddings, based on networks of cross-linguistic colexification patterns. While the resulting concept embeddings reflect meaningful semantic properties and relations, they suffer from a lack of scalability, since they rely on transductive embedding approaches which only learn embeddings for nodes present in the training data. In this study, we present an inductive framework for learning concept embeddings, combining the structural properties of full and partial colexification networks with semantic information from short concept descriptions. This framework allows the embedding of unseen concepts based on a short definition. We show that the resulting concept embeddings correlate with various cross-linguistic measures of similarity or relatedness, while generalizing well to new concepts that were absent from the training data.

title: SAFETYEDIT: Sparse Internal Targets with Prompt-Wide Control for LLM Jailbreak Backdoors
summary: Model-editing backdoors aim to induce harmful responses under a trigger while preserving ordinary behavior on untriggered input. Recent model-editing approaches target affirmative response prefixes through rank-one updates to a small subset of model weights. Yet when this prefix-level target is satisfied, the model may still revert to refusal or produce a coherent, apparently compliant response that does not address the request. To overcome this limitation, existing internal-representation approaches shift focus from output tokens to dense, high-dimensional compliance directions in latent space. Existing representation-level approaches rely on preservation constraints to maintain conditionality, motivating us to ask whether a smaller internal target can offer a different effectiveness-preservation trade-off. Motivated by the comparable control capability of single-coordinate interventions, we investigate a sparse refusal-related MLP coordinate as this target. We propose SAFETYEDIT, which optimizes a single refusal-related coordinate and uses KV-cache marking in early attention layers to propagate a prefix-trigger signal across subsequent instruction positions. On some checkpoints a downstream MLP reader converts this signal into control of the coordinate, while on others the propagated signal alone suffices; the method is defined by the sparse target rather than by a fixed writer-reader pair. Across four open-weight LLMs and three dataset groups, SAFETYEDIT achieves the highest triggered Guard ASR in 11 of 12 comparisons and the highest mean StrongREJECT score in all 12, relative to the baselines evaluated for each model. Crucially, comprehensive ablation and behavioral audits confirm generally minimal changes in untriggered behavior and general capabilities in the tested configurations.

title: The Ephemeral Cost of Switching Optimizers Across LLM Training Stages
comments: Accepted to the Transitioning from Pre-Training to Post-Training Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Recent work suggests that switching optimizers between pretraining and subsequent training stages incurs a performance cost, but systematic investigation of this phenomenon is lacking. We study the mismatch between AdamW and Muon optimizers by pretraining 1.2B Llama-3 models from scratch while varying the proportion of updates taken with each optimizer, and similarly interpolating between the two optimizers during continued pretraining and supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Surprisingly, we find little evidence of a meaningful optimizer mismatch penalty: final performance is largely explained by the independent effects of the pretraining and post-training optimizers, with downstream performance generally improving as the proportion of Muon updates during SFT increases. Although matching the pretraining optimizer can reduce forgetting during SFT, this does not translate into improved final benchmark performance. We further evaluate AdamW and Muon for task-general SFT of open-weight models, across the Llama and Qwen families up to 14B parameters, where Muon remains competitive with AdamW, despite these models having been pretrained with AdamW. Together, our results suggest that the choice of optimizer for post-training can be made largely independently of the optimizer used during pretraining.

title: Evidence-Gated Bilingual RAG for Reliable Consumer Banking Search
summary: Consumers often describe what they need rather than use the terminology found on a banking website. For example, a natural-language request ("a card for travel") may not share the keywords of the relevant product page, and the problem is harder in bilingual services, where the same intent may be expressed in Arabic or English. This paper presents an evidence-gated bilingual retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework for consumer banking search that operates entirely on local infrastructure. The framework combines structured web-content refinement, hybrid dense-lexical retrieval, intent-aware evidence selection, cross-encoder reranking, and a three-outcome Answer / Related Mismatch / No Answer decision mechanism. On 210 URL-labeled Arabic and English queries, the proposed approach improves Top-1 hit rate from 50.48% to 79.05% and MRR@5 from 0.571 to 0.797 over a hybrid baseline. A separate 26-case end-to-end evaluation achieved 69.2% strict success, with 72.7% of generated answers classified as supported by an automated faithfulness judge. These results are preliminary: the retrieval queries are paraphrases of a small reference set, and the end-to-end test is small and uses an automated rather than human judge, so they do not establish human-verified answer correctness or generalizable performance.

title: Secondhand Stress: How Stressful Disclosures Affect Psychosocial Wellbeing in Online Graduate Admissions Communities
summary: Online communities provide spaces for individuals navigating stressful life transitions to disclose difficulties and seek peer support. Yet encountering others' distress may also have psychosocial implications for community members. Drawing on stress crossover theory, we examine how engagement with peer distress during graduate admissions is associated with subsequent psychosocial expression and participation, and whether similar associations extend through downstream interactions. We analyze 171,981 posts and 1,130,413 comments from two Reddit communities across three admissions cycles, using propensity-score stratification and baseline-adjusted comparisons. Users who engaged with distress disclosures during application preparation subsequently exhibited higher classifier-estimated anxiety, depression, and stress expression, alongside greater commenting activity and lexical redundancy. These associations recurred across admissions cycles, while no significant psychosocial associations were detected among downstream respondents interacting with previously exposed users. Our findings highlight how greater distress-related expression can coexist with continued community participation, while distinguishing direct engagement with distress disclosures from subsequent social contact. We discuss implications for designing online communities that preserve opportunities for self-disclosure and peer support while remaining attentive to the experiences of those encountering distress-related content.

title: Exploring The Empirical Privacy Landscape of Synthetic Data
summary: Methods for training language models on sensitive data differ in how they balance capability gains against the risk of leaking private information. In this paper, we present a controlled comparison of data-level and training-level interventions for navigating the capability-privacy tradeoff on synthetic medical records with canaries to probe for leakage. Direct finetuning performs best on capability metrics but leads to the most privacy leakage, while DP-SGD reduces leakage at substantial cost to capabilities. Generating synthetic data from these records offers a more favorable balance, particularly when guided by a uniqueness-aware instruction to replace private details. Relative to naive paraphrasing, privacy-aware rewriting improves privacy protection across a variety of different rewriting models. We also find that more capable rewriting models generally reduce the risks of downstream privacy leakage, although held-out fit does not improve monotonically and increased test-time compute yields inconsistent gains. Overall, these results highlight privacy-aware rewriting as a promising direction for achieving a more favorable trade-off between capabilities and empirical privacy compared to other training-level methods, and our evaluation framework supports comparisons of future models and methods.

title: Edit Discovery in Human-AI Interactions
summary: Human-AI interactions are becoming a rich source of data for improving AI systems: while many model responses are already satisfactory, others expose failures that could become valuable supervision if identified and corrected. We study this setting through the notion of an editor: a more capable evaluation process that can inspect a response and either confirm it or modify it, but whose invocation is costly. The editor may be a human expert, a stronger AI system, or the same model equipped with additional computation, context, tools, or information. The key challenge is to decide which interactions to send to the editor before knowing whether an edit will actually be made, since invoking the editor itself consumes limited resources such as expert time, inference cost, latency, or tool-use overhead. We formulate this problem as Edit Discovery Optimization (EDO), which seeks to minimize edit opportunities missed among skipped interactions while controlling unnecessary confirmations and respecting an editor-cost budget. We characterize the population-optimal policy and show that it takes the form of a cost-adjusted threshold on the posterior probability of an edit. Building on this structure, we develop EDIT (Edit Discovery via Iterative Thresholding), an online algorithm for the partial-feedback setting in which edit labels are revealed only for selected interactions. EDIT combines an adaptive edit score, a confirmation-control threshold, and a cost-aware selection rule; it satisfies the editor budget at every round and controls the average confirmation rate up to a vanishing finite-horizon term, without distributional assumptions on the interaction stream. Across four reasoning and factual question-answering benchmarks, EDIT achieves a better trade-off between editor cost, Type-I error, and Type-II error than direct LLM-based batch selection.

title: Enjoying the Product but Not Joining the Builders: Investigating Why Students Don't Contribute to OSS
summary: Open-source software (OSS) participation provides students with authentic exposure to collaborative, real-world software development, yet active contributions remain limited. This short paper presents an exploratory study of computing students' perceptions, knowledge, and experiences with OSS at the University of Hawai'i at Manoa. We administered a survey and analyzed 122 responses using both quantitative and qualitative methods. Students reported moderate OSS familiarity and frequent OSS use in coursework and personal projects, yet only 12.3% actively contributed and engagement with OSS communities was limited. Key barriers included skill gaps (72.89% of non-contributors), time constraints (59.81%), and codebase complexity (66.67% of contributors), often alongside imposter syndrome (36.45%). Students indicated that more time, mentorship, beginner-friendly issues, better onboarding/documentation, and curricular incentives (e.g., course credit) would most increase participation, while most reported their courses do not require or incentivize OSS contributions (58.20%). Grounded in a single institutional context, this study provides a nuanced understanding of how curriculum structure, faculty encouragement, and competing academic demands shape OSS participation. These insights inform the design of targeted curricular and institutional interventions aimed at supporting student onboarding and participation in OSS communities.

title: Diverse Reasoning Paths Matter: Symbolic Equivalence Augmentation for Enhancing RL Exploration
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a powerful paradigm for improving the reasoning capabilities of LLMs. However, the role of supervised fine-tuning (SFT) data in enabling effective downstream RL remains underexplored. In this paper, we investigate a key hypothesis: the diversity of reasoning steps in chain-of-thought (CoT) during SFT is a critical enabler of RLVR performance. To test this hypothesis, we introduce EquivAug, a data augmentation framework that uses symbolic equivalence transformations to generate diverse yet provably correct reasoning paths. By converting CoT solutions into formal symbolic representations, applying equivalence transformations, and reconstructing natural-language explanations, EquivAug produces training data that differs in reasoning steps rather than surface-level lexical variation. Experiments on GSM8K and FOLIO across model scales demonstrate that EquivAug consistently achieves the highest reasoning path diversity after SFT and the strongest accuracy after GRPO. Our results establish that CoT diversity during SFT is positively correlated with downstream RLVR performance.

title: From Relevant Memories to Sufficient Evidence: Rethinking Memory Utilization in LLM Agents
summary: Long-term memory enables LLM agents to reuse past experiences, yet retrieving relevant memories does not necessarily provide sufficient evidence for answering a query. Essential information may remain fragmented across memory records, obscured by abstraction, or disconnected from the relations required for reasoning. We identify this relevance-sufficiency gap and propose QEMem, a framework that reformulates memory utilization as the construction of query-specific evidence sets, shifting the focus from individual retrieval relevance to collective evidential support. QEMem integrates three complementary mechanisms: query-guided discovery retrieves evidence across multiple memory granularities; source-grounded reification organizes it into structured ViewCards with explicit evidential roles and source references; and sufficiency-guided refinement selectively recovers missing information. Operating on existing memory stores without modifying memory formation, QEMem achieves 91.43% LLM-judge accuracy on LoCoMo with Claude Opus 4.5, outperforming the strongest evaluated baseline, MemR$^3$, by 7.6 percentage points and NEMORI by 10.7 points under a shared memory store. Further analyses demonstrate improved evidence coverage and strong performance on questions requiring cross-session evidence integration.

title: Task Structure and Scalability in Multi-Robot Authoring
summary: Multi-robot authoring can reduce completion time by distributing drawing work, but the resulting speedup depends on task structure and the allocation-routing pipeline. We investigate these relationships by representing drawings as geometric stroke graphs and comparing component-level (single-token) allocation with shared-token (decomposed) allocation, which permits multiple robots to work within a connected component. A simulation study of 385 drawings and teams of one to eight robots shows diminishing speedup gains under single-token allocation and larger mean speedups under the shared-token pipeline, each normalized by its own single-robot completion time. Shared-token execution also exhibits lower idle-time shares at larger team sizes, although it does not reduce completion time for every drawing. Comparisons across structural attribute groups reveal associations between structural descriptors and differences in scaling behavior, with greater separation between several attribute groups at larger team sizes. These findings characterize empirical scaling in the evaluated pipelines and highlight the importance of considering within-component workload and graph structure alongside component count. Additional materials are available at https://sites.google.com/view/multirobotauthoring/home.

title: ProPerAgent: Toward Memory-Driven Proactive Assistance
summary: As assistants move from reactive answering toward proactive intervention, memory changes role: it no longer only supplies the answer to a query, it determines whether and when to speak at all. Prior work in this setting hands the system the relevant fact in context; we study the regime that makes the problem hard, where the evidence justifying an intervention must be mined from a long-horizon personal memory. We introduce ProPerMem, a benchmark for memory-driven proactive assistance (MPA), pairing egocentric video with year-long, distractor-rich user memories (~618K tokens on average), human-verified trigger windows, and a protocol that scores content and timing jointly. Every baseline we evaluate performs poorly (at most 15%), including frontier models given summarized or retrieval-augmented memory. A controlled study explains why: with oracle evidence delivered inside the trigger window GPT-5.3-Chat reaches 96%; letting it choose the timing drops it to 38%, and replacing oracle evidence with retrieval drops it to 15%. Content and timing are separately necessary, and missing either is catastrophic. Guided by this, we build ProPerAgent (Proactive Personalized Agent) with a plug-and-play harness that surfaces memory from a graph-organized store and gates it down to what is worth interrupting for, plus a lightweight RL stage that curbs early and repeated firing. Without any training, ProPerAgent lifts strict accuracy from below 10% to 37.5% on Qwen3.8-27B and 38% on GPT-5.3-Chat; RL post-training reaches 42.4%.

title: Not All Graphs Are Maps: A Task-Agnostic Exploration Framework for Mobile GUI Navigation
summary: Modern mobile GUI agents can perceive visible screens and execute local actions, but they still lack persistent app-specific navigation knowledge: where functions live, which pages contain them, and which screens are equivalent across repeated visits. We introduce TAG-Nav, a Task-Agnostic Graph Navigation framework that wraps existing GUI-agent backbones with reusable destination memory. Offline exploration is distilled into compact records of app functions, target pages, and waypoint routes before any evaluated instruction is seen. When a future task's destination is covered, TAG-Nav retrieves the destination and provides route guidance without task-specific demonstrations. This separates mobile GUI destination navigation from full task completion: many tasks share the prefix of reaching the right page, while final actions may enter content, send data, make purchases, delete information, or change sensitive settings. To evaluate route finding without downstream execution confounds, we introduce DestBench, a navigation-only protocol that asks whether an agent reaches the correct pre-action destination screen. DestBench enables a controlled graph-memory study comparing no-memory agents with random, automated BFS, and clean graph memory. Graph-derived memory improves strict navigation success rate of UI-TARS-1.5-7B from 52.4% without graph memory to 58.3% with automated BFS memory, and improves Qwen-VL-Max success rate from 59.5% to 71.4% on the same conditions. Together, TAG-Nav and DestBench show that destination coverage and route cleanliness strongly shape graph-memory value, making graph quality a measured variable rather than an assumed benefit of exploration.

title: The Case for TPU-Accelerated Analytical Query Processing
summary:
Large-scale analytical query processing requires computing substrates capable of immense distributed scale-out. Tensor Processing Units (TPUs) perfectly embody this extreme-scale architecture, offering massive computational density and highly scalable optical pod-level interconnects. Despite these advantages, TPUs have so far remained largely unexplored for analytical database workloads. In this paper, we present the first comprehensive case for TPU-accelerated analytical query processing by running all the TPC-H queries entirely on the TPUs. We introduce Native TPU Accelerator (NTA) for analytical query processing, which provides hardware-conscious algorithm design and optimizations in JAX/XLA. By exposing the TPU's structural mechanics, we demonstrate how dynamic, memory-bound database operations can be rewritten into deterministic JAX programs. We engineer a suite of novel execution strategies that leverage both the TPU's TensorCore and SparseCore to trade sparse, unpredictable memory accesses for dense, hardware-aligned ones. At the core of NTA, a compiler uses catalog statistics to assign guarded static capacities and a hardware-calibrated local cost model to select a TPU-native implementation for each relational operator before JIT compilation.
  We evaluate our system using the TPC-H benchmark. Taking full advantage of TPU slices and JAX distributed computing, we seamlessly scale our execution environment to run TPC-H benchmark up to Scale Factor 1000 (SF1000). Evaluated against a rigorous CPU ground truth (DuckDB), our native TPU accelerator achieves state-of-the-art performance, achieving a 7.0x single-device speedup over DuckDB at SF100 and a 68.6x speedup with 16 TPUs at SF1000 (1TB). The results establish TPUs not merely as dense neural compute hardware, but as a highly competitive, massively scalable substrate for the next generation of analytical query processing.

title: Gossip Agents: Reputation through Opinion Dynamics over Evolving Networks
summary: Sustained cooperation among self-interested learning agents is essential in many shared environments. Reputation systems are among the best-studied mechanisms for promoting such cooperation. Existing multi-agent reinforcement learning approaches, however, typically assume that reputation is either globally available to all agents or derived solely from an agent's own observations, leaving largely unexplored how reputational information propagates between agents. We study gossip, the exchange of information about third parties, as a mechanism for reputation diffusion over dynamic communication networks. Agents form private opinions from limited observations and exchange them with their neighbors following DeGroot opinion dynamics, while the communication network changes as agents interact and move. A tunable broadcast radius controls the reach of information, spanning private reputation, local gossip, and globally shared reputation. We study this framework in two \(n\)-player social dilemmas with distinct network dynamics: a Prisoner's Dilemma with randomly resampled interaction groups and Harvest, where communication neighborhoods emerge from agents' movements. Our results show that the reach of reputational information shapes cooperation in both environments. Moreover, in Harvest, reputation diffusion increases environmental rewards and leads to more peaceful and sustainable behavior.

title: Online Constraint Optimization-Based Indirect-Adaptive Robust Control for Autonomous Vehicles with Unknown Friction
summary: Friction uncertainty is a significant challenge for autonomous vehicle control, undermining feasibility and performance. This paper proposes a novel two-layer control framework to achieve vehicle motion control under large friction uncertainty by combining optimization-based planning with indirect adaptive robust control (IARC). The upper layer solves a constrained optimal control problem to generate a feasible trajectory that satisfies all the constraints in a time-optimal manner along the desired path. The lower layer, IARC, adapts the unknown parameters related to friction uncertainty and combines model compensation with robust feedback to ensure transient and steady-state tracking performance. An estimation monitor is designed to prevent poor learning when data indicate a model mismatch, while a smooth parameter reset reduces the estimated tire capacity and limits abrupt tightening of constraints. The updated parameters are fed back into the model and constraints in the planner, enabling trajectory replanning as friction conditions change. Simulation results indicate that the proposed method achieves accurate tracking of the desired trajectory and online friction adaptation under large friction uncertainty while ensuring time-optimal vehicle motion. The simulation results demos are available at https://github.com/TedZhou0603/CO-IARC.

title: Deep Learning for Deepfake Image Detection: Comparative Model Evaluation and Gradient-Based Visual Attribution
summary: Synthetic facial imagery has made the distinction between authentic and generated content increasingly important for digital forensics and online trust. This study examines an explainable deep-learning workflow for image-level deepfake detection using two contrasting classification strategies: a compact convolutional model trained from scratch and an ImageNet-pretrained MobileNetV2 model adapted through two-stage transfer learning. Experiments were conducted with the balanced 140k Real and Fake Faces dataset, comprising 140,000 facial images. Under the recorded validation protocol, the augmented from-scratch model reached 84.15% accuracy (loss 0.3625), compared with 95.90% accuracy (loss 0.1074) for the fine-tuned pretrained model. Gradient-weighted class activation mapping (Grad-CAM) was used to visualize image regions associated with predictions, and a Flask-based prototype was developed for side-by-side inspection. These observations support the practical value of pretrained visual representations in the studied setting while underscoring the need to interpret validation performance alongside dataset provenance, explanation limitations, and evaluation scope. The reported results are validation results, not held-out test estimates.

title: Whose Polarization Is It? Auditing Fairness in Network Polarization Measures
summary: A polarization score is supposed to describe a community, not its surroundings. Yet when a minority community is embedded in a larger network, its measured polarization can rise or fall with the size and structure of the majority around it. We ask whether polarization measures are therefore fair to minorities and develop an audit built around two criteria: measurement invariance (MI), which asks whether otherwise equivalent majorities and minorities receive equivalent scores, and structural exogeneity (SE), which asks whether a minority's score changes when its surrounding majority changes. Resolution sensitivity (RS) is treated as a prerequisite for meaningful fairness assessment. We audit seven polarization measure families spanning the three network-operationalizable dimensions of polarization, introducing Network-Weighted Distance (NWD) to fill an unserved extremeness-separation combination. Across controlled synthetic networks, mechanism-isolating diagnostic topologies, and real political and communication networks, no measure passes all applicable checks. Minorities are systematically scored as more polarized than equivalent majorities. We trace this dependence to two separate channels: majority structure can alter the opinions that opinion-reading measures consume, and, on a different path, opinion-orthogonal structural change can affect the arithmetic of structural measures. Reading opinions is thus double-edged, letting contamination in when structure moves opinions but shielding the score when structure changes and opinions do not. We close with practical guidance for reporting polarization scores without inheriting these biases.

title: Retrospective Evaluation of Bluetooth RSSI Fingerprinting for Bin Localization on an Industrial Shop Floor
summary: This paper evaluates an archival Bluetooth Low Energy received signal strength indicator (RSSI) dataset collected for bin localization on an industrial shop floor. The installation used 24 fixed relays positioned on walls and Bluetooth beacons attached to bins, with each relay applying a Kalman filter to its own readings in firmware before publishing them. The primary survey produced 19,034 usable two-minute fingerprint samples across 90 known positions, with 23 relay measurements available as model features. We compare calibrated path-loss multilateration with two radio-map estimators: distance-weighted $k$-nearest neighbours and Random Forest regression. A random 70/30 row split measures recognition at surveyed positions, while a coordinate-grouped split reserves 27 entire positions for testing and measures interpolation to unseen positions. Random Forest achieved a median error of 0.66~m for surveyed positions, with 77.9% of estimates within 3~m and 96.3% within 10~m. For unseen positions, median error increased to 9.42~m and 55.5% of estimates were within 10~m. Path-loss multilateration produced a 19.41~m median error on unseen positions, close to the 19.62~m mean-position baseline. The results support RSSI fingerprinting for a fixed inventory of surveyed bin positions, but not precise continuous localization between survey points. Git history dates the original implementation to September 7, 2019. The evaluation code in this paper was written in October 2026 and is reported separately from the seven-year-old prototype.

title: EgoP$^{2}$C: Internalizing Plan-Perceive-Compose for Spatial Reasoning in Egocentric Video
summary: Answering complex spatial reasoning questions from egocentric video requires determining what evidence is needed, acquiring targeted observations, and combining them through multiple reasoning steps. Existing vision-language models (VLMs) struggle to perform this process reliably. Agentic systems address this challenge by querying external vision and geometry tools, but training their reasoning leaves these tools unchanged, so inaccurate observations can still lead to incorrect answers. We introduce EgoP$^{2}$C, a framework that internalizes a plan-perceive-compose process within a single VLM. To this end, we first train specialized Planner and Perception teachers using separate adapters (Dual-LoRA), then fine-tune the corresponding experts in a mixture-of-experts (MoE) student under their supervision. We subsequently train the student on trajectories generated by its current policy using a segment-level extension of multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD), assigning different trajectory segments to different supervisors. The Planner teacher supervises which evidence-seeking questions to ask, when to stop gathering evidence, and how to compose the final answer. The Perception teacher supervises the video-grounded answers to those questions. At inference, the student executes this adaptive workflow end-to-end, without external spatial tools. Across three spatial reasoning benchmarks, EgoP$^{2}$C students built from Qwen3-VL-8B and SenseNova-SI-1.3-8B outperform their base models by an average of 9.2 and 7.5 percentage points, respectively. Across both backbones, EgoP$^{2}$C reduces inference FLOPs by 65.8-66.3% and achieves $1.29$-$1.49\times$ speedups over their shared Dual-LoRA teacher.

title: FlexUMM: Flexible Representation Learning for Unified Multimodal Models
summary: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) can integrate understanding and generation within a single backbone. However, it is commonly known that these two capabilities can cause conflicting representations, leading to a central question: how representation and computation should be shared across functionalities? Existing UMMs often rely on a largely fixed structure, where different inputs and functionalities follow the same depth and parameter-sharing pattern. We argue that this assumption is too restrictive: more effective unification requires sharing the computation that supports cross-functional communication while specializing the capacity that becomes task- or input-specific. We introduce FlexUMM, a flexible UMM framework that dynamically decides when to preserve shared computation, when to route specialized capacity, and when to stop further processing. Evidence shows that this flexible allocation improves UMMs along two complementary axes. It improves accuracy by reducing harmful competition between functionalities, and it improves efficiency by avoiding unnecessary computation once an input representation is sufficiently mature. Beyond simple architectural unification from the pre-trained models, FlexUMM works as a model-agnostic, functional plug-in to make existing UMMs more unified, stronger, and efficient. Code is available at: https://github.com/AIFrontierLab/TorchUMM/tree/main/src/umm/post_training/flexumm.
