AI.title_translation: 可验证授权：跨人类、组织和智能体交易的可验证授权解析与控制协议
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为ChainIT Authority Protocol的控制平面协议，用于在人类、组织和AI智能体交易中提供可验证的授权解析和执行控制。
AI.motivation: 现有支付系统虽然能认证用户、设备和凭据，但无法为依赖方提供紧凑、独立可验证的证据，以证明交易发起者在当前证据、政策、预算和审批状态下拥有实际的组织授权。特别是随着AI智能体商业的发展，这一漏洞变得尤为紧迫。
AI.method: 提出了ChainIT Authority Protocol，分离了持久身份、版本化组织权限记录、源证据断言、确定性策略谓词及处置方式；将人类审批绑定到规范交易摘要；通过原子容量保留应对并发；并使用单次使用、发送者受限的执行授权凭证（Execution Authorization Credential）授权提交。
AI.result: 规范了提交时的执行谓词和有界新鲜度状态规则，提供了针对法币（ACH、电汇、银行卡、即时支付）和稳定币通道的执行配置文件，并指出了残留风险与非目标。
AI.conclusion: 论文成功设计了ChainIT Authority Protocol及其代理主体配置文件，能够有效解决传统支付和新兴AI智能体交易中的授权验证痛点，在保障交易合规和权限控制的同时适应多种支付通道。
AI.translation: 支付系统可以对用户、设备、账户和密码凭证进行身份验证，但依赖方（如交易对手、支付通道、市场或自主智能体运行时）通常无法获得紧凑的、可独立验证的证据，以证明出示某个具体交易的一方在适用的证据、政策、预算和审批状态下，拥有执行该交易的当前组织权限。智能体商业使得这一差距在运营上变得紧迫：软件 agent 在其实施超出委托目的、赞助商权限发生变化之后，或者在与人类批准的交易细节不同的情况下，仍然可以生成有效的签名。我们描述了 ChainIT 授权协议（ChainIT Authority Protocol），这是一个与主体无关且与通道无关的预执行授权和证据控制平面。该协议将持久身份、版本化组织权限记录（Authority Resolution Pactvera）、来源证据断言、确定性带原因代码的策略谓词以及组织配置的处置方式进行了分离；将每个决策和人类批准绑定到一个规范的交易摘要；原子化地保留容量以确保限制在并发情况下依然有效；并通过在通道适配器处消耗的、单次使用的、受发送者约束的执行授权凭证（Execution Authorization Credential）来授权提交，并在终端结果产生后密封追加写入的生命周期证据。智能体主体配置文件（Agent Subject Profile）增加了当行动主体为人工智能 agent 时所需的工作负载注册、证明密钥层次结构和主权边界，而没有引入单独的授权概念。我们指定了提交时的执行谓词和有界新鲜度状态规则，给出了法币（ACH、电汇、银行卡、即时支付）和稳定币通道的执行配置文件，并陈述了残余风险和非目标。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了ChainIT Authority Protocol，一个用于跨人类、组织和AI智能体交易的、与主体和通道无关的预执行授权与证据控制平面，以解决由于代理越权或状态变化带来的可验证授权漏洞。
AI.keywords: 可验证授权, 智能体商业, 支付系统, 授权解析协议, 组织权限控制
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的“ChainIT Authority Protocol”，用于解决跨人类、组织和AI智能体的可验证授权解析和控制问题。这在智能体商业（Agentic Commerce）日益普及的背景下具有极高的现实意义和创新价值，它有效弥补了传统支付系统无法在交易执行前独立验证复杂授权状态的漏洞。

title: Structured Perception Representations for Off-road Dynamics Learning
summary: Autonomously navigating off-road terrain at high speed demands accurate control, which often relies on dynamics models that capture complex interactions between the robot and terrain. In off-road regimes, terrain interaction is a major component of the vehicle's dynamics. Prior work attempts to capture this effect by training learned models of the vehicle's dynamics, conditioned on its perception of the local environment. However, said conditioning is often overly simplistic, ignoring the spatial structure of the dynamics problem. Our approach, SpatialBEV, exploits this spatial structure. At each step, we query the bird's-eye-view (BEV) features around the predicted state, conditioning the next prediction on current geometric and semantic cues. We additionally present a benchmarking approach that mines a dataset's most difficult scenarios. On datasets collected across seasons, SpatialBEV reduces prediction error by 17.1%, compared to physics-based and learned baselines. We further evaluate on hardware on high-speed ($\geq$10 m/s) and geometrically challenging courses with a 25.3% reduction in maximum cross-track error. More details can be found at https://theairlab.org/spatial-bev-dynamics .

AI.title_translation: 用于越野动力学学习的结构化感知表征
AI.tldr: 提出 SpatialBEV，通过利用鸟瞰图的空间结构显著提升了高速越野自动驾驶的动力学预测和控制精度。
AI.motivation: 现有越野自主导航的动力学模型对局部环境感知条件的利用过于简单，忽略了动力学问题的空间结构，导致无法准确捕捉复杂的越野地形与车辆交互。
AI.method: 提出了 SpatialBEV 方法，在每一步根据预测状态查询鸟瞰图（BEV）特征，从而将当前的空间几何和语义线索条件化到下一步的动力学预测中；同时提出了一种挖掘数据集中最难场景的基准测试方法。
AI.result: 在跨季节数据集上，SpatialBEV 相比基于物理和学习的基准方法将预测误差降低了 17.1%；在硬件实测的高速（$\ge$10 m/s）和几何复杂赛道上，最大横向轨迹误差减少了 25.3%。
AI.conclusion: SpatialBEV 通过在预测状态周围查询 BEV 特征，有效建模了复杂的越野地形与车辆相互作用，在仿真和真实硬件实验中均展现出优于现有基准的性能。
AI.translation: 以高速自主导航越野地形需要精确的控制，这通常依赖于能够捕捉机器人与地形之间复杂相互作用的动力学模型。在越野情况下，地形相互作用是车辆动力学的重要组成部分。先前的研究试图通过训练以局部环境感知为条件的车辆动力学学习模型来捕捉这种效应，但这种条件化通常过于简单，忽略了动力学问题的空间结构。我们的方法 SpatialBEV 利用了这种空间结构。在每一步中，我们在预测状态周围查询鸟瞰图（BEV）特征，将下一个预测条件化于当前的几何和语义线索。我们还提出了一种挖掘数据集中最困难场景的基准测试方法。在跨季节收集的数据集上，与基于物理和学习的基准相比，SpatialBEV 将预测误差降低了 17.1%。我们在高速（$\ge$10 m/s）和几何具有挑战性的赛道上对硬件进行了进一步评估，最大横向误差减少了 25.3%。更多详情请访问 https://theairlab.org/spatial-bev-dynamics。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了 SpatialBEV，一种利用鸟瞰图（BEV）特征的空间结构来改进越野车辆动力学学习的方法，通过结合几何与语义线索提升了高速导航的准确性。
AI.keywords: 越野自主导航, 动力学学习, 鸟瞰图特征, 空间结构, 车辆控制
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将鸟瞰图（BEV）特征与车辆动力学模型结合，有效利用了越野环境中的空间结构信息，显著提升了高速越野自主导航的控制精度和鲁棒性。

title: SenseSwarm: Swarm Exploration via Neural Structure Estimation with Shared World-Anticipation for Rapid Mapping
summary: A robot swarm covers a building faster with more robots, but the map is only as complete as the space the robots have physically visited. We target the amount of an unknown building a decentralized swarm knows at each instant, ahead of physical coverage. SenseSwarm serves a lightweight learned map predictor on the swarm's shared occupancy map and folds the predicted structure back into a stigmergic guidance field. Its 709K-parameter predictor is fine-tuned on the swarm's own multi-front observations, which we show is necessary: a single-robot predictor collapses on such views. We build a benchmark of twelve real building floors from HouseExpo, HKUST, and KTH, up to 24,000 square meters, and run 1,620 simulations across nine coordination methods, swarm sizes 32 to 512, and three seeds. On physical coverage the swarm is near parity with a greedy frontier planner, as expected. On map reconstruction, every non-predictive baseline needs 1.3 to 1.9 times longer to reach an 80 percent known map, and SenseSwarm holds an equal-time area lead of about 670 square meters, up to 1,359. Folding the prediction into the shared field matters: the same predictor applied per robot matches our speed but suffers a 6.9 times higher inter-robot contact rate at 512 robots. The prediction is computed once per shared map, so its cost stayed flat from 32 to 512 robots.

AI.title_translation: SenseSwarm：通过共享世界预期的神经结构估计实现群集快速探索与建图
AI.tldr: SenseSwarm 通过在机器人集群的共享地图上利用轻量级神经网络预测未知空间结构，实现了比传统方法快 1.3 到 1.9 倍的快速地图重建。
AI.motivation: 机器人群体虽然能更快地覆盖建筑物，但地图的完整性受限于机器人物理到达的空间。现有的非预测性方法在获取未知建筑物的全局知识时速度较慢，因此需要一种能够在物理覆盖之前预测未知建筑结构以实现快速建图的方法。
AI.method: 提出 SenseSwarm 方法，在机器人群体的共享占用图上运行一个轻量级（709K参数）的学习型地图预测器，该预测器根据多前沿观测结果进行微调，并将预测结构折叠回一个信息素式（stigmergic）的引导场中。
AI.result: 在包含12个真实建筑楼层的基准测试中，与非预测性基准相比，SenseSwarm 达到 80% 已知地图所需的时间缩短了 1.3 到 1.9 倍，同等时间下的地图面积领先优势约为 670 到 1,359 平方米。同时，计算成本在 32 到 512 个机器人规模下保持平稳，且将预测融入共享字段能显著降低机器人间的接触率。
AI.conclusion: SenseSwarm 通过在共享占用图上利用轻量级学习型地图预测器并将其融入引导场，显著超越了传统非预测性基准，在加速地图重构的同时保持了较低的计算成本和碰撞率。
AI.translation: 机器人集群用更多机器人可以更快地覆盖建筑物，但地图的完整性仅限于机器人实际访问过空间。我们的目标是提升去中心化集群在每个瞬间对未知建筑物已知区域的认知，超越物理覆盖范围。SenseSwarm 在集群的共享占用图上提供了一个轻量级的学习型地图预测器，并将预测的结构折叠回一个信息素式的引导场中。其 709K 参数的预测器根据集群自身的多前沿观测进行了微调，我们证明这是必要的：单机器人预测器在此类视图下会崩溃。我们建立了包含 HouseExpo、HKUST 和 KTH 的 12 个真实建筑楼层（面积达 24,000 平方米）的基准，并在 9 种协调方法、32 到 512 的集群规模以及 3 个随机种子下进行了 1,620 次模拟。在物理覆盖方面，正如预期，该集群与贪婪前沿规划器不相上下。在地图重建方面，每个非预测性基准达到 80% 已知地图所需的时间长了 1.3 到 1.9 倍，SenseSwarm 在同等时间下的面积领先优势约为 670 平方米，最高可达 1,359 平方米。将预测折叠到共享字段中至关重要：相同的预测器应用于每个机器人虽然达到了相同的速度，但在 512 个机器人时，机器人间的接触率高出 6.9 倍。预测是每个共享地图计算一次，因此其计算成本在 32 到 512 个机器人之间保持平稳。
AI.summary: SenseSwarm 是一种用于机器人集群探索的创新方法，它利用轻量级的神经结构预测器预测未知建筑空间，并通过共享引导场实现快速建图，极大地提高了地图重建的效率和广度。
AI.keywords: 机器人群体, 神经结构估计, 快速建图, 分布式探索, 共享世界预期
AI.comments: SenseSwarm 创新性地将轻量级神经结构估计与分布式机器人群体（swarm）的协同探索相结合，通过共享的世界预期（world-anticipation）显著提升了地图重建的速度和空间感知范围，同时有效控制了高密度群体下的碰撞风险。这对于灾难救援和快速测绘等应用具有重要价值。

title: FederatedBytes: Tokenizer-Free, Byte-Level Small Language Models for Efficient Multimodal Federated Learning
summary: Federated Learning (FL) is a powerful machine learning framework that allows building a global model from the contributions of multiple, distributed clients, while ensuring the privacy of their local data. However, its heavy computational and communication overheads challenge its use for contemporary AI workloads such as natural language processing (NLP) and multimodal analysis. For this reason, this paper presents a novel small language model that leverages byte-level text and multimodal data processing, enhanced by a linear attention mechanism, to enable manageable Federated Learning of NLP and multimodal analysis tasks. The proposed model, nicknamed FederatedBytes, manages to process text and any other data types, including images, by treating its input as a mere sequence of bytes, while its lean linear attention mechanism allows abating the overall memory and computational footprint. To prove the effectiveness of the proposed model we have carried out an extensive performance evaluation on sentiment analysis tasks in multilingual and multimodal settings over the Multilingual Amazon Reviews and ScienceQA datasets. The experimental results show that FederatedBytes has been able to outperform comparable models such as ByT5 and LSTM, achieving higher accuracy while significantly reducing memory and communication overheads.

AI.title_translation: FederatedBytes：用于高效多模态联邦学习的无分词器字节级小型语言模型
AI.tldr: FederatedBytes是一种无分词器的字节级小语言模型，结合了线性注意力机制，能够在联邦学习中高效处理多语言和多模态任务，同时降低通信和内存开销。
AI.motivation: 传统的联邦学习在处理自然语言处理和多模态分析等现代AI任务时，面临着沉重的计算和通信开销挑战。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为FederatedBytes的新型小语言模型，采用无需分词器的字节级文本及多模态数据处理方式，并结合线性注意力机制以降低内存和计算开销。
AI.result: 在多语言和多模态情感分析任务（Multilingual Amazon Reviews和ScienceQA数据集）上的实验表明，FederatedBytes的表现优于ByT5和LSTM等同类模型，实现了更高的准确率，同时显著减少了内存和通信开销。
AI.conclusion: FederatedBytes为资源受限的联邦学习环境提供了一种高效的多模态小语言模型解决方案，在保证高准确率的同时大幅削减了通信与内存成本。
AI.translation: 联邦学习（FL）是一种强大的机器学习框架，允许从多个分布式客户端的贡献中构建全局模型，同时确保其本地数据的隐私。然而，其沉重的计算和通信开销对将其用于自然语言处理（NLP）和多模态分析等当代AI工作负载提出了挑战。为此，本文提出了一种新颖的小型语言模型，该模型利用字节级文本和多模态数据处理，并由线性注意力机制增强，以实现对NLP和多模态分析任务的可管理联邦学习。所提出的模型被命名为FederatedBytes，通过将输入视为单纯的字节序列来处理文本以及图像等任何其他数据类型，而其精简的线性注意力机制则能够减少整体内存和计算占用。为了证明所提模型的有效性，我们在Multilingual Amazon Reviews和ScienceQA数据集上的多语言和多模态设置的情感分析任务中进行了广泛的性能评估。实验结果表明，FederatedBytes能够优于ByT5和LSTM等同类模型，在实现更高准确率的同时显著降低了内存和通信开销。
AI.summary: FederatedBytes是一个针对高效多模态联邦学习而设计的无需分词器的字节级小语言模型。它通过将输入视为字节序列来处理文本及图像等多模态数据，并利用线性注意力机制减少内存和计算开销，在多语言和多模态任务中超越了传统模型。
AI.keywords: Federated Learning, Small Language Models, Byte-Level Processing, Multimodal Analysis, Linear Attention
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将字节级处理与线性注意力机制结合应用于联邦学习的小语言模型中，摆脱了传统分词器的依赖，兼顾了多模态处理能力和隐私保护需求，显著降低了通信和计算开销。

title: COMET: Decoupled Distillation, Routing, and Capacity Control for Task-Agnostic Continual Vision--Language Learning
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) such as CLIP retain zero-shot recognition ability, but their open-world use often requires task-agnostic continual learning: tasks arrive sequentially, past data are unavailable, task identity is unknown, and the backbone cannot be retrained. We argue that this setting fails VLMs through three coupled pressures beyond the stability-plasticity tradeoff: (1) modal-consistency drift, (2) representation-space interference, and (3) per-task capacity shortfall. We propose COMET (Collaborative Mixture-of-Expert Transfer) to resolve these three issues respectively as follows. A frozen teacher provides only a feature reference on a shared image-text pool; Tri-Affinity Distillation preserves image-image, text-text, and image-text geometry; and Student-Aware Cross-Expert Distillation aligns new experts with compatible prior experts so routing errors degrade gracefully. We design COMET to keep capacity and inference separate: a contextual bandit keeps or merges full per-task experts using post-training signals, while a reconstruction router selects sparse experts at test time without teacher semantics. On the X-TAIL benchmark, we show that each proposed component improves continual learning performance. COMET shows that continual vision-language adaptation can preserve multimodal geometry, coordinate accumulated experts, and allocate capacity jointly when feature reference, expert shaping, routing, and capacity control are separated by construction.

AI.title_translation: COMET：面向任务无关持续视觉-语言学习的解耦蒸馏、路由与容量控制
AI.tldr: 本文提出了COMET框架，通过解耦蒸馏、路由和容量控制，解决了任务无关持续视觉语言学习中的多重挑战，在保持多模态几何和动态分配容量方面表现优异。
AI.motivation: 现有的视觉语言模型在开放世界使用时常需面对任务无关的持续学习，然而传统设置带来了模态一致性漂移、表示空间干扰和每任务容量不足三大耦合压力，导致现有方法表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出COMET（协同专家混合迁移）框架，包含三个核心部分：用于保持图像-图像、文本-文本和图像-文本几何结构的“三亲和力蒸馏”（Tri-Affinity Distillation）；用于对齐新老专家的“学生感知跨专家蒸馏”（Student-Aware Cross-Expert Distillation）；以及利用上下文赌博机和重建路由器分别进行容量控制和推理时稀疏专家选择的解耦容量与推理机制。
AI.result: 在X-TAIL基准测试上，实验结果表明所提出的每一个组件均能显著提升持续学习的性能。
AI.conclusion: COMET通过将特征参考、专家塑造、路由和容量控制在结构上进行解耦，成功实现了持续视觉语言适应中多模态几何的保持、累积专家的协同以及容量的联合分配。
AI.translation: 诸如CLIP之类的视觉-语言模型（VLMs）保留了零样本识别能力，但其开放世界的应用通常需要任务无关的持续学习：任务顺序到达，过去的数据不可用，任务身份未知，且主干网络无法重新训练。我们认为，这种设置由于三个耦合的压力（超越了稳定性-可塑性权衡）而使VLMs失效：（1）模态一致性漂移，（2）表示空间干扰，以及（3）每任务容量不足。我们提出了COMET（Collaborative Mixture-of-Expert Transfer，协同专家混合迁移）来分别解决这三个问题。冻结的教师模型仅在共享的图像-文本池上提供特征参考；三亲和力蒸馏（Tri-Affinity Distillation）保持图像-图像、文本-文本以及图像-文本的几何结构；学生感知跨专家蒸馏（Student-Aware Cross-Expert Distillation）将新专家与兼容的先前专家对齐，从而使路由错误优雅地退化。我们设计COMET使容量和推理保持分离：上下文赌博机使用后训练信号保留或合并每个任务的完整专家，而重建路由器在测试时选择稀疏专家而无需教师语义。在X-TAIL基准测试中，我们表明每个提出的组件都改进了持续学习性能。COMET表明，当特征参考、专家塑造、路由和容量控制在结构上解耦时，持续的视觉-语言自适应可以保持多模态几何、协调积累的专家并联合分配容量。
AI.summary: 论文提出了COMET框架，用于解决任务无关的持续视觉语言学习中的多重挑战。该框架通过三亲和力蒸馏、学生感知跨专家蒸馏以及解耦的容量控制与路由机制，实现了模态几何保持、专家协同及联合容量分配。
AI.keywords: 持续视觉语言学习, 混合专家模型, 知识蒸馏, 路由机制, 多模态模型
AI.comments: 本文针对与任务无关的持续视觉语言学习（Task-Agnostic Continual Vision-Language Learning）这一极具挑战性的设置，创新性地提出了COMET框架。通过解耦蒸馏、路由和容量控制，有效地解决了模态一致性漂移、表示空间干扰和每任务容量不足三大核心痛点，并在X-TAIL基准上验证了其卓越性能，具有很高的学术价值和应用前景。

title: Data Center Load Accommodation under QoS and Checkpoint-Induced Frequency Security Constraints
summary: The rapid growth of artificial intelligence workloads is accelerating the expansion and grid interconnection of data centers (DCs). Existing data center load accommodation (DCLA) assessments primarily focus on grid and resource adequacy and often imply that greater workload flexibility always increases accommodable capacity. However, workload flexibility has a dual effect. Workload deferral and temporal shifting can alleviate network congestion, whereas synchronized checkpointing of training workloads can cause large and rapid load reductions, threatening frequency stability. Therefore, DCLA cannot be determined solely by grid adequacy. This paper develops an optimal DCLA method that jointly accounts for workload quality of service (QoS), checkpoint-induced frequency security (FS), and grid adequacy. First, a QoS-aware model characterizes workload-dependent flexibility while ensuring service feasibility. Second, checkpoint-induced FS constraints are developed for periodic and event-triggered power variations, with key frequency-security limits reformulated in algebraic form. Third, a two-stage lexicographic model is developed to maximize DCLA and minimizes the required energy storage (ES) deployment, and then optimizes system operation under the given DC and ES siting and sizing decisions. Case studies show that the proposed method avoids a 40.3% overestimation of DCLA compared with the grid-adequacy benchmark. QoS is the primary limiting factor, while checkpoint-induced frequency-security constraints become more restrictive as training workloads increase. These findings highlight that reliable DCLA should account for both its grid-support value and the associated QoS and FS risks.

title: Provable Compliance: A Protocol for Runtime Compliance Evidence and Transaction-Specific Decisioning
comments: ChainIT white paper CIT-PC-WP-4.0. 32 pages, 5 figures. Companion paper: Provable Authority. Project page: https://chainit.com/white-papers/
summary: Regulated institutions already perform onboarding, screening, monitoring, and review, but compliance evidence ages, and whether it supports a decision depends on the institution, product, subject, counterparty, transaction, jurisdiction, risk tier, and purpose. A relying party therefore often cannot obtain compact, attributable proof of which evidence, policy, authority, and transaction context were current when a decision was made, a gap that grows as authority is delegated to software agents and scheduled workflows. We describe ChainIT Provable Compliance, the compliance-side layer of the ChainIT Authority Protocol. Each sourced or institution-generated fact is represented as a separate Evidence Assertion VDT with provenance, freshness, confidence, permitted purpose, and privacy classification; a versioned Compliance Policy Profile selects the applicable rules; a Business Rules Engine returns deterministic, reason-coded predicate results; and the organization's configured Workflow Engine composes them into a signed, time-bounded Compliance Decision VDT for one reliance event. The decision contributes a single predicate, Compliance Decision Permits, to session-eligibility and transaction-policy decisions. It never independently authorizes payment: only a final Allow together with an exact transaction digest, atomic capacity reservation, and a single-use execution credential can commit value. The paper specifies point-of-reliance freshness, scoped propagation of evidence changes, decision states, evidence domains (AML, sanctions, PEP, background, identity, and licensing), the U.S. and FATF regulatory context as of August 2026, privacy and disclosure controls, and residual risks.

title: Reward Engine: Reward-Centric Self-Evolution for Open-Ended Tool Agents
summary: Open-ended tool agents can complete the same objective through different tool paths, and their quality depends jointly on the interaction trace, environment state, and final artifacts, so such tasks rarely admit an executable ground-truth reward. The central challenge is therefore to construct a reward from existing experience that exposes the current policy's failures while remaining stationary during optimization. We introduce Reward Engine, which, like a self-motivated student, first works out what success requires and then optimizes toward it. From the task and initial trajectories, it builds a RewardPack of testcases for required correctness and rubrics for graded quality, each executed as a check that returns a judgment with evidence. The frozen RewardPack then guides the agent to revise and select its outputs, and can also serve as a reward for reinforcement learning. On WorkBuddy Bench Office and Claw-Eval, the constructed reward largely agrees with the benchmark graders, not reversing their ordering on 82.3\% and 80.5\% of candidate pairs. Used to revise executions, it raises three-run consistency ($\mathrm{Pass}^{3}$) over Baseline from 45.0\% to 54.0\% and from 78.4\% to 83.7\%.

title: Where's the Indirect Evidence? Investigating Grammatical Generalization with Influence Functions
summary: Language models generalize beyond their training corpus to learn linguistic phenomena (Patil et al., 2024; Misra and Mahowald, 2024), showing that there exists indirect evidence driving learning. Prior work has inferred that indirect evidence exists without identifying its character or considered specific hypotheses about what it might be. We explore an alternative bottom-up method for identifying indirect evidence. We use influence functions (Koh and Liang, 2017) to measure how individual training sentences affect model predictions in 15 grammatical phenomena from BLiMP (Warstadt et al., 2020). We filter out a phenomenon's direct evidence using hand-constructed rules and take the 60,000 most influential remaining sentences as indirect evidence. This indirect evidence substantially affects learning: retraining without it lowers held-out accuracy more than removing a matched random group for every phenomenon across five models (by a median of 12 points). We characterize the indirect evidence by its similarity to our direct evidence filters: it (partially) meets the filters' structural conditions at a median of 4.7 times the rate of a matched random group. Finally, clustering phenomena by indirect-evidence overlap recovers three of the five BLiMP categories that include multiple phenomena, suggesting that this method can reveal linguistic relationships.

title: MaskMerge: Structure-aware Token Merging for Efficient Instance Segmentation
summary: Token merging improves the efficiency of Vision Transformers by combining redundant tokens, but existing methods largely rely on feature similarity to determine which tokens to merge. This criterion is effective for semantic segmentation, yet can fail in instance segmentation, where adjacent objects of the same class often have highly similar features. We identify this failure mode as cross-instance token fusion. We introduce MaskMerge, an instance-aware token merging method that uses coarse intermediate mask predictions to constrain feature-based merging and preserve instance boundaries. We evaluate MaskMerge on two diverse instance segmentation domains characterized by high inter-instance visual similarity: PanNuke and iSAID. Against the SOTA token merging method ALGM, MaskMerge improves mAP from 30.1 to 32.1 on PanNuke while reducing computation from 229 to 153 GFLOPs and running 1.18x faster, and from 33.1 to 36.2 on iSAID while reducing computation from 198 to 182 GFLOPs and running 1.23x faster. Additionally, we also test it on Cityscapes and match ALGM's performance while using fewer FLOPs. The gains also transfer to an MAE pretrained backbone, demonstrating that instance-aware merging enables more aggressive compression when appearance similarity alone cannot reliably preserve object identity.

title: ODSS-Net: Orthogonally Decoupled Shared-Specific Representations for Multi-Modal Object Re-Identification
summary: Multi-modal object re-identification (ReID) leverages complementary information from heterogeneous sensors. Cross-modal alignment and fusion remain challenging. Existing methods mainly reduce modality gaps via feature alignment and fusion. However, alignment may entangle modality-shared structural information with modality-specific cues, while conventional fusion may not fully exploit complementary information. To address these issues, we propose ODSS-Net, a framework for orthogonally decoupled shared-specific representation learning and adaptive fusion of complementary modality-specific features. First, a Shared Structural Feature Construction (SSFC) module suppresses modality-dependent appearance variations and extracts modality-shared structural information. Then, an Orthogonal Specific Feature Learning (OSFL) module aggregates identity-relevant local information and removes the shared-aligned component via geometric orthogonal projection. Finally, a Sample Adaptive Mixture of Experts (SAMoE) module uses the shared structure as routing context to adaptively refine and fuse modality-specific features. Experiments on three benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of ODSS-Net for multi-modal object ReID.

title: Sep-Latent: Separator Tokens as Natural Compression Anchors for Implicit Reasoning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable success in complex reasoning through explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT), but the associated computational overhead and token verbosity remain significant barriers to efficiency. While implicit reasoning in continuous latent spaces offers a promising alternative, existing methods like Coconut and CODI often rely on fixed-length latent sequences and suffer from representational collapse. In this paper, we propose Sep-Latent, an adaptive implicit reasoning framework that utilizes separator tokens as structural semantic anchors. By introducing an Attention-Decay mechanism, we force the model to aggregate and compress reasoning logic into these anchors during training. We then align explicit and implicit pathways through multi-level distillation across all layers to ensure logical consistency. Crucially, Sep-Latent enables dynamic reasoning depth by adaptively terminating the latent thinking phase based on query complexity. Experimental results on the GSM8k-Aug benchmark show that Sep-Latent achieves an accuracy of 56.8\% with an average of only 5.4 tokens, significantly outperforming prior fixed-length implicit models in efficiency while narrowing the performance gap with explicit CoT. Further analysis via PCA and symbolic variant testing confirms that our method ensures semantic grounding and exhibits superior robustness to perturbations.

title: Scalable Levenberg-Marquardt Training Framework for Deep Learning
summary: The Levenberg-Marquardt (LMA) algorithm is a widely used nonlinear least-squares solver known for its rapid convergence. For small-scale neural networks, LMA provides better convergence and architectural robustness than first-order optimizers like Adam. However, LMA imposes prohibitive memory and computational costs. These costs are primarily from the Jacobian matrix, whose dimensions scale with both the number of samples and parameters. This bottleneck prevents its use in large-scale neural networks. Recent efforts scale LMA using preconditioned conjugate gradient (PCG) solvers to avoid materializing the Jacobian. However, PCG only approximates the solution, requiring many network propagations and a task-specific preconditioner. Other studies optimize LMA to reduce costs, but they restrict their methods to specific tasks or network architectures. As a result, LMA remains impractical for training general large-scale neural networks. In this paper, we propose LeMA, a distributed LMA algorithm for large-scale neural network training on multi-GPU platforms. Our contributions are twofold: First, an exact dual formulation of LMA removes the memory dependence on the parameter dimension. Second, a Jacobian sharding strategy computes Jacobian shards on the fly and in parallel to avoid materializing the full Jacobian. For large-scale neural networks, LeMA reduces the memory footprint of LMA from quadratic in the number of parameters to quadratic in the batch size. This makes exact LMA steps feasible for billion-parameter models without approximate PCG solves. Furthermore, for a convolutional neural network with 1,000,022,632 parameters on an 8-GPU node, LeMA achieves a 7.97x speedup over a single GPU, corresponding to a 99.7% strong scaling efficiency.

title: Multiple Turns, Short Horizons: Measuring Effective-Horizon Compression in Jailbreaks
summary: Multi-turn jailbreaks use feedback from a victim large language model to adapt their queries over several turns. However, once an effective trajectory has been found, it is unclear how much of the earlier query history is still needed. In this work, we study this by removing early attacker queries and running the remaining queries again in a new conversation while regenerating the victim's responses. We define the effective horizon as the shortest remaining query sequence that recovers the same attack progress. Empirically, we find that roughly half of the original query sequence is sufficient on average to recover the same attack progress. We call this phenomenon effective-horizon compression. We show that this shorter history can recover the best point reached during an unsuccessful attack and provide a better starting point for continuing the attack. It also helps identify which earlier queries should receive less learning signal during attacker training, and downweighting those queries improves performance. We further find that short reward-propagation windows preserve calibrated defense performance close to full-trajectory returns. These results show that multi-turn attacks can contain more queries than are needed to recover the progress reached later in the interaction.

title: DICL-Qwen3VL: Decoupled Confidence Calibration for Interpretable Workwear Detection
summary: Poor illumination and occlusion obscure clothing cues in indoor work sites, while diverse clothing styles complicate workwear compliance judgments. Although vision-language models (VLMs) support localization and semantic reasoning, their predictions often lack explicit supporting evidence, and a single confidence score cannot distinguish visual uncertainty from ambiguity in compliance judgments. We propose DICL-Qwen3VL, a decoupled interpretable VLM that integrates structured workwear detection, evidence generation, and separate visual and reasoning confidence estimates. First, low-rank adaptation (LoRA) adapts Qwen3-VL to localize visible upper-body clothing and identify workwear. Second, decoupled calibration separates visual observations from compliance reasoning and assigns a confidence score to each. Token entropy and sensitivity to image perturbations provide supervision for visual confidence, linking confidence estimation to the generated observations and their dependence on image content. Finally, group relative policy optimization (GRPO) jointly optimizes detection accuracy, output validity, and confidence calibration. Experiments on the company-collected Indoor Construction Site Workwear Dataset (ICSWD) and the web-collected Indoor Construction Workwear Dataset (WICWD) yield mAP@50 values of 0.730 and 0.753, respectively, outperforming the evaluated LoRA-adapted VLM baselines, including Qwen3-VL. The framework also provides explicit evidence and separate confidence scores to support manual review in industrial safety monitoring. WICWD is publicly available at https://github.com/DaErwen1/WICWD.

title: Gaussian Identification in MIMO Channels
summary: We study the identification capacity of discrete-time Gaussian multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) channels under per-antenna, per-symbol peak-amplitude constraints. We establish upper and lower bounds on the identification capacity that scale linearly with the channel rank $r.$ The number of reliably identifiable messages can grow super-exponentially with blocklength $n,$ following $M_n(R)=2^{(n\log n)R},$ where $R$ is an achievable rate. The channel rank provides a spatial-multiplexing advantage, enabling higher achievable rates and, consequently, stronger super-exponential codebook growth. These results characterize the rank-dependent gain in achievable identification performance.

AI.title_translation: MIMO信道中的高斯辨识
AI.tldr: 本文研究了峰值受限高斯MIMO信道的辨识容量，证明消息规模可呈超指数增长，且辨识性能随信道秩线性提升。
AI.motivation: 探究在逐天线、逐符号峰值幅度约束下，离散时间高斯MIMO信道的辨识容量特性及其与信道空间维数（秩）的关系。
AI.method: 理论推导与界估计方法（在单天线单符号峰值约束下推导辨识容量的上下界；具体证明技术在摘要中未提及）。
AI.result: 推导出了与信道秩 $r$ 呈线性缩放的辨识容量上下界；证明了可靠辨识消息数可随块长 $n$ 呈超指数级增长（$M_n(R)=2^{(n\log n)R}$），且信道秩提供了显著提升辨识速率的空间复用增益。
AI.conclusion: 本文揭示了信道秩能够为高斯MIMO信道下的消息辨识提供空间复用增益，显著提高辨识的可达速率并实现更强的超指数级码本规模增长。
AI.translation: 我们研究了在逐天线、逐符号峰值幅度约束下，离散时间高斯多输入多输出（MIMO）信道的辨识容量。我们建立了辨识容量的上下界，该界与信道秩 $r$ 呈线性缩放。可靠可辨识的消息数量可随块长 $n$ 呈超指数增长，满足 $M_n(R)=2^{(n\log n)R}$，其中 $R$ 为可达速率。信道秩提供了空间复用优势，能够实现更高的可达速率，从而带来更强的超指数码本增长。这些结果刻画了可达辨识性能中与秩相关的增益。
AI.summary: 本论文研究了逐天线、逐符号峰值幅度限制下的离散时间高斯MIMO信道辨识容量。研究建立了随信道秩线性扩展的辨识容量上下界，证明了消息规模随块长呈超指数增长，并阐明了信道秩作为空间复用增益对辨识速率和码本规模增长的决定性作用。
AI.keywords: 高斯MIMO信道, 辨识容量, 信道秩, 空间复用增益, 峰值幅度约束
AI.comments: 本研究的重要创新在于将Ahlswede和Dueck的辨识理论拓展到了具有实际物理约束（单天线、单符号峰值幅度约束）的高斯MIMO信道，揭示了空间复用增益（信道秩）不仅影响传统传输容量，还能在线性尺度上直接增强辨识容量中的超指数增长率。其局限在于摘要中未给出闭式容量而仅提供了上下界，具体的可达码构建方案在摘要中亦未详述。

title: Ego2Contact: Predicting Touch from Egocentric Human Video for Contact-Rich Robot Manipulation
summary: Contact locations and interaction forces are critical for contact-rich robot manipulation but are often ambiguous from vision alone. Measuring them on robots requires specialized tactile hardware and platform-specific data collection, which keeps robot tactile data scarce. Human egocentric video is far easier to scale but lacks touch. Recent predictors trained on egocentric recordings paired with tactile-glove measurements can predict this missing signal from video alone. These predictors, however, remain confined to human hands, which differ from robot hands in appearance and tactile layout. We present Ego2Contact, which learns a visual-tactile prior from human interactions and transfers it to robot hands. Its predictor fuses temporal scene context with hand-local visual features to infer bimanual tactile fields from the RGB video. Anatomical region correspondences align varying robot tactile layouts with the predictor's canonical grid, turning robot measurements into fine-tuning targets and predictions into policy inputs. Ego2Contact outperforms prior tactile predictors on human data, including unseen objects, and on robot data after adaptation. The adapted predictor provides tactile inputs for both simulated reinforcement learning and real-robot policy post-training. In simulation, policies using predicted touch outperform non-tactile baselines and recover part of the benefit of ground-truth tactile sensing. These results show that human-learned tactile priors can supply touch when direct tactile sensing is limited.

AI.title_translation: Ego2Contact：从第一人称人类视频预测触觉以用于富接触机器人操作
AI.tldr: Ego2Contact 通过从人类第一人称视频中学习视觉-触觉先验，并利用解剖对齐迁移至机器人，实现仅从RGB视频预测触觉信号以辅助机器人操作。
AI.motivation: 富接触机器人操作高度依赖接触位置和交互力，但仅靠视觉难以准确推断，而依靠物理触觉硬件采集机器人数据成本高昂且数据稀缺。人类第一人称视频易于规模化获取却缺乏触觉信号，且现有基于人手视频的触觉预测器因人手与机械手外观和传感器布局差异无法直接迁移到机器人。
AI.method: 提出 Ego2Contact 框架：1）结合时序场景上下文与手部局部视觉特征，仅从 RGB 视频推断双手的触觉场；2）通过解剖区域对应关系将不同形态的机器人触觉布局对齐到预测器的规范网格中，将机器人实际测量值作为微调目标，并将预测触觉作为策略输入，支持仿真强化学习与真机策略训练。
AI.result: Ego2Contact 在人类测试数据（包括未见物体）及自适应后的机器人数据上的触觉预测表现均优于先前基线；在仿真强化学习中，采用预测触觉的策略表现显著优于无触觉基线，并能恢复真实触觉传感器带来的部分性能优势；成功为真实机器人策略后训练提供了有效的触觉输入。
AI.conclusion: 从人类交互中学习到的触觉先验能够在机器人直接触觉感知受限或缺失时，通过视频准确推断触觉信息并有效提升富接触操作策略的表现。
AI.translation: 接触位置和交互力对于富接触机器人操作至关重要，但通常难以仅凭视觉明确推断。在机器人上测量它们需要专门的触觉硬件和平台专用的数据采集，导致机器人触觉数据极为稀缺。人类第一人称视频更易于规模化拓展，但缺乏触觉数据。近期在第一人称记录与触觉手套测量配对数据上训练的预测器，能够仅从视频中预测这种缺失的信号。然而，这些预测器仍局限于人手，而人手与机械手在外观和触觉布局上均存在差异。我们提出了 Ego2Contact，它从人类交互中学习视觉-触觉先验并将其迁移到机械手上。其预测器融合了时序场景上下文与手部局部视觉特征，以从 RGB 视频中推断双手触觉场。解剖区域对应关系将不同的机器人触觉布局与预测器的规范网格对齐，从而将机器人测量值转化为微调目标，并将预测结果转化为策略输入。Ego2Contact 在人类数据（包括未见过的物体）以及自适应后的机器人数据上均优于先前的触觉预测器。自适应后的预测器可为仿真强化学习和真实机器人策略后训练提供触觉输入。在仿真中，使用预测触觉的策略优于无触觉基线，并恢复了真实触觉传感带来的部分优势。这些结果表明，当直接触觉感知受限时，从人类学习到的触觉先验可以提供触觉信息。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 Ego2Contact，一种利用人类第一人称视频预测触觉信号并迁移至机器人的方法。该方法从 RGB 视频中融合时序与手部特征以推断触觉场，并借助解剖区域映射对齐异构机器人触觉布局。实验证明其在触觉预测及辅助仿真与真机富接触操作策略方面均表现优异。
AI.keywords: 第一人称视频, 触觉预测, 机器人操作, 视觉-触觉先验, 强化学习
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地构建了一种将人类第一人称视觉中学习到的触觉先验迁移至机器人手的方法，通过解剖区域对齐机制巧妙克服了人手与机械手在外观及传感器布局上的物理形态差异，缓解了机器人触觉数据匮乏的核心痛点。不过，方法的性能依然依赖于从视频中准确推断交互力与接触，若遇到严重遮挡或与人手形态差异过大的异构夹爪，其迁移效果可能会受限。

title: ASR-Style Transcript Normalization Removes Useful Pragmatic Signal for Dialogue Act Classification
summary: Automatic speech recognition (ASR) pipelines often normalize transcripts by removing filled pauses and punctuation and expanding colloquial forms, potentially discarding cues useful for dialogue act classification. We evaluate nine transcript conditions across six classifiers (TF-IDF logistic regression, RoBERTa, BERT, ALBERT, GPT-2, and BiLSTM) and three conversational corpora (Switchboard, ICSI MRDA, and SLUE-HVB), supplemented by multi-seed experiments, normalization controls, and real-ASR evaluations. Across five random seeds, heavy normalization reduces Macro-F1 in all 15 neural model-corpus combinations under the original preprocessing protocols. Removal using the original filler and backchannel lexicon consistently degrades performance on MRDA and SLUE-HVB but produces mixed effects on Switchboard. Punctuation-aware TF-IDF experiments show that punctuation removal reduces Macro-F1 by 0.036 on Switchboard and 0.078 on MRDA, demonstrating that the original linear baseline's apparent insensitivity resulted from tokenization. Restricting filler removal to um, uh, and erm preserves degradation on MRDA but largely eliminates the SLUE-HVB effect, where the original lexicon removes class-defining backchannel expressions. These findings demonstrate that normalization effects depend on preprocessing definitions, feature extraction, and conversational context, supporting task-dependent rather than indiscriminate transcript normalization.

AI.title_translation: ASR风格的转录文本规范化会消除对对话行为分类有用的语用信号
AI.tldr: 研究表明ASR流水线中去除标点和填充词等规范化预处理会严重损耗语用信息，从而降低对话行为分类性能，倡导采用任务依赖的规范化策略。
AI.motivation: 自动语音识别（ASR）流程常通过移除填充停顿、标点符号及展开口语表达来对转录文本进行规范化，这种做法可能会丢弃对对话行为分类有用的语用线索。
AI.method: 评估了9种转录文本规范化条件在6种分类器（TF-IDF逻辑回归、RoBERTa、BERT、ALBERT、GPT-2和BiLSTM）以及3个对话语料库（Switchboard、ICSI MRDA和SLUE-HVB）上的表现，并结合多随机种子实验、规范化对照实验和真实ASR评估进行分析。
AI.result: 重度规范化使全部15种神经模型-语料库组合的Macro-F1均出现下降；移除填充词和反馈表达词汇在MRDA和SLUE-HVB上持续降低性能，在Switchboard上效果不一；感知标点的TF-IDF实验显示，移除标点使Switchboard和MRDA的Macro-F1分别下降0.036和0.078；仅将填充词移除限制在“um、uh、erm”时，MRDA仍受损，但SLUE-HVB的负面影响基本消除。
AI.conclusion: ASR文本规范化的影响取决于预处理定义、特征提取和会话语境，因此在对话处理中应根据下游具体任务进行定制化规范化，而非盲目套用一刀切的清洗流程。
AI.translation: 自动语音识别（ASR）流水线通常通过移除填充停顿和标点符号以及展开口语形式来规范化转录文本，这可能会丢弃对对话行为分类有用的线索。我们评估了9种转录文本条件在6种分类器（TF-IDF逻辑回归、RoBERTa、BERT、ALBERT、GPT-2和BiLSTM）和3个对话语料库（Switchboard、ICSI MRDA和SLUE-HVB）中的表现，并辅以多随机种子实验、规范化对照和真实ASR评估。在5个随机种子下，按照原始预处理协议，重度规范化使全部15个神经模型-语料库组合的Macro-F1均发生下降。使用原始填充词和反馈表达（backchannel）词表进行移除会持续降低MRDA和SLUE-HVB上的性能，但在Switchboard上产生了不一致的效果。感知标点的TF-IDF实验表明，移除标点会使Switchboard上的Macro-F1降低0.036，在MRDA上降低0.078，这证明原始线性基线表现出的不敏感性源自其分词方式。将填充词移除范围限制为“um、uh和erm”时，MRDA上的性能退化得以保留，但基本消除了SLUE-HVB上的影响，因为原始词表移除了定义类别的反馈表达。这些发现表明，规范化效应取决于预处理定义、特征提取和会话语境，支持任务依赖型而非无差别的转录文本规范化。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了ASR文本规范化对对话行为分类的影响。通过在三大对话语料库及六种分类器上的广泛实验，作者发现移除标点和填充词等规范化操作普遍降低了分类性能，证明这些被清洗掉的成分包含重要的语用信号，主张针对下游任务采用任务依赖的转录规范化策略。
AI.keywords: ASR文本规范化, 对话行为分类, 填充词, 标点符号, 语用信号
AI.comments: 该研究系统揭示了ASR标准文本规范化（如去除标点、填充词及展开口语缩写）对下游对话行为分类带来的负面影响。其重要性在于指出了跨语音与文本NLP任务时，简单套用标准文本清洗流程会造成关键语用信息的丢失，强调了在语音驱动的下游任务中采用任务感知（task-dependent）而非盲目预处理策略的必要性。

title: Many Biases, One Circuit: Post-Training Tunes a Pretrained Cue-Routing Mechanism
summary: Language models often abandon a correct answer when the prompt contains a cue, a hint toward a wrong option such as "I think the answer is B." Sycophancy and related biases show this failure. They are often studied separately and blamed on alignment. We test this view causally, tracing the attention heads behind these biases through the stages of two post-training pipelines. In multiple-choice tests on most models, four cue types rely largely on the same few heads, a shared circuit already present in pretrained models. Most base models follow cues in plain text. Fine-tuning a base model on about 200 generic assistant examples without cues activates these heads in chat format, so cue-following can be a side effect of assistant tuning. The final reinforcement learning (RL) stage strengthens the effect of cues in almost every comparison. In Tulu-3-8B and OLMo-2-7B, we swap the attention patterns of six middle layers between the RL checkpoint and its predecessor. For suggested-answer cues, this shifts each checkpoint's cue effect most of the way to the other's level. Post-training thus seems to change when and how strongly models use this circuit. Mitigation for these multiple-choice biases could target this circuit.

AI.title_translation: 多种偏差，单一回路：后训练微调了预训练的线索路由机制
AI.tldr: 语言模型中的阿谀奉承等偏差源于预训练阶段即存在的共享注意力回路，后训练只是激活并强化了该机制。
AI.motivation: 语言模型在提示包含错误倾向线索时常会放弃正确答案（如阿谀奉承等偏差），以往研究多将其割裂看待并简单归咎于对齐训练，缺乏对其底层注意力回路演化机制的因果性分析。
AI.method: 因果追踪两个后训练流程各阶段负责线索响应的注意力头；分析4种线索类型对应的回路重合度；在无提示线索的通用助手数据上微调基座模型；并在强化学习（RL）检查点与前序检查点之间互换中间6层的注意力模式以验证因果效应。
AI.result: 在多数模型的多选题测试中，4种线索类型共享极少数相同的注意力头（该回路在预训练模型中已存在）；仅用约200条无诱导线索的通用助手样本微调基座模型，即可在对话格式下激活该回路；随后的RL阶段普遍放大了线索效应；交换RL与前序检查点的6个中间层注意力模式可直接将线索效应大幅转移至对方水平。
AI.conclusion: 后训练并没有重新创造偏差机制，而是调整了模型在何时以及以多大强度调用预训练期即存在的线索路由回路；因此，针对该共享注意力回路进行干预是缓解相关选择题偏差的有效途径。
AI.translation: 当提示中包含暗示错误选项的线索（例如“我认为答案是B”）时，语言模型通常会放弃正确答案。阿谀奉承（Sycophancy）及相关偏差体现了这一缺陷。它们通常被分开独立研究，并被归咎于对齐。我们通过因果方式检验这一观点，在两个后训练流水线的各阶段追踪这些偏差背后的注意力头。在多数模型的单选测试中，四种线索类型在很大程度上依赖相同的少数注意力头——即一个在预训练模型中就已存在的共享回路。大多数基座模型在纯文本格式下就会遵循线索。在约200个不含线索的通用助手示例上微调基座模型，便会在对话格式中激活这些注意力头，因此线索依从可能是助手微调的副作用。最后的强化学习（RL）阶段在几乎所有对比中都增强了线索效应。在Tulu-3-8B和OLMo-2-7B中，我们交换了RL检查点与其前序检查点之间六个中间层的注意力模式。对于建议答案线索，这种交换使每个检查点的线索效应大部分转移到了对方的水平。因此，后训练似乎改变了模型使用该回路的时机和强度。针对这些单选题偏差的缓解手段可以直接作用于该回路。
AI.summary: 本文研究了语言模型受提示线索误导产生错误（如阿谀奉承）的底层机理。研究发现多种偏差共用同一套在预训练阶段就已存在的线索路由注意力回路。后训练过程（SFT与RL）并未新建机制，只是改变了该回路的激活条件与响应强度，交换关键层的注意力模式可直接转移偏差效应，为偏差缓解提供了明确靶点。
AI.keywords: 阿谀奉承偏差, 注意力回路, 机制可解释性, 后训练, 强化学习
AI.comments: 本研究的重要创新在于推翻了“阿谀奉承等偏差是因对齐训练而凭空产生”的常见看法，从机理可解释性角度证明了这些偏差共享预训练期就存在的单一注意力回路。实验设计具有严密的因果逻辑，通过层交换操作为机制溯源提供了坚实证据。局限性在于其验证主要基于多项选择题任务，在复杂的开放式长文本生成或多轮交互中的表现仍有待进一步拓展检验。

title: Beyond Surface Cues: Robust LLM-Generated Korean Text Detection
summary: As large language models (LLMs) generate increasingly fluent text, the need for reliable detection of LLM-generated content has grown substantially. However, existing research remains heavily English-centric, leaving Korean largely underexplored. Moreover, current evaluations of Korean text detection often rely on superficial cues, leading to overly optimistic estimates of detection performance. To address these limitations, we introduce \textsc{KoLing}, a bias-controlled adversarial benchmark comprising 50.9k instances that suppresses superficial shortcuts while preserving semantic content and separately evaluates LLM-generated and LLM-modified text detection. We further propose KoLingProbe, an interpretable detector grounded in theoretical linguistics that models Korean-specific properties across multiple linguistic levels. Experiments show that KoLingProbe substantially outperforms strong baselines on all detection tasks while remaining robust to adversarial attacks. Our analyses further reveal that integrating complementary linguistic features across multiple levels yields both improved performance and interpretability.

AI.title_translation: 超越表面线索：鲁棒的大语言模型生成韩语文本检测
AI.tldr: 本文提出了消除表面线索偏差的韩语检测基准KoLing以及基于多层级语言学特征的可解释检测器KoLingProbe，显著提升了韩语LLM生成文本检测的性能与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM生成内容检测主要集中在英语领域，韩语研究严重不足；且现有的韩语文本检测评估往往依赖表面线索，导致对其检测性能的估计过于乐观。
AI.method: 1. 提出偏差受控的对抗性基准KoLing（包含50.9k个样本），抑制表面快捷方式并保留语义内容，分别评测LLM生成和LLM修改文本；2. 提出基于理论语言学的可解释检测器KoLingProbe，在多个语言层级对韩语特有属性进行建模。
AI.result: KoLingProbe在所有检测任务中均大幅超越强基线模型，对对抗攻击表现出强鲁棒性，且分析表明跨多层级整合互补语言特征能兼顾性能与可解释性的提升。
AI.conclusion: 跨多个语言层级整合互补的语言特征，能够有效克服表面捷径偏差，显著提升韩语LLM生成及修改文本检测的准确率、鲁棒性与可解释性。
AI.translation: 随着大语言模型（LLM）生成的文本日益流畅，可靠检测LLM生成内容的需求大幅增加。然而，现有研究仍严重以英语为中心，使得韩语领域大部分未被充分探索。此外，当前对韩语文本检测的评估往往依赖表面线索，导致对检测性能产生过于乐观的估计。为了解决这些局限性，我们引入了KoLing，这是一个包含50.9k个实例的偏差受控对抗性基准，它在抑制表面快捷方式的同时保留了语义内容，并分别对LLM生成和LLM修改文本的检测进行评估。我们进一步提出了KoLingProbe，一种基于理论语言学的可解释检测器，能够跨多个语言层面对韩语特有属性进行建模。实验表明，KoLingProbe在所有检测任务上均显著优于强大的基线模型，同时对对抗攻击保持鲁棒。我们的分析进一步表明，跨多个层级整合互补的语言特征可以同时提高性能和可解释性。
AI.summary: 本文针对韩语LLM文本检测受限于英语中心化以及表面线索导致评估虚高的问题，构建了包含50.9k样本的对抗去偏基准KoLing，并提出了基于理论语言学建模韩语多层级特性的可解释检测器KoLingProbe。实验表明该检测器在多项任务中显著优于强基线，且兼具高鲁棒性与可解释性。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 文本检测, 韩语NLP, 对抗基准, 可解释性
AI.comments: 本研究填补了非英语语言（特别是韩语）在LLM生成文本检测领域的显著空白。其核心亮点在于指出现有评估依赖“表面捷径”导致性能虚高的问题，并通过构建去偏对抗基准和融合多层级理论语言学特征的检测器，同时提升了检测的鲁棒性、泛化能力与可解释性。

title: Aligning Language Models Towards Counterfactual Invariance
summary: Small variations in prompt characteristics can meaningfully alter the semantics, tone, and contextual assumptions of large language model outputs. Such characteristics can involve group variables such as demographics or other sensitive latent attributes. Sensitivity to such input variables is undesirable when demographic information is causally irrelevant to the task, but might still be relevant for generation of semantically coherent responses. This makes the task of enforcing counterfactual invariance while preserving model utility difficult. To study this problem, we first show that standard model alignment recipes (such as reinforcement learning) increase differences in response quality across demographics, while improving overall response quality, ultimately amplifying what is known as counterfactual bias. To address this, we develop a policy gradient technique involving a group-level reward function that operates on matched pairs of counterfactual prompts. For completeness, we build a dataset of controlled counterfactual prompt pairs and design an evaluation that separately measures cases where demographic information is causally relevant to the answer. Finally, we validate our findings on several fairness benchmarks. We demonstrate that our methods reduce counterfactual differences while preserving overall response quality and that the models continue to adapt appropriately when such sensitive information is relevant.

AI.title_translation: 面向反事实不变性对齐语言模型
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种利用反事实提示对进行群体级奖励优化的策略梯度方法，有效解决了标准对齐技术加剧反事实偏见的问题，兼顾了公平性与模型效用。
AI.motivation: 标准对齐算法（如强化学习）在提高总体质量的同时会放大不同人口属性之间的质量差异（即加剧反事实偏见），而在因果无关时消除偏见且在因果相关时保留语义连贯性与适应性十分困难。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于群体级奖励函数的策略梯度技术，该函数作用于成对匹配的反事实提示；构建了受控反事实提示对数据集，并设计了能够独立测量人口信息因果相关场景的评估方法。
AI.result: 在多个公平性基准上的实验表明，该方法在减少反事实差异的同时保留了整体生成质量，且在敏感信息确实具有因果相关性时，模型依然能够做出恰当的自适应调整。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，所提出的群体级奖励策略梯度方法能够有效减少语言模型中的反事实偏见，在确保反事实不变性的同时不牺牲模型的整体效用与合法的因果相关适应能力。
AI.translation: 提示词特征的微小变化可能会显著改变大型语言模型输出的语义、语气和上下文假设。这些特征可能涉及诸如人口统计学或其他敏感潜在属性等群体变量。当人口统计信息与任务在因果上无关时，对这些输入变量的敏感性是不可取的，但对于生成语义连贯的回复而言，此类信息可能仍然是相关的。这使得在保持模型效用的同时强制实现反事实不变性变得极为困难。为了研究这一问题，我们首先证明了标准的模型对齐方案（例如强化学习）在提高整体回复质量的同时，会拉大不同人口群体之间的回复质量差异，最终加剧了所谓的反事实偏见。为了解决这个问题，我们开发了一种策略梯度技术，该技术涉及一个作用于成对匹配的反事实提示的群体级奖励函数。为了研究的完整性，我们构建了一个受控反事实提示对的数据集，并设计了一种评估方法，专门独立测量人口统计信息对答案具有因果相关性的情况。最后，我们在几个公平性基准上验证了我们的发现。我们证明了我们的方法在减少反事实差异的同时保持了整体回复质量，并且模型在敏感信息相关时仍能继续适当地调整。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了语言模型在提示词包含敏感属性时的反事实偏见问题。研究发现标准对齐方案会加剧群体间的质量差异。为此，作者提出了一种利用匹配反事实提示对和群体级奖励的策略梯度对齐方法，并构建了专门的测试集与评估机制。实验证实该方法能有效降低反事实偏见，并兼顾模型整体表现与对因果相关属性的响应能力。
AI.keywords: 反事实不变性, 模型对齐, 策略梯度, 公平性, 强化学习
AI.comments: 该论文指出了现有基于强化学习的对齐方法在提升性能时会无意中加剧反事实偏见的负面效应，具有重要的现实预警意义。其核心创新在于设计了基于成对反事实样本的群体级奖励函数，并巧妙地区分了人口属性在任务中“因果相关”与“因果无关”的场景，避免了一刀切式的去偏导致模型语义适应能力的丧失。

title: When Core-Network Elements Become Reachable: Field-Level Exploitability Analysis in Diameter
summary: The increasing exposure of cellular core-network elements to public networks has turned Diameter signaling interfaces into a practical attack surface. While large language models (LLMs) show promise for protocol exploitability analysis, we find that their judgments on Diameter can be unreliable because they may deviate from the tacit analysis discipline followed by security experts and reach conclusions without considering complete protocol evidence. To address this challenge, we present LENS, an LLM-based system for reliable field-level Diameter exploitability analysis. LENS guides LLMs using both exploitability-analysis discipline and the protocol evidence needed for analysis. It infers analysis discipline from existing exploit writeups and evidence-collection guidance from exploitability-analysis failures, enabling systematic evidence collection, exploitability assessment, and proof-of-concept (PoC) attack generation when applicable. Our experiments show that LENS performs reliable analysis across four LLMs and repeated runs, achieving mean recall of 94.00% to 98.00%, precision of 78.73% to 88.94%, and accuracy of 84.00% to 92.00%. We find that more than 25% of field paths in the S6a and Cx interfaces are exploitable under the considered threat model. We further assess their impact on practical implementations and uncover 95 previously unknown vulnerabilities, including 17 in open-source EPC/IMS implementations and 78 in commercial deployments, causing service disruption, information leakage, subscriber tracking, and accelerated battery depletion. Applying LENS to 16 additional protocols spanning cellular, network, industrial, and host-internal systems uncovers 118 previously unknown vulnerabilities, demonstrating its strong generalizability.

AI.title_translation: 当核心网网元变得可达时：Diameter 协议中的字段级可利用性分析
AI.tldr: 本文提出了基于大语言模型的系统 LENS，通过融入专家分析规范与证据收集指导，实现了可靠的字段级 Diameter 协议及其他协议的漏洞与可利用性分析。
AI.motivation: 蜂窝核心网网元暴露于公共网络使 Diameter 接口成为现实攻击面。现有 LLM 虽有潜力，但在分析 Diameter 时容易偏离安全专家的隐性分析规范且缺乏完整证据链，导致评估结果不可靠。
AI.method: 提出了 LENS 系统，该系统从现有的漏洞分析报告中推断分析规范，并从历史分析失败案例中推断证据收集指导，以此引导 LLM 进行系统化的协议证据收集、字段级可利用性评估及概念验证（PoC）攻击生成。
AI.result: LENS 在 4 款 LLM 上取得了 94.00%-98.00% 的召回率和 84.00%-92.00% 的准确率；发现 S6a 和 Cx 接口超 25% 的字段路径可被利用；在实际实现中挖掘出 95 个未知漏洞（17 个开源、78 个商用），并在拓展的另外 16 种协议中发现了 118 个新漏洞。
AI.conclusion: LENS 系统成功解决了大语言模型在协议漏洞分析中由于缺乏隐性规范和证据不足导致的不可靠问题，能够准确评估协议字段级可利用性，并具备出色的跨协议漏洞挖掘泛化能力。
AI.translation: 蜂窝核心网网元日益暴露于公共网络，使得 Diameter 信令接口成为了现实中的攻击面。尽管大语言模型（LLM）在协议可利用性分析中展现出应用前景，但我们发现它们对 Diameter 的判定可能并不可靠，原因在于它们可能偏离安全专家遵循的隐性分析规范，并在缺乏完整协议证据的情况下得出结论。为了解决这一挑战，我们提出了 LENS，一个基于 LLM 的可靠字段级 Diameter 可利用性分析系统。LENS 利用可利用性分析规范以及分析所需的协议证据来指导 LLM。它从现有的漏洞分析文章中推断分析规范，并从可利用性分析失败案例中推断证据收集指导，从而实现系统化的证据收集、可利用性评估以及在适用时生成概念验证（PoC）攻击。我们的实验表明，LENS 在四种 LLM 和多次运行中均表现出可靠的分析能力，平均召回率达到 94.00% 至 98.00%，精确率达到 78.73% 至 88.94%，准确率达到 84.00% 至 92.00%。我们发现，在所考虑的威胁模型下，S6a 和 Cx 接口中超过 25% 的字段路径是可被利用的。我们进一步评估了其对实际实现的影响，发现了 95 个此前未知的漏洞，其中包括开源 EPC/IMS 实现中的 17 个漏洞和商业部署中的 78 个漏洞，这些漏洞会导致服务中断、信息泄露、用户跟踪和加速电池消耗。将 LENS 应用于涵盖蜂窝、网络、工业和主机内部系统的其他 16 种协议，发现了 118 个此前未知的漏洞，证明了其强大的通用性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了结合专家分析规范与协议证据指导的 LLM 漏洞分析系统 LENS。该系统解决了大模型缺乏协议分析上下文与推导逻辑的问题，实现了高精度的 Diameter 字段级可利用性评估与 PoC 生成，并在核心网商用系统及多种外部协议中挖掘出大量未公开高危漏洞。
AI.keywords: Diameter 协议, 大语言模型, 核心网安全, 可利用性分析, 漏洞挖掘
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于识别并解决了大模型在协议安全性分析中缺乏专家隐式分析逻辑和完整证据链的问题，通过规范推断与失败引导的证据收集，显著降低了大模型的误判率；其在实际核心网及其他多种网络/系统协议中挖掘出数百个未知漏洞，展现了极强的实用安全价值与泛化能力。

title: Large Diffusion Models Need More Than EMA
summary: Large-scale diffusion models are commonly trained with a constant learning rate (LR) and exponential moving average (EMA), despite the strong performance of LR decay and Schedule-Free optimization in training large language models. We study whether EMA is uniquely suited to diffusion training, or whether stronger alternatives have been underexplored. Our theory shows that averaging a constant-step trajectory has an inherent optimization limitation, whereas LR decay and Schedule-Free optimization admit vanishing stationarity guarantees under standard nonconvex assumptions. Empirically, LR decay and EMA provide complementary benefits: combining decay with EMA further improves the standard baseline at most tested starting points, although the gain remains sensitive to when decay begins. Schedule-Free avoids this timing requirement and consistently outperforms EMA with a constant LR across training stages, achieving both lower fixed-evaluation objectives and better generation quality. Our analysis further shows that all three strategies substantially reduce parameter variability, yet stronger stabilization is not always better: EMA with a constant LR retains comparatively higher parameter variability, while aggressive decay combined with EMA achieves the lowest checkpoint variability but also weakens continued optimization. Schedule-Free substantially reduces parameter variability while preserving more late-stage progress, providing a better balance between parameter stability and continued optimization. Finally, the benefits of Schedule-Free extend beyond pretraining to ReFL and generator-side DMD, demonstrating its transferability across distinct diffusion optimization settings. Overall, our results suggest that large diffusion models need more than parameter averaging alone: effective optimization requires balancing variance reduction with continued optimization.

AI.title_translation: 大型扩散模型需要的不仅仅是EMA
AI.tldr: 大型扩散模型仅依赖常数学习率和EMA存在优化局限，引入Schedule-Free优化或学习率衰减能够更好地平衡方差缩减与后期持续优化，显著提升生成质量和优化表现。
AI.motivation: 尽管学习率衰减和Schedule-Free优化在大型语言模型中表现优异，但大型扩散模型普遍仍使用常数学习率与EMA进行训练。研究旨在探究EMA是否是扩散模型最适合的优化方式，抑或存在未被充分探索的更优替代方案。
AI.method: 理论上证明常数步长EMA轨迹平均的优化局限，以及学习率衰减和Schedule-Free在非凸条件下的渐近稳定性保证；实证上对比了常数学习率+EMA、学习率衰减+EMA和Schedule-Free在扩散模型预训练、ReFL和生成器端DMD任务中的优化表现与参数变异性。
AI.result: 学习率衰减与EMA具有互补效果，二者结合优于标准基线但对衰减启动时机敏感；Schedule-Free无需设定衰减时机，在所有阶段持续优于常数学习率+EMA，带来更低的评估目标与更优的生成质量；Schedule-Free兼顾了降低参数变异性与维持后期优化进展的平衡，且该优势可迁移至ReFL和DMD。
AI.conclusion: 大型扩散模型需要的不仅是单纯的参数平均，有效的优化需要在参数方差缩减与后期持续优化之间取得良好平衡。
AI.translation: 大规模扩散模型通常使用常数学习率（LR）和指数移动平均（EMA）进行训练，尽管学习率衰减和无调度（Schedule-Free）优化在大型语言模型训练中表现优异。我们研究了EMA是否唯一适用于扩散模型训练，或者更优的替代方案是否尚未被充分探索。我们的理论表明，对常数步长轨迹进行平均具有固有的优化局限性，而学习率衰减和Schedule-Free优化在标准非凸假设下具备渐近平稳性保证。实证表明，学习率衰减与EMA具有互补优势：在大多数测试的起始点将衰减与EMA结合能进一步提升标准基准，不过该增益对何时开始衰减依然敏感。Schedule-Free避免了这一时机要求，在各个训练阶段均持续优于常数学习率配比EMA，同时实现了更低的固定评估目标和更佳的生成质量。我们的分析进一步表明，这三种策略都大幅降低了参数变异性，但更强的稳定性并不总是意味着更好：采用常数学习率的EMA保留了相对更高的参数变异性，而激进的衰减结合EMA虽然实现了最低的检查点变异性，但也削弱了持续优化能力。Schedule-Free在大幅降低参数变异性的同时保留了更多后期进展，在参数稳定性与持续优化之间提供了更好的平衡。最后，Schedule-Free的优势不仅限于预训练，还延伸到了ReFL和生成器端DMD，证明了其在不同扩散模型优化环境下的可迁移性。总体而言，我们的结果表明大型扩散模型需要的不仅仅是参数平均：有效的优化需要在方差缩减与持续优化之间取得平衡。
AI.summary: 本文探讨了大规模扩散模型的优化方法，发现常数学习率配合EMA存在理论与实践上的优化瓶颈。研究证实学习率衰减结合EMA及Schedule-Free优化能显著提升模型效果，其中Schedule-Free不仅免除了衰减时机的超参数调优，还能更好地平衡参数稳定度与持续优化能力，在预训练及下游任务中均优于传统EMA方案。
AI.keywords: 扩散模型, 指数移动平均 (EMA), 学习率衰减, Schedule-Free优化, 参数变异性
AI.comments: 该研究指出了扩散模型训练中长期沿用“常数学习率+EMA”组合的局限性，从理论分析到实证评估全面论证了方差缩减与持续优化之间的权衡关系。论文引入Schedule-Free等方法并验证其在预训练、微调及蒸馏等多种场景的有效性，为大规模生成模型的优化策略设计提供了极具价值的实践指导。

title: SwitchTube: A Proof-of-Concept System Introducing "Adaptable Commitment Interfaces" as a Tool for Digital Wellbeing
comments: 22 pages. Published in Proceedings of the 2023 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI '23)
summary: YouTube has many features, such as homepage recommendations, that encourage users to explore its vast library of videos. However, when users visit YouTube with a specific intention, e.g., learning how to program in Python, these features to encourage exploration are often distracting. Prior work has innovated 'commitment interfaces' that restrict social media but finds that they often indiscriminately block needed content. In this paper, we describe the design, development, and evaluation of an 'adaptable commitment interface,' the SwitchTube mobile app, in which users can toggle between two interfaces when watching YouTube videos: Focus Mode (search-first) and Explore Mode (recommendations-first). In a three-week field deployment with 46 US participants, we evaluate how the ability to switch between interfaces affects user experience, finding that it provides users with a greater sense of agency, satisfaction, and goal alignment. We conclude with design implications for how adaptable commitment interfaces can support digital wellbeing.
comment: 22 pages. Published in Proceedings of the 2023 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI '23)

AI.title_translation: SwitchTube：引入“可适应性承诺界面”作为数字福祉工具的概念验证系统
AI.tldr: SwitchTube 允许用户在“专注模式”与“探索模式”间灵活切换，有效提升了使用视频平台时的自主感、满意度与目标一致性。
AI.motivation: YouTube 等平台的推荐机制极易分散有特定目标用户的注意力，而以往限制社交媒体的“承诺界面”往往不加区分地屏蔽必要内容，缺乏灵活性。
AI.method: 设计并开发了移动应用 SwitchTube，允许用户在“专注模式”（搜索优先）和“探索模式”（推荐优先）间自由切换，并面向 46 名美国参与者开展了为期三周的现场部署与实证评估。
AI.result: 评估结果表明，界面的灵活切换能力显著提升了用户的自主感（agency）、使用满意度以及与自身目标的一致性（goal alignment）。
AI.conclusion: 可适应性承诺界面能够有效平衡用户的专注与探索需求，为支持数字福祉（Digital Wellbeing）的人机交互设计提供了切实可行的方向。
AI.translation: YouTube 拥有诸多功能（例如首页推荐），鼓励用户探索其庞大的视频库。然而，当用户带着特定目的（例如学习如何用 Python 编程）访问 YouTube 时，这些鼓励探索的功能往往会分散注意力。先前的研究创新了限制社交媒体使用的“承诺界面”，但发现它们往往会不加区分地屏蔽所需内容。在本文中，我们介绍了名为 SwitchTube 的移动应用程序的设计、开发与评估，该应用作为一种“可适应性承诺界面”，允许用户在观看 YouTube 视频时在两种界面之间切换：“专注模式”（搜索优先）和“探索模式”（推荐优先）。在针对 46 名美国参与者开展的为期三周的实地部署中，我们评估了界面切换能力对用户体验的影响，发现它赋予了用户更强的自主感、满意度和目标一致性。最后，我们提出了关于可适应性承诺界面如何支持数字福祉的设计启示。
AI.summary: 本文提出了旨在促进数字福祉的“可适应性承诺界面”概念，并开发了原型应用 SwitchTube。该系统支持用户在搜索优先的“专注模式”和推荐优先的“探索模式”间自由切换。为期三周的实地实验证明，该方法能有效克服传统屏蔽工具的硬性限制，显著改善用户的自主控制感与目标一致性。
AI.keywords: 数字福祉 (Digital Wellbeing), 承诺界面 (Commitment Interfaces), 用户自主感 (Agency), 推荐系统 (Recommendation Systems)
AI.comments: 该研究针对数字福祉领域中传统限制性工具“一刀切”屏蔽内容的弊端，创新性地提出了“可适应性承诺界面”，巧妙平衡了用户的目标专注与休闲探索需求。其实用性和人机交互启发性较强，但样本局限于46名美国用户，长期有效性及向其他社交平台的泛化能力仍有待进一步验证。

title: Designing Human-AI Collaborative Science: The 9A Framework
summary: Artificial intelligence (AI) for Science is often described as a progression from human-directed assistance toward increasingly autonomous AI scientists. Human-AI collaboration offers a further mode in which human and AI contributions substantively shape scientific reasoning, judgments, and the course of inquiry. Existing research addresses work allocation, human-AI coordination, and system evaluation, but how these aspects interact to shape collaborative scientific systems remains insufficiently articulated. We develop the 9A Framework for Human-AI Collaborative Science (HACS) to connect these considerations across three layers. The organization layer specifies what scientific activities are required (Activity), who performs them (Actor), and who holds authority over consequential decisions (Authority). The coordination layer addresses how participants access relevant research information (Awareness), how scientific work advances through iterative proposal, execution, examination, revision, and resolution (Accountability), and when collaborative arrangements should be adjusted (Adaptability). The evaluation layer establishes what constitutes effective system performance (Achievement), how comparisons can be designed to identify the effects of organizational and coordination choices (Attribution), and what evidence supports the resulting conclusions (Assurance). Together, these layers frame HACS as a system-design problem, providing a basis for designing collaborative scientific workflows and for empirically comparing their effectiveness.

AI.title_translation: 设计人机协同科学：9A框架
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个包含组织、协调和评估三层维度的“9A框架”，为人机协同科学工作流的系统化设计与实证评估提供了理论基础。
AI.motivation: 尽管现有人机协作科研研究探讨了工作分配、协调与系统评估，但缺乏对这些要素如何相互作用以共同塑造协同科研系统的深入与系统性阐述。
AI.method: 提出了人机协同科学（HACS）的“9A框架”，涵盖三个层面：组织层（活动 Activity、行动者 Actor、权威 Authority）、协调层（认知/信息获取 Awareness、问责/迭代进展 Accountability、适应性 Adaptability）以及评估层（成就 Achievement、归因 Attribution、保证 Assurance）。
AI.result: 构建了一个贯穿组织、协调与评估的系统性理论框架（9A框架），将人机协同科学形式化为一个系统设计问题。
AI.conclusion: 9A框架将人机协同科学定义为一个系统设计问题，为人机协作科研工作流的规范化设计及其有效性的实证评估提供了系统性的理论基础。
AI.translation: 人工智能驱动的科学研究（AI for Science）常被描述为从人类主导的辅助工具向日益自主的AI科学家演进的过程。人机协作则提供了另一种模式，在该模式下，人类与AI的共同贡献实质性地塑造了科学推理、判断以及探索的过程。现有研究涉及了工作分配、人机协调以及系统评估，但这些方面如何相互作用以构建协同科学系统仍未得到充分阐释。为此，我们提出了人机协同科学（HACS）的9A框架，跨越三个层面将这些考量连接起来：组织层明确需要哪些科学活动（Activity）、由谁执行（Actor）以及谁对关键决策拥有权威（Authority）；协调层解决参与者如何获取相关研究信息（Awareness）、科学工作如何通过提议、执行、审查、修订和解决的迭代过程来推进（Accountability），以及何时应当调整协作安排（Adaptability）；评估层确立了何为有效的系统性能（Achievement）、如何设计对比以确定组织和协调选择所产生的影响（Attribution），以及哪些证据支持所得结论（Assurance）。这些层面共同将HACS构建为一个系统设计问题，为设计协同科学工作流以及实证比较其有效性奠定了基础。
AI.summary: 本文提出了针对人机协同科学（HACS）的“9A框架”。该框架从组织层（Activity, Actor, Authority）、协调层（Awareness, Accountability, Adaptability）和评估层（Achievement, Attribution, Assurance）三方面解构科研协作全流程，将人机协同科学重塑为系统设计问题，为协同工作流的设计与实证评价提供了基础。
AI.keywords: 人机协同科学, 9A框架, 人工智能科学 (AI for Science), 科学工作流, 系统设计
AI.comments: 该研究跳出了追求“完全自主AI科学家”的单一视角，创新性地提出了人机深度协同的系统化范式。9A框架将复杂的科研协作解构为组织、协调和评估三个层次的九个维度，逻辑严密全面，尤其将因果归因和证据保证纳入评估层，对未来设计、实现及量化评估人机协同科研系统具有重要的理论指导和方法论参考价值。

title: MambaAct: Efficient Mamba Action Experts for Flow-Matching Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have shown strong promise for generalist robotic manipulation, but their inference cost remains a major bottleneck for real-time control. This limitation is especially pronounced in flow-matching VLAs such as $π_{0.5}$, where the action expert is evaluated repeatedly during iterative denoising. We introduce MambaAct, an efficient Mamba action expert for flow-matching VLA policies. MambaAct retains the pretrained visual-language prefix encoder of $π_{0.5}$, while replacing its transformer-based action expert with a compact Mamba-based action expert. Within this expert, Mamba serves as the action mixer that models dependencies across the noisy continuous-action sequence. To preserve visual-language conditioning without repeated token-level cross-attention, MambaAct uses a lightweight Context Compressor to map Vision-language model (VLM) prefix tokens into a compact conditioning signal that gates and modulates each Mamba action block. MambaAct uses a $10\times$ smaller action expert and reduces flow-matching denoising latency by $64.8\%$ on LIBERO and $58.8\%$ in real-world deployment, while improving mean LIBERO success by $1.08$ percentage points across three independent fine-tuning seeds and maintaining gains on LIBERO-Plus and real-world benchmarks. Our code and model weights are publicly available at https://github.com/giakhuyendihoc/MambaAct.

AI.title_translation: MambaAct：面向流匹配视觉-语言-动作模型的高效Mamba动作专家
AI.tldr: MambaAct使用紧凑的Mamba结构和轻量上下文压缩器替代流匹配VLA中的Transformer动作专家，使动作专家体积缩小10倍、去噪延迟降低约60%，并同时提升了操作成功率。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在通用机器人操作中潜力巨大，但高昂的推理开销严重制约了实时闭环控制；特别是在基于流匹配（flow-matching）的VLA（如π_{0.5}）中，迭代去噪生成动作需要反复调用评估动作专家网络，进一步加剧了计算延迟瓶颈。
AI.method: MambaAct保留了π_{0.5}模型的预训练视觉-语言前缀编码器，将其原有的Transformer动作专家替换为紧凑的Mamba动作专家，利用Mamba作为动作混合器建模加噪连续动作序列的时间依赖；同时引入轻量级上下文压缩器（Context Compressor），将VLM前缀标记映射为紧凑的条件特征向量，用于直接门控和调制各个Mamba动作块，避免了每次迭代中反复进行高开销的标记级交叉注意力计算。
AI.result: 相比基线模型，MambaAct的动作专家参数量减少了10倍；在LIBERO仿真和真实世界部署中，流匹配去噪延迟分别降低了64.8%和58.8%；在3个独立随机种子微调评估下，LIBERO平均操作成功率提高了1.08个百分点，并在LIBERO-Plus和真实机器人任务中保持了稳定增益。
AI.conclusion: MambaAct证明了使用状态空间模型（Mamba）构建动作专家能够大幅提升流匹配VLA模型的推理效率与实时控制可行性，在显著降低参数量和去噪延迟的同时保持甚至超越了原有基线的操作表现。
AI.translation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在通用机器人操作中展现出巨大的应用前景，但其推理成本仍是实现实时控制的主要瓶颈。这种限制在诸如 π_{0.5} 等流匹配（flow-matching）VLA模型中尤为突出，因为在迭代去噪过程中动作专家会被反复评估。我们提出了 MambaAct，一种面向流匹配 VLA 策略的高效 Mamba 动作专家。MambaAct 保留了 π_{0.5} 的预训练视觉-语言前缀编码器，同时将其基于 Transformer 的动作专家替换为紧凑的基于 Mamba 的动作专家。在该专家内部，Mamba 作为动作混合器来建模噪声连续动作序列之间的依赖关系。为了在不进行重复标记级交叉注意力的情况下保留视觉-语言条件信息，MambaAct 使用轻量级的上下文压缩器（Context Compressor）将视觉语言模型（VLM）的前缀标记映射为紧凑的条件信号，以门控和调制每个 Mamba 动作块。MambaAct 将动作专家的参数量缩小了 10 倍，并在 LIBERO 基准和真实世界部署中分别将流匹配去噪延迟降低了 64.8% 和 58.8%，同时在三个独立的微调随机种子上使 LIBERO 平均成功率提高了 1.08 个百分点，并在 LIBERO-Plus 及真实世界基准测试中保持了性能优势。我们的代码和模型权重已在 https://github.com/giakhuyendihoc/MambaAct 公开。
AI.summary: 本文针对基于流匹配的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在迭代去噪中推理延迟过高的问题，提出了MambaAct。该方法保留预训练VLM前缀编码器，采用基于Mamba的紧凑动作专家替代Transformer专家，并借助上下文压缩器进行轻量化条件调制。实验表明，MambaAct大幅缩小了模型规模并降低了约60%的去噪延迟，同时在仿真与真实场景中均提升了机器人操作成功率。
AI.keywords: 视觉-语言-动作模型, Mamba, 流匹配, 机器人操作, 实时控制
AI.comments: 该论文精准切中了基于流匹配的VLA模型在机器人实时控制中“多次迭代去噪导致高延迟”的核心痛点。创新性地将线性复杂度的状态空间模型（Mamba）用作动作混合器，并设计了上下文压缩器规避跨模态交叉注意力的重复计算开销。在将参数量缩减10倍、去噪延迟减半以上的同时，操作性能不仅未损耗反而略有提升，为推动基础具身智能模型在真实硬件上的低延迟落地提供了极具实用价值的范式。

title: MergeShuffle: Reconstruct Shared Libraries for Improved Performance and Security
summary:
Debloating shared libraries has been an active research topic for years. Tools for shared library debloating rely on either static or dynamic analysis techniques to discover which parts of the shared library is used. Once these parts are found, these tools take one of two routes, either removing parts of the library that are not used, requiring reconstruction of the library; or they simply overwriting the unused functions. However, recently a broad study~\cite{brown2024broad} on debloating tools has shown that some of these tools either increase the static binary size, or are generally less effective for complex workloads.
  In this paper, we argue that shared-library debloaters' performance can be improved by proper reconstruction of the shared-libraries once the used functions in the library are identifies. We propose \myapp, a novel tool for reconstructing shared libraries from a given set of file ranges to eliminate unused code based on user-specified requirements, without requiring access to source code. \myapp takes as input a shared library and a set of file ranges to retain, and performs a two-phase reconstruction: merging nearby ranges to reduce loading overhead, and shuffling them to minimize file size while preserving page-aligned memory mappings. The shuffling problem is formulated as a variant of the Traveling Salesman Problem and solved using a heuristic algorithm. \myapp utilizes program headers to remap retained code to its original memory addresses, preserving user-specified functionality. Our results show that \myapp achieves up to 60\% reduction in file size, 16\% reduction in memory usage, and 32\% reduction in runtime, while maintaining user-specified functionality and improving security.

AI.title_translation: MergeShuffle：重构共享库以提升性能与安全性
AI.tldr: MergeShuffle提出了一种通过合并与启发式重排代码区间的两阶段共享库重构方法，能在无需源码的情况下实现高达60%的文件体积缩减和32%的运行时间优化。
AI.motivation: 现有共享库瘦身工具存在移除未使用部分后重构困难或直接覆盖未使用函数的问题，近期研究表明这些工具可能导致静态二进制体积反而增大，或在复杂工作负载中表现不佳。因此需要更有效的共享库重构技术来兼顾精简效果与性能。
AI.method: 提出名为MergeShuffle的无源码共享库重构工具。它以共享库和待保留文件范围为输入，执行两阶段重构：首先合并相邻代码范围以减少加载开销；其次将重排问题形式化为旅行商问题（TSP）变体，利用启发式算法重排代码块，在保持内存页对齐的同时最小化文件体积，并通过程序头将代码重新映射至原始内存地址。
AI.result: MergeShuffle在保留用户指定功能并提升安全性的同时，最高实现了60%的文件体积缩减、16%的内存使用缩减以及32%的运行时间缩减。
AI.conclusion: MergeShuffle通过创新的两阶段重构方法，证明了在无需源码的情况下，对共享库精简后的代码块进行恰当合并与重排能够有效兼顾紧凑性与加载执行效率，从而显著提升软件的性能与安全性。
AI.translation: 共享库瘦身（Debloating）多年来一直是一个热门的研究课题。用于共享库瘦身的工具依赖静态或动态分析技术来发现共享库中被使用的部分。一旦找到这些部分，这些工具通常采取两种途径之一：要么移除库中未使用的部分，这需要对库进行重构；要么直接覆盖未使用的函数。然而，最近一项针对瘦身工具的广泛研究表明，其中一些工具要么增加了静态二进制文件的大小，要么在复杂工作负载下整体效果较差。在本文中，我们认为在识别出库中使用到的函数后，通过对共享库进行适当的重构，可以提高共享库瘦身工具的性能。我们提出了MergeShuffle，这是一种新型工具，用于根据用户指定的需求从给定的文件范围集中重构共享库以消除未使用代码，且无需访问源代码。MergeShuffle以共享库和一组要保留的文件范围作为输入，并执行两阶段重构：合并相邻范围以减少加载开销，并对它们进行重排（shuffling）以在保持内存页对齐映射的同时最小化文件大小。重排问题被形式化为旅行商问题（TSP）的一种变体，并使用启发式算法进行求解。MergeShuffle利用程序头将保留的代码重新映射到其原始内存地址，从而保留用户指定的功能。我们的实验结果表明，MergeShuffle在保持用户指定功能并提高安全性的同时，实现了高达60%的文件大小缩减、16%的内存使用减少以及32%的运行时间减少。
AI.summary: 针对现有共享库精简工具在二进制重构上存在的体积膨胀或效率低下问题，本文提出了一种无需源码的共享库重构工具MergeShuffle。该工具接收保留代码区间作为输入，采用合并临近区间与基于启发式TSP变体算法重排代码的两阶段策略，结合程序头重映射机制，在保留原始地址与功能的前提下大幅减少了文件体积、内存占用及运行时间。
AI.keywords: shared library debloating, binary reconstruction, file size reduction, Traveling Salesman Problem, software security
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于将共享库精简后的重构布局问题形式化为旅行商问题（TSP）的变体，通过合并与重排保留的文件范围，兼顾了页对齐映射和文件大小压缩；局限在于该方法依赖前端工具准确提供需保留的代码范围，且仅针对重构阶段进行优化。

title: Recognizing Atari and Assessing Sente: Controlled Evaluation Tasks for Language-Based Go Agents
comments: 7 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. The first two authors contributed equally
summary: Domain terminology provides concise descriptions of game states and strategic relationships, but whether game-playing language models can accurately recognize these concepts and relate them to move evaluation remains unclear. We construct a controlled evaluation set centered on atari and its relationship to sente in Go, examining terminology recognition under local board changes and move evaluation under different strategic conditions. We conduct our tests on LoGos, a Go language model, after fine-tuning it with terminology and commentary supervision. The model struggles to recognize changes in the atari relationship and assess its strategic implications. Its terminology predictions are associated with move preferences even when those preferences contradict the reference evaluation. Our controlled tests provide a framework for examining whether language-based Go agents connect domain terminology with precise board relationships and strategic move values.
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables. The first two authors contributed equally

AI.title_translation: 识别叫吃与评估先手：基于语言的围棋智能体受控评估任务
AI.tldr: 本文构建了针对围棋“叫吃”与“先手”关系的受控评测基准，发现围棋语言模型难以准确识别局部变化带来的术语改变，且术语预测会诱导错误的着法偏好。
AI.motivation: 领域专业术语能高度概括博弈状态与战略关系，但博弈语言模型是否能够准确识别这些概念并将其正确关联到着法评估中，目前尚不明确。
AI.method: 构建了聚焦于围棋中“叫吃”及其与“先手”关系的受控评估数据集，用于测试局部棋盘变化下的术语识别以及不同战略条件下的着法评估；并在经过术语和解说数据监督微调的围棋语言模型LoGos上进行了实验测试。
AI.result: 实验表明，LoGos模型难以准确识别叫吃关系的变化并评估其战略影响；此外，模型的术语预测会引发特定的着法偏好，即便这种偏好与标准参考评估存在冲突。
AI.conclusion: 该受控测试为检验基于语言的围棋智能体能否真正将领域专业术语与精准的棋盘空间逻辑及战略着法价值相联系，提供了有效的评测框架。
AI.translation: 领域术语能够提供对博弈状态和战略关系的简洁描述，但用于下棋的语言模型是否能够准确识别这些概念并将它们与着法评估联系起来仍不明确。我们构建了一个以围棋中的“叫吃”及其与“先手”关系为核心的受控评估集，旨在考察局部棋盘变化下的术语识别以及不同战略条件下的着法评估。我们在使用术语和解说监督微调后的围棋语言模型LoGos上进行了测试。该模型在识别叫吃关系的变化以及评估其战略意义方面表现吃力。模型的术语预测与其着法偏好相关联，即便这些偏好与参考评估相违背。我们的受控测试提供了一个框架，用于检验基于语言的围棋智能体是否能将领域术语与精准的棋盘关系及战略着法价值相结合。
AI.summary: 本文针对语言模型在博弈理解中的概念认知问题，构建了围绕围棋“叫吃”与“先手”关系的受控评估任务。在对微调后的围棋语言模型LoGos进行评测后，研究发现模型难以根据局部盘面变化准确识别战术概念，且术语与着法评估之间存在不合理的错误关联。该研究为评估博弈智能体的专业概念落地与策略推理能力提供了新基准。
AI.keywords: 围棋语言模型, 叫吃, 先手, 术语识别, 受控评估
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于跳出单纯依靠胜率或胜着匹配率的宏观评测模式，转而构建细粒度的受控评估框架，探究语言模型对围棋专业概念（叫吃、先手）的真正理解及符号表征与走法价值推理之间的对齐关系。其发现揭示了当前语言模型可能只是学习到了术语与走法间的浅层虚假关联（即使与参考评估相悖），对推进符号知识与博弈推理的深度结合具有重要启发。局限在于测试仅局限于单一围棋模型LoGos及叫吃/先手这一局部概念，未来需扩展至更广泛的模型架构与复杂大局观术语。

title: On the tradeoff between robustness and geometric accuracy in adversarial training
summary: For non-parametric binary classification in the presence of an adversary, we prove an optimal quantitative estimate for adversarial classifiers controlling geometric accuracy, as measured by the Hausdorff distance to the Bayes classifier, in terms or their robustness, as encoded by the adversarial budget $\varepsilon$. This rigorously shows that robust classifiers sacrifice at most $O(\sqrt{\varepsilon})$ or $O(\varepsilon)$ in accuracy, depending on the regularity of the underlying Bayes classifier. In contrast to prior work on the incompatibility of robustness and accuracy over low-complexity hypothesis classes, our work shows that high-complexity hypothesis classes allow for robust classifiers with precisely quantified accuracy. Our results apply for adversaries determined by any norm on Euclidean space and in both the infinite and finite data settings.

AI.title_translation: 对抗训练中鲁棒性与几何精度之间的权衡
AI.tldr: 论文证明了在非参数二元分类中，鲁棒分类器的几何精度损失以对抗预算为界（至多为 $O(\sqrt{\varepsilon})$ 或 $O(\varepsilon)$），证实了高复杂度假设类中鲁棒性与精度的可调和性。
AI.motivation: 明确非参数二元分类在对抗样本扰动下，分类器的几何精度与对抗鲁棒性（扰动预算）之间精确的定量权衡关系，重新审视鲁棒性与精度的兼容性。
AI.method: 基于非参数二元分类框架，利用到贝叶斯分类器的豪斯多夫距离来度量几何精度，并在欧氏空间任意范数及有限/无限数据设定下推导最优定量估计。
AI.result: 严格证明了鲁棒分类器在精度上的损失最多为 $O(\sqrt{\varepsilon})$ 或 $O(\varepsilon)$（取决于贝叶斯分类器的正则性），揭示了高复杂度假设类允许构建具有精确量化精度的鲁棒分类器。
AI.conclusion: 高复杂度假设类支持兼具鲁棒性与高几何精度的分类器，二者之间的权衡关系具有精确且最优的量化上界，而非不可调和。
AI.translation: 针对存在对抗扰动的非参数二元分类问题，我们证明了对抗分类器在控制几何精度（由到贝叶斯分类器的豪斯多夫距离衡量）与鲁棒性（由对抗预算 $\varepsilon$ 刻画）之间的最优定量估计。这严格表明，取决于底层贝叶斯分类器的正则性，鲁棒分类器在精度上的损失最多为 $O(\sqrt{\varepsilon})$ 或 $O(\varepsilon)$。与先前关于低复杂度假设类上鲁棒性与精度不可兼得的研究不同，我们的工作表明高复杂度假设类允许存在具有精确量化精度的鲁棒分类器。我们的结论适用于欧几里得空间上任意范数定义的对抗扰动，以及无限和有限数据两种设定。
AI.summary: 本文针对存在对抗攻击的非参数二元分类问题，严格证明了对抗预算 $\varepsilon$ 与几何精度（以豪斯多夫距离衡量）之间的最优定量权衡界限，指出高复杂度假设类下的鲁棒分类器精度损失至多为 $O(\sqrt{\varepsilon})$ 或 $O(\varepsilon)$，为鲁棒性与精度的共存提供了理论支撑。
AI.keywords: 对抗训练 (Adversarial training), 几何精度 (Geometric accuracy), 鲁棒性权衡 (Robustness tradeoff), 豪斯多夫距离 (Hausdorff distance), 非参数分类 (Non-parametric classification)
AI.comments: 该研究的重要创新在于打破了先前针对低复杂度模型认为“鲁棒性与精度不兼容”的认知，首次从非参数高复杂度假设类的视角，使用豪斯多夫距离建立了鲁棒性与几何精度之间的严谨理论上界，并适用于任意范数扰动及有限/无限样本环境。

title: Query-adaptive Recurrent Tokenization
summary: Visual information worth extracting from an image and the token budget it warrants depend on the text query. Yet modern vision and vision-language models largely encode images independently of the query and allocate a fixed visual token budget to every input. We introduce the Query-Adaptive Recurrent Tokenizer (QART), a backbone-agnostic module that makes visual representations both query-steerable and budget-adaptive. QART steers the visual representation toward query-relevant evidence while adapting its token budget to the amount of information required. Its key principle is simple. Additional tokens are allocated until the visual features relevant to the query are represented with sufficient fidelity. Starting from frozen encoder features, QART recurrently constructs a compact representation and uses reconstruction quality over the query-relevant visual support to control token allocation. On Visual7W and VQAv2, QART achieves 81.96% and 76.37% accuracy using only about 29 visual tokens, reducing token counts by 20-25x relative to dense VLM inputs. It further reaches 92.0% P@1 on CORE and 36.3% PR-AUC on PODS, outperforming SteerViT on PODS by 8.4%. Together, these results show that visual representations need not be fixed in either content or capacity and can instead adapt to what each query requires.

AI.title_translation: 查询自适应循环词元化
AI.tldr: 提出QART模块，依据文本查询自适应调整视觉token内容与预算，在减少20-25倍视觉token的同时保持高精度。
AI.motivation: 从图像中提取的有用信息及所需的token预算高度依赖于文本查询，但现有多模态模型通常与查询无关地编码图像，并为所有输入分配固定的视觉token预算，造成计算冗余。
AI.method: 提出与主干网络无关的QART（查询自适应循环Token生成器）模块。该模块基于冻结的编码器特征，循环构建紧凑表示，以查询相关视觉证据的重构质量为衡量指标，逐步分配额外token直至满足保真度要求，实现内容可控与预算自适应。
AI.result: 在Visual7W和VQAv2上仅使用约29个视觉token即达到81.96%和76.37%的准确率，较密集型VLM输入减少了20-25倍的token数量；在CORE上达到92.0%的P@1，在PODS上取得36.3%的PR-AUC（比SteerViT高出8.4%）。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果表明，视觉特征在内容与容量上均无需保持固定，而应根据具体查询动态自适应，从而兼顾计算效率与表达准确性。
AI.translation: 从图像中提取有价值的视觉信息及其合理的词元（token）预算取决于文本查询。然而，现代视觉和视觉语言模型在编码图像时大多独立于查询，并为每个输入分配固定的视觉token预算。我们提出了查询自适应循环Token生成器（QART），这是一种与主干网络无关的模块，使视觉表示既可被查询引导，又能自适应预算。QART将视觉表示引导至与查询相关的证据，同时根据所需信息量调整其token预算。其核心原理十分简单：持续分配额外的token，直到与查询相关的视觉特征达到足够的表示保真度。QART基于冻结的编码器特征循环构建紧凑表示，并利用针对查询相关视觉支持的重构质量来控制token分配。在Visual7W和VQAv2上，QART仅使用约29个视觉token就分别达到了81.96%和76.37%的准确率，相比密集型VLM输入减少了20至25倍的token数量。它还在CORE上达到了92.0%的P@1，在PODS上达到了36.3%的PR-AUC（比SteerViT高出8.4%）。这些结果共同表明，视觉表示在内容和容量上均无需固定，而是可以自适应每个查询的具体需求。
AI.summary: 本文提出了QART模块，使视觉表示能够根据文本查询自适应调整内容侧重与token预算。该方法通过循环重构查询相关视觉支持来动态决定token数量，在显著减少20-25倍视觉token的同时，在多个视觉问答与检索基准上保持了优异甚至更胜一筹的性能。
AI.keywords: 查询自适应, 循环Token化, 视觉语言模型, 动态Token预算, 视觉表示压缩
AI.comments: 该研究创新性地将文本查询信息引入图像token的动态分配与表示构建中，打破了传统VLM对所有图像均分配固定静态token预算的局限。通过循环重构质量自适应控制token数量，既大幅降低了多模态模型的计算负载（token压缩20-25倍），又保持了高精度，对高效视觉语言模型设计具有重要启示。

title: SAFE-Mem: Secure Agentic Memory with Fine-Grained Authority and Governance-Aware Retrieval
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on persistent memory to support long-term reasoning and personalized interactions. However, information collected from external sources can introduce security risks when untrusted claims (i.e., atomic statements) are later treated as authorized preferences, policies, or permissions. Existing defenses typically rely on content-based filtering or coarse-grained provenance tracking, which either fail to prevent unauthorized memory use or block legitimate information, sacrificing memory utility. To address these limitations, we propose SAFE-Mem, a fine-grained memory governance framework that improves security while preserving legitimate memory use. First, SAFE-Mem annotates each claim with three governance labels (i.e., kind, authority, and scope) to capture its provenance and permitted use. Second, governance-aware retrieval matches query requirements with claim permissions to block unauthorized influence while retaining legitimate information. Third, a governance-enabled memory graph connects source sentences, claims, and entities to support provenance tracking and efficient retrieval. Across four LLM backbones on MPBench and LoCoMo, SAFE-Mem attains the lowest attack success among defenses that retain legitimate memory, at least 77% below the strongest of them, and the highest answer accuracy of all evaluated defenses, improving it by up to 15%. The code is available at https://github.com/LVenum/SAFE-Mem.

AI.title_translation: SAFE-Mem：具有细粒度权限与治理感知检索的安全智能体记忆
AI.tldr: SAFE-Mem提出了一种基于细粒度治理标签、权限匹配检索和记忆图谱的智能体记忆安全治理框架，在大幅削减安全风险的同时保证了记忆的正常利用率。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型智能体依赖持久记忆进行推理和个性化交互，但外部不可信断言可能被错误赋予授权偏好或权限，引发安全风险；现有基于内容过滤或粗粒度追踪的防御方案要么无法阻止未授权记忆使用，要么过度拦截合法信息而牺牲记忆效用。
AI.method: SAFE-Mem采用细粒度记忆治理框架：1）为每个断言（claim）标注种类（kind）、权限（authority）和范围（scope）三种治理标签；2）通过治理感知检索将查询要求与断言权限进行匹配，阻止未授权影响；3）构建由源句、断言和实体连接的治理记忆图谱，支持来源追踪与高效检索。
AI.result: 在MPBench和LoCoMo基准及四种LLM骨干模型上的实验表明，在保留合法记忆的防御方法中，SAFE-Mem的攻击成功率最低（相比最强基线至少降低77%），并在所有防御中取得了最高的回答准确率（提升高达15%）。
AI.conclusion: SAFE-Mem通过细粒度治理标签、治理感知检索及图谱化管理，成功兼顾了智能体记忆的安全性与可用性，为安全智能体记忆架构提供了有效的解决方案。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体越来越依赖持久记忆来支持长期推理和个性化交互。然而，当来自外部源的不可信断言（即原子陈述）随后被视为已授权的偏好、策略或权限时，收集到的信息可能会引入安全风险。现有的防御通常依赖于基于内容的过滤或粗粒度的来源追踪，这些方法要么无法阻止未授权的记忆使用，要么会阻断合法信息，从而牺牲记忆效用。为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了SAFE-Mem，一种细粒度的记忆治理框架，它在保护安全的同时保留了合法的记忆使用。首先，SAFE-Mem为每个断言标注三个治理标签（即种类、权限和范围），以捕获其来源和允许的使用方式。其次，治理感知检索将查询要求与断言权限进行匹配，以阻断未授权影响，同时保留合法信息。第三，支持治理的记忆图谱连接了源句子、断言和实体，以支持来源追踪和高效检索。在MPBench和LoCoMo基准上跨四个LLM骨干模型的评估中，SAFE-Mem在保留合法记忆的防御方案中取得了最低的攻击成功率，比其中最强的方法至少低77%，并在所有评估的防御中取得了最高的回答准确率，提升高达15%。代码已开源于 https://github.com/LVenum/SAFE-Mem。
AI.summary: 针对大语言模型智能体长期记忆中外部不可信信息带来的安全漏洞，本研究提出了SAFE-Mem框架。该框架通过细粒度治理标签（种类、权限、范围）、权限匹配的治理感知检索以及治理记忆图谱，实现了对记忆权限的严格控制与溯源。实验证明，SAFE-Mem在大幅降低攻击成功率的同时显著提升了回答准确率。
AI.keywords: 智能体记忆, 细粒度权限, 治理感知检索, 记忆图谱, 大语言模型安全
AI.comments: 该研究针对大语言模型智能体记忆中不可信信息被误当作高权限策略/偏好的安全隐患，创新性地提出了将访问控制和数据治理思想引入记忆机制。通过定义属性标签、治理感知检索以及记忆图谱，在不牺牲记忆效用的前提下显著降低了被攻击概率，对保障多轮、长期交互中智能体的安全部署具有重要意义。

title: DriftTTS: One-stage Single Step Text-to-Speech via Generative Drifting
summary: Text-to-speech models built on score matching and flow matching produce natural speech, but only by calling the decoder many times, which makes synthesis slow. Existing ways to cut the number of calls either distill from a multi-step teacher or add a stage on top of a pretrained model, leaving single-step TTS without a pretrained TTS model unexplored. We question whether pretraining a TTS model is necessary, and propose DriftTTS, which adopts generative drifting, an objective that moves iterative sampling from inference into training. Drifting assumes samples of fixed shape, whereas speech has variable length; we address this issue with segment drifting. On LJSpeech, DriftTTS matches the multi-step quality of Matcha-TTS and RapFlow-TTS in a single decoder call, while being faster. To our knowledge, this is the first application of generative drifting to text-to-speech.

AI.title_translation: DriftTTS：基于生成漂移的单阶段单步文本转语音
AI.tldr: DriftTTS首次将生成漂移引入TTS，无需多步预训练模型或复杂蒸馏，即可实现单步解码且媲美多步扩散模型的语音合成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有的得分匹配和流匹配TTS模型生成速度慢（需要多步解码），且现有的加速方案通常依赖多步教师模型蒸馏或在预训练模型上增加阶段，缺乏无需预训练TTS模型的单阶段单步TTS研究。
AI.method: 提出DriftTTS，引入生成漂移（generative drifting）目标，将推理阶段的迭代采样计算转移至训练阶段；针对传统漂移要求固定样本尺寸而语音具有可变长度的问题，提出了分段漂移（segment drifting）方法。
AI.result: 在LJSpeech数据集上，DriftTTS仅需单次解码器调用即可达到Matcha-TTS和RapFlow-TTS的多步生成质量，且合成速度更快。
AI.conclusion: DriftTTS证明了无需预训练TTS模型也可以直接训练出单阶段单步的高质量语音合成模型，成功将生成漂移应用于TTS领域。
AI.translation: 基于得分匹配和流匹配的文本转语音模型能够生成自然的语音，但只能通过多次调用解码器来实现，这导致合成速度变慢。现有减少调用次数的方法要么从多步教师模型中进行蒸馏，要么在预训练模型的基础上增加一个阶段，这使得在没有预训练TTS模型的情况下实现单步TTS仍未被探索。我们质疑预训练TTS模型是否必要，并提出了DriftTTS。该模型采用生成漂移（generative drifting）目标，将迭代采样过程从推理转移到了训练中。由于漂移假设样本具有固定形状，而语音具有可变长度，我们通过分段漂移（segment drifting）解决了这个问题。在LJSpeech数据集上，DriftTTS在仅需单次解码器调用的情况下，达到了Matcha-TTS和RapFlow-TTS的多步质量，同时速度更快。据我们所知，这是生成漂移在文本转语音领域的首次应用。
AI.summary: 针对扩散及流匹配TTS模型推理步数多、现有加速方案依赖预训练蒸馏的问题，本文提出了首个应用生成漂移的单阶段单步TTS模型DriftTTS。通过生成漂移将采样迭代移至训练阶段，并利用分段漂移解决语音变长问题，DriftTTS在无需预训练模型的情况下，仅凭单步解码即可在LJSpeech上达到主流多步模型的语音合成质量，显著提升了推理效率。
AI.keywords: 文本转语音, 生成漂移, 单步生成, 分段漂移, 流匹配
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于首次将生成漂移（generative drifting）引入文本转语音领域，并针对语音序列变长特性提出了分段漂移机制，打破了以往单步TTS必须依赖多步预训练教师模型蒸馏的固有范式，极大地简化了训练流程。其局限在于摘要中仅在LJSpeech单说话人数据集上进行了验证，在更复杂的多说话人及野外场景下的泛化能力仍有待检验。

title: What Shapes Brain Alignment of Large Language Models during Dialogue? Insights from Language Production and Comprehension
summary: Brain alignment of large language models (LLMs) offers a way to investigate representational similarities between LLMs and the human brain during language processing. While previous studies have mainly focused on passive language comprehension, little is known about such alignment during dialogue, in which speakers engage in both language production and comprehension. In this study, using fMRI data collected during dialogue, we examine brain alignment during language production and comprehension across LLM layers and brain regions. We assess its association with the intrinsic dimension (ID) of LLM representations and the contributions of several interpretable linguistic and communicative features. Our results reveal distinct patterns of brain alignment between production and comprehension, as well as strong associations with ID in brain regions associated with each processing mode. Furthermore, we show that the contributions of linguistic and communicative features also vary across processing modes, LLM layers, and brain regions.

AI.title_translation: 对话中是什么塑造了大语言模型的大脑对齐？来自语言生成与理解的见解
AI.tldr: 研究利用对话fMRI数据，揭示了大语言模型在语言生成与理解中截然不同的大脑对齐模式，以及内在维度和语言交际特征对对齐的显著影响。
AI.motivation: 以往探索大语言模型（LLM）与人脑表征相似性（大脑对齐）的研究主要集中在被动语言理解任务上，而在说话者同时参与语言生成与理解的真实对话场景中，LLM与大脑的对齐特征尚不明确。
AI.method: 利用对话过程中采集的人脑功能性磁共振成像（fMRI）数据，跨越LLM各网络层与不同脑区，对比分析语言生成和语言理解过程中的大脑对齐现象；同时评估对齐效果与LLM表征内在维度（ID）的关系，并分析多种可解释的语言和交际特征的贡献。
AI.result: 语言生成与理解呈现出不同的大脑对齐模式；在与各处理模式相关的特定脑区中，对齐程度与模型的内在维度（ID）存在强关联；此外，语言和交际特征对对齐的贡献随处理模式、LLM层级以及脑区的不同而发生显著变化。
AI.conclusion: 对话中语言生成与理解展现出截然不同的大脑对齐模式，且该对齐受到模型内在表征维度以及多层次语言与交际特征的动态调制，揭示了人脑交互与LLM表征之间的复杂映射机制。
AI.translation: 大语言模型（LLM）的大脑对齐为研究语言处理过程中LLM与人脑之间的表征相似性提供了一种途径。以往的研究主要集中在被动语言理解上，而对于说话者同时参与语言生成和理解的对话过程中这种对齐情况知之甚少。在本研究中，我们利用对话期间采集的fMRI数据，跨越LLM层和脑区检验了语言生成与理解期间的大脑对齐。我们评估了其与LLM表征的内在维度（ID）之间的关联，以及若干可解释的语言和交际特征所作出的贡献。我们的结果揭示了生成和理解之间截然不同的大脑对齐模式，以及在与各处理模式相关的脑区中与ID的强关联。此外，我们表明语言和交际特征的贡献在不同处理模式、LLM层和脑区之间也存在差异。
AI.summary: 本研究通过对话任务中的fMRI数据，首次系统评估了大语言模型在语言生成与理解两种模式下的大脑对齐特性。结果表明，生成与理解诱发了差异化的大脑对齐模式，且对齐程度与LLM表征的内在维度及具体语言交际特征密切相关，为认知神经科学与AI对齐研究提供了全新见解。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型, 大脑对齐, 语言生成, 语言理解, 内在维度
AI.comments: 本研究的创新点在于打破了以往仅局限于被动语言理解的范式，首次在更具生态效度的双向交互对话场景下，同时对比考察了语言生成与理解两种认知模式下的脑-机表征对齐。引入内在维度（ID）及可解释特征为理解深度模型表征与神经机制的映射提供了更细粒度的分析视角。局限在于摘要未透露具体的LLM模型类型、特征工程细节以及具体的脑区解剖定位。

title: Rethinking Magnitude Compression in Spectral Losses for DDSP Parameter Estimation
