AI.title_translation: 企业温室气体清单中采购的人工智能推理核算：一种基于Token的方法
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Token的方法和公开数据集，用于精确计算企业温室气体清单中采购的AI推理服务的碳足迹，解决了传统基于支出方法误差大的问题。
AI.motivation: 目前企业温室气体清单中对购买的AI推理（属于范围3类别1）往往忽略不计，或采用基于支出的粗略计算因子，导致结果与物理实际相差悬殊且无法区分不同模型或地区，因此需要一种更精确的核算方法。
AI.method: 建立了一个从摇篮到大门的边界，包含四个级别的活动数据、有效Token基础、四项因子（服务器电力、硬件内含、数据中心建设、披露的最终训练运行）以及将模型标识符和地区解析为排放因子的规则。
AI.result: 推理碳萍迹在不同模型类别之间相差12倍，不同地区之间相差9倍。全球平均电网下，中档模型的中间类别因子为每百万计费Token 0.039千克二氧化碳当量。实际应用案例显示，200人公司的年排放量为8.5千克二氧化碳当量，而使用智能编码工具的50名开发人员的排放量在2.1吨到8.3吨之间。
AI.conclusion: 本文提出的基于Token的AI推理碳足迹核算方法和公开数据集，能够显著提升企业温室气体清单中Scope 3碳排放核算的准确性，揭示了不同模型与地区间巨大的排放差异。
AI.translation: 采购的人工智能（AI）推理属于企业温室气体清单的范围3类别1，然而实践中往往忽略它或应用基于支出的计算因子，这比物理估计高出1.7到12.3倍，且无法区分不同的模型或地区。本文提出了一种基于Token的方法和公开数据集：包括从摇篮到大门的边界、四个级别的活动数据、有效Token基础、四项计算因子（服务器电力、内含硬件、数据中心建设、披露的最终训练运行）以及将任何模型标识符和地区解析为因子的规则。推理碳足迹在模型类别之间相差12倍，在地区之间相差9倍。在全球平均电网下，中档模型因子为每百万计费Token 0.039千克二氧化碳当量（$CO_2e$），处于结构范围的低端：效率较低的服务配置将其提高2.8倍，将训练项替换为所有模型开发则使其提高1.5到2.9倍。输入区间本身带来-18%至+29%的变化。已发表的可描述中档模型的单次查询能耗估计值为中档模型能耗的2.4到7.2倍，其中四分之三高于其结构范围；可描述前沿模型的估计值则在0.7到1.6倍之间。具体算例显示：一个200人的公司每年产生8.5千克 $CO_2e$，50名使用中档模型智能编码工具的开发人员产生2.1吨，使用前沿模型则产生8.3吨。本研究的贡献在于提供了一个可追溯的数值，但其相对于实际计量能耗的准确性尚未经过测试。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种基于Token的方法和公开数据集，用于准确核算企业温室气体清单中采购的AI推理碳足迹，解决了现有基于支出方法的偏差问题，并为不同模型和地区的排放量提供了可追溯的估算标准。
AI.keywords: 人工智能推理, 温室气体清单, 碳足迹, Token基础方法, 范围3排放
AI.comments: 该论文针对企业温室气体清单中采购AI推理服务计量缺失或粗糙的问题，创新性地提出了一种基于Token的方法和公开数据集，为精细化核算AI的碳足迹提供了切实可行的路径。尽管准确性有待实际能耗计量验证，但其方法学具有重要的前瞻性和实用价值。

title: Sparse Polynomial GCD Cannot Be Computed in Fixed-output Polynomial Time
summary: This paper shows that, assuming $\mathsf{P}\ne\mathsf{NP}$, sparse univariate polynomial GCD cannot be computed in fixed-output polynomial time over any fixed computable field. Precisely, there is no deterministic algorithm that can compute the GCD of sparse univariate polynomials over any fixed computable field with total bit complexity polynomial in the input size, with the output size as a fixed parameter. In particular, there is no deterministic algorithm for sparse polynomial GCD that runs in polynomial time with respect to both the input and the output sizes. This settles the open problem posed as Challenge 5 in the sparsity challenges. Furthermore, we show that the Roots of Unity Detection problem over finite fields is NP-hard under random reductions; that is, determining whether the GCD of a sparse univariate polynomial and $x^n - 1$ has nonzero degree is NP-hard.

AI.title_translation: 稀疏多项式最大公约数无法在固定输出多项式时间内计算
AI.tldr: 本文证明了在P不等于NP的假设下，稀疏单变量多项式最大公约数（GCD）无法在固定输出的多项式时间内计算，解决了该领域的长期公开问题。
AI.motivation: 旨在解决关于稀疏多项式GCD计算复杂性的长期公开问题（即稀疏性挑战中的Challenge 5），探究其是否能在固定输出多项式时间内被计算。
AI.method: 利用计算复杂性理论进行归纳证明，假设P不等于NP，并证明有限域上的单位根检测问题在随机归约下是NP难的。
AI.result: 证明了在任意固定可计算域上，假设P不等于NP，不存在能在输入及固定输出大小下以多项式时间运行的确定性算法来计算稀疏多项式GCD；同时证明了有限域上的单位根检测问题在随机归约下是NP难的。
AI.conclusion: 在P不等于NP的假设下，稀疏单变量多项式GCD无法在固定输出多项式时间内计算，彻底解决了该领域的一个公开挑战问题。
AI.translation: 本文表明，在假设$\mathsf{P}\ne\mathsf{NP}$的情况下，稀疏单变量多项式最大公约数（GCD）无法在任何固定可计算域上的固定输出多项式时间内计算。精确地说，在任何固定可计算域上，不存在总位复杂度为输入大小的多项式、且输出大小作为固定参数的确定性算法来计算稀疏单变量多项式的GCD。特别地，不存在针对稀疏多项式GCD且同时关于输入和输出大小均以多项式时间运行的确定性算法。这解决了作为稀疏性挑战中挑战5提出的公开问题。此外，我们证明了有限域上的单位根检测问题在随机归约下是NP难的；也就是说，确定稀疏单变量多项式与$x^n - 1$的GCD是否具有非零度是NP难的。
AI.summary: 本文在P不等于NP的假设下，证明了稀疏单变量多项式GCD无法在任意固定可计算域上的固定输出多项式时间内计算，从而解决了稀疏挑战中的第5项公开挑战。此外，作者还证明了有限域上的单位根检测问题在随机归约下是NP难的。
AI.keywords: 稀疏多项式, 最大公约数 (GCD), 计算复杂性, NP难度, 有限域
AI.comments: 该论文在计算复杂性理论和符号计算领域具有重要意义，解决了稀疏性挑战中的长期公开问题（Challenge 5）。其创新之处在于结合了复杂性理论（P不等于NP假设）证明了稀疏多项式GCD在固定输出多项式时间内不可解。

title: Learning What to Say to Your VLA: Mostly Harmless Vision Language Action Model Steering
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide a natural language interface to robot control, but the mapping from language to behavior is often brittle and unintuitive: semantically similar instructions can induce drastically different behaviors, while some capabilities may not be elicitable through prompting alone. As a result, both human instructions and zero-shot language models can fail to reliably steer VLAs toward successful task execution. In this work, we propose a framework that interactively searches for language sequences that improve closed-loop VLA task performance, distills these sequences into a test-time language feedback policy (LFP), and learns an improvement head that predicts when language steering will improve performance. We conformalize this improvement head to prevent harmful steering interventions, where the LFP decreases task performance relative to the original instruction on out-of-distribution scenarios. Crucially, our approach operates on arbitrary frozen pre-trained VLAs, requiring neither access to the original training distribution nor fine-tuning of the underlying model. On seen environments, our conformalized LFP improves base VLA performance by 24.7% in simulation and 65.0% in hardware. On visual and semantic perturbations with calibration samples, our conformalized LFP has strong harmlessness guarantees, and produces recovery behaviors not observed with open-loop prompting.

AI.title_translation: 学习如何对你的VLA说话：大体无害的视觉语言动作模型引导
AI.tldr: 无需微调底层视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，通过学习语言反馈策略和共形化干预机制，显著提升机器人任务执行性能并保证无害性。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型虽然提供了自然语言控制接口，但其映射关系通常较为脆弱且不直观，语义相似的指令可能导致截然不同的行为，单纯依靠提示词无法可靠地引导VLA成功执行任务。
AI.method: 提出一个交互式搜索最优语言序列的框架，将其蒸馏为测试时语言反馈策略（LFP），并学习一个改进头来预测语言引导的效果，同时利用共形化（conformalization）技术防止分布外场景下的有害干预。
AI.result: 在已见环境中，共形化的LFP在仿真中将基础VLA的性能提升了24.7%，在真实硬件上提升了65.0%；同时在面对视觉和语义扰动时表现出很强的无害性保证，并能产生开环提示无法观察到的恢复行为。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功提出了一种名为LFP的测试时语言反馈策略和共形化改进头，在不修改底层VLA模型的前提下，有效提升了机器人在面对视觉和语义扰动时的任务执行性能，并提供了无害性保证。
AI.translation: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型为机器人控制提供了自然语言接口，但语言到行为的映射通常是脆弱且不直观的：语义相似的指令可能引发截然不同的行为，而某些能力可能无法仅通过提示来激发。因此，人类指令和零样本语言模型都无法可靠地引导VLA成功执行任务。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个框架，该框架交互式地搜索能够改善闭环VLA任务性能的语言序列，将这些序列蒸馏为测试时语言反馈策略（LFP），并学习一个预测语言引导何时能改善性能的改进头。我们对该改进头进行共形化处理，以防止有害的引导干预——在这些干预中，LFP在分布外场景下相对于原始指令降低了任务性能。至关重要的是，我们的方法适用于任意冻既有的预训练VLA，既不需要访问原始训练分布，也不需要对底层模型进行微调。在已见环境中，我们的共形化LFP在仿真中将基础VLA性能提升了24.7%，在硬件上提升了65.0%。在具有校准样本的视觉和语义扰动下，我们的共形化LFP具有很强的无害性保证，并能产生开环提示所未观察到的恢复行为。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的无害化引导框架，无需对底层模型进行微调，通过搜索和蒸馏语言反馈策略，并利用共形化机制防止有害干预，显著提升了机器人控制的性能和鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 视觉-语言-动作模型, 模型引导, 语言反馈, 共形预测, 机器人控制
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种在测试时引导视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的方法，通过交互式搜索最优语言序列、蒸馏策略并结合共形化（conformalization）机制防止有害干预。其最大亮点在于无需微调底层模型即可显著提升VLA的鲁棒性和性能，在仿真和真实硬件实验中均表现出色，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Dual-State Slot Attention: Decoupling Appearance and Identity for Video Object-Centric Learning
summary:
Unsupervised video object-centric learning aims to decompose dynamic scenes into persistent, object-level representations without supervision. However, existing slot-based methods struggle to maintain stable object identity in challenging settings such as rapid motion and partial occlusion. First, they typically encode both the per-frame appearance of an object and its identity across frames in a single slot vector, creating an objective conflict that leads to slot swapping: reconstruction requires sensitivity to transient visual changes, whereas temporal consistency requires invariance to them. Second, the token renormalization used in Slot Attention can amplify weakly attending slots, allowing them to absorb tokens from other objects and destabilize slot-to-object correspondence.
  We propose Dual-State Slot Attention (DSSA), a fully self-supervised framework that addresses these limitations by separating appearance from identity and by reducing spurious updates from weakly matching slots. DSSA decomposes each slot into a local state for per-frame appearance and an identity state for temporally stable object information, thereby aligning reconstruction and temporal consistency with separate representations. The identity state is updated through a learned recurrent transition that acts as a temporal filter on the local state, while competition-modulated aggregation (CMA) down-weights updates from weakly matching slots and prevents them from absorbing tokens from other objects. Experiments on MOVi-C, MOVi-D, and YouTube-VIS demonstrate that DSSA consistently improves segmentation quality and temporal consistency over prior methods, while also yielding stronger downstream object recognition and video dynamics prediction. Code is available at \href{https://uark-aicv.github.io/dssa/}{\texttt{uark-aicv.github.io/dssa}}.

AI.title_translation: 双状态槽注意力：为视频目标中心学习解耦外观与身份
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为DSSA的无监督视频目标学习框架，通过将外观和身份状态解耦并改进聚合机制，显著提升了视频中目标分割的时序稳定性和一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于槽的无监督视频目标学习方法在快速运动和部分遮挡等挑战性场景下难以保持稳定的目标身份。原因在于：1）单一槽向量同时编码外观和身份导致目标冲突和槽交换；2）传统的token重新归一化会放大弱关注的槽，破坏槽与目标的对应关系。
AI.method: 提出了双状态槽注意力（DSSA）框架。将每个槽分解为用于逐帧外观的局部状态和用于时序稳定目标信息的身份状态；身份状态通过学习得到的循环转换进行更新；引入竞争调节聚合（CMA）来降低弱匹配槽的更新权重。
AI.result: 在MOVi-C、MOVi-D和YouTube-VIS数据集上的实验表明，DSSA在分割质量和时序一致性方面一致优于以往方法，并增强了下游的目标识别和视频动态预测能力。
AI.conclusion: DSSA通过解耦外观与身份状态以及改进聚合机制，有效解决了现有基于槽的视频目标学习方法中的槽交换和不稳定性问题，提升了视频理解和分割的性能。
AI.translation:
无监督视频目标中心学习旨在无需监督的情况下将动态场景分解为持久的目标级表示。然而，现有的基于槽的方法在快速运动和部分遮挡等具有挑战性的设置中很难保持稳定的目标身份。首先，它们通常在一个槽向量中编码对象的每帧外观及其跨帧身份，从而产生导致槽交换的目标冲突：重建需要对瞬时视觉变化敏感，而时间一致性需要对它们保持不变。其次，槽注意力中使用的token重新归一化可以放大弱注意力的槽，使它们能够从其他对象中吸收token并破坏槽与对象的对应关系。
我们提出了双状态槽注意力（DSSA），这是一种完全自监督的框架，它通过将外观与身份分离以及减少来自弱匹配槽的虚假更新来解决这些局限性。DSSA将每个槽分解为用于每帧外观的局部状态和用于时间稳定对象信息的身份状态，从而通过单独的表示对齐重建和时间一致性。身份状态通过学习的循环转换进行更新，该转换充当局部状态的时间滤波器，而竞争调制聚合（CMA）则降低了来自弱匹配槽的更新权重，并防止它们吸收来自其他对象的token。在MOVi-C、MOVi-D和YouTube-VIS上的实验表明，DSSA在分割质量和时间一致性方面始终优于先前的方法，同时也产生更强的下游对象识别和视频动态预测。代码可在 \href{https://uark-aicv.github.io/dssa/}{\texttt{uark-aicv.github.io/dssa}} 获取。
AI.summary: 论文提出了双状态槽注意力（DSSA）框架，通过将外观和身份解耦到不同的槽状态中，并利用竞争调节聚合来防止虚假更新，从而解决了无监督视频目标中心化学习中的身份不稳定和槽交换问题。
AI.keywords: 视频目标中心化学习, 无监督学习, 槽注意力, 身份与外观解耦, 目标分割
AI.comments: 该论文针对无监督视频目标中心化学习中的核心难点（身份漂移和槽位混淆），创新性地提出了“双状态槽注意力（DSSA）”机制，通过解耦外观与身份，并引入竞争调节聚合，显著提升了视频分割的稳定性和时序一致性，方法设计合理且实验充分。

title: TSA: Temporal Slot Activation for Persistent Object-Centric Video Representation
summary: Unsupervised video object-centric learning aims to decompose dynamic scenes into temporally persistent entity representations. Existing recurrent video slot-attention methods propagate a fixed set of slots across frames, but typically assume unconditional slot propagation: every slot is updated and decoded at every frame, regardless of whether its corresponding object is visible. We show that this design violates a basic lifecycle requirement for persistent slots: when an object is absent or fully occluded, its slot should preserve its previous state and avoid explaining unrelated visible content. Instead, unconditional propagation creates update-induced state drift, where current-frame evidence overwrites the absent object's representation, and decoder-induced reconstruction interference, where the inactive slot remains coupled to reconstruction through decoder attention. We propose Temporal Slot Activation (TSA), a lightweight mechanism that learns a per-slot, per-frame activation score $α_{k,t}\in(0,1)$ without visibility supervision. TSA uses this activation as a shared latent control variable for slot lifecycle modeling. When a slot is inactive, TSA anchors its state to the previous slot via activation-gated updating and suppresses its decoder participation through an activation-dependent additive bias on attention logits before softmax normalization. This jointly reduces state drift and reconstruction-driven interference. To improve decisions under partial occlusion and gradual reappearance, TSA further conditions activation prediction on a per-slot temporal memory produced by a Temporal Context Encoder. We evaluate TSA on MOVi-C, MOVi-E, YTVIS-HQ, and the occlusion-heavy OVIS benchmarks, using standard (FG-ARI, mBO) and tracking-based (IDF1, HOTA) metrics. TSA improves object decomposition and temporal identity preservation, with large gains on long, heavily occluded videos.

AI.title_translation: TSA：用于持久目标中心视频表示的时间槽激活机制
AI.tldr: 提出时间槽激活（TSA）机制，通过动态控制槽的生命周期，解决了视频目标中心学习中的状态漂移与重建干扰问题，大幅提升了遮挡场景下的物体分解与追踪性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的循环视频槽注意力方法采用无条件槽传播，无论对象是否可见都在每一帧更新和解码所有槽，这导致了状态漂移（当前帧证据覆盖了消失对象的表示）和重建干扰（不活动的槽仍然通过解码器注意力与重建耦合），违背了持久槽的基本生命周期要求。
AI.method: 提出了时间槽激活（TSA）机制，无需可见性监督，学习每个槽每帧的激活分数。利用激活分数作为潜控制变量，通过激活门控更新锚定槽状态，并通过注意力逻辑上的激活依赖加法偏差抑制解码器参与。此外，引入时间上下文编码器以改善部分遮挡和逐渐重新出现时的激活决策。
AI.result: 在 MOVi-C、MOVi-E、YTVIS-HQ 和以遮挡为主的 OVIS 基准测试上进行了评估，使用标准指标（FG-ARI、mBO）和基于跟踪的指标（IDF1、HOTA），结果表明 TSA 改善了物体分解和时间身份保持，在长视频和严重遮挡的视频上取得了巨大提升。
AI.conclusion: 通过引入轻量级的时间槽激活机制（TSA），该方法有效解决了视频目标中心学习中的状态漂移和重建干扰问题，在长视频和严重遮挡基准测试中展现出优异的物体分解和时序一致性性能。
AI.translation: 无监督视频目标中心学习旨在将动态场景分解为时间上持久的实体表示。现有的循环视频槽注意力方法在各帧之间传播一组固定的槽，但通常假设无条件槽传播：无论其对应对象是否可见，每个槽都在每一帧进行更新和解码。我们表明，这种设计违反了持久槽的基本生命周期要求：当对象不存在或完全被遮挡时，其槽应保留其先前状态并避免解释不相关的可见内容。相反，无条件传播会产生更新引起的状态漂移（当前帧证据覆盖了缺失对象的表示）以及解码器引起的重建 interference（不活动的槽通过解码器注意力保持与重建的耦合）。我们提出了时间槽激活（TSA），这是一种轻量级机制，它在没有可见性监督的情况下学习每个槽每帧的激活分数 $\alpha_{k,t}\in(0,1)$。TSA 使用此激活作为槽生命周期建模的共享潜控制变量。当槽处于不活动状态时，TSA 通过激活门控更新将其实态锚定到先前的槽，并在 softmax 归一化之前通过对注意力 logits 施加激活依赖的加法偏置来抑制其解码器参与。这共同减少了状态漂移和重建驱动的干扰。为了改善部分遮挡和逐渐重新出现时的决策，TSA 进一步将激活预测条件化于由时间上下文编码器生成的每槽时间记忆。我们在 MOVi-C、MOVi-E、YTVIS-HQ 和重度遮挡的 OVIS 基准上使用标准（FG-ARI、mBO）和基于跟踪的（IDF1、HOTA）指标评估了 TSA。TSA 改善了物体分解和时间身份保持，在长且严重遮挡的视频上取得了巨大提升。
AI.summary: 该论文提出了一种名为时间槽激活（TSA）的轻量级机制，用于无监督视频目标中心学习中的时序持久对象表示。TSA 通过学习每槽每帧的激活分数，动态控制槽的更新与解码参与，有效解决了无条件槽传播带来的状态漂移和重建干扰问题，并在长视频和重度遮挡场景中表现出显著优势。
AI.keywords: 视频目标中心学习, 无监督学习, 槽注意力机制, 时序持久性, 物体遮挡
AI.comments: 该论文针对视频目标中心学习中传统无条件槽传播导致的“状态漂移”和“重建干扰”问题，提出了时间槽激活（TSA）机制。其创新之处在于无需显式可见性监督，通过自适应激活分数控制槽的更新和解码参与度，显著提升了模型在长视频和严重遮挡场景下的物体分解与时序身份保持能力。

title: SidewalkBench: Benchmarking Visual Navigation on Urban Sidewalks
summary: Urban sidewalk navigation presents significant challenges due to complex structural layouts, dynamic pedestrian behaviors, and long distances. While recent visual navigation models offer a promising solution, the lack of a unified benchmark hinders quantitative and reproducible evaluation. To bridge this gap, we propose SidewalkBench, a comprehensive benchmark designed for visual navigation on urban sidewalks. Built upon NVIDIA Isaac Sim, SidewalkBench brings GPU-accelerated simulation of diverse, high-fidelity sidewalk environments, including both procedurally generated and real-world scanned scenes. We further populate the scenes with rich, reactive event-based pedestrian behaviors and flexible, efficient animation, enabling standardized model evaluation under realistic real-world settings. We conduct a comprehensive evaluation of 9 visual navigation models on 330 unit-test scenarios, 800 pedestrian-reactive scenarios, and 105 long-horizon scenarios. Our findings highlight that pedestrian interaction and long-horizon robustness remain critical bottlenecks for existing models, and scaling up sidewalk training with synthetic data emerges as a promising solution.

AI.title_translation: SidewalkBench：城市人行道视觉导航基准测试
AI.tldr: 本文推出了SidewalkBench——首个针对城市人行道视觉导航的全面仿真基准，评估发现行人交互和长视距鲁棒性是现有模型的关键瓶颈。
AI.motivation: 由于缺乏统一的基准，复杂结构布局、动态行人行为以及长距离导航等挑战阻碍了城市人行道视觉导航模型的定量和可复现评估。
AI.method: 基于NVIDIA Isaac Sim构建了包含程序生成和真实扫描场景的高仿真环境，并加入了响应式、事件驱动的行人行为，对9个视觉导航模型在330个单元测试场景、800个行人交互场景以及105个长视距场景下进行了综合评估。
AI.result: 通过对9个视觉导航模型在多达1235个各种场景下的测试，发现行人交互和长视距鲁棒性是现有模型的主要瓶颈，且通过合成数据扩展人行道训练展现出良好的前景。
AI.conclusion: 现有视觉导航模型在人行道交互和长视距鲁棒性方面仍面临瓶颈，利用合成数据进行大规模训练是解决该问题的有效途径。
AI.translation: 城市人行道导航由于复杂的结构布局、动态的行人行为和长距离，带来了巨大的挑战。虽然最近的视觉导航模型提供了一个有前景的解决方案，但缺乏统一的基准阻碍了定量和可复现的评估。为了弥补这一空白，我们提出了SidewalkBench，一个专为城市人行道视觉导航设计的综合基准。基于NVIDIA Isaac Sim，SidewalkBench带来了多样化、高保真人行道环境的GPU加速模拟，包括程序生成的场景和真实世界扫描的场景。我们进一步在场景中填充了丰富、反应式的基于事件的行人行为和灵活、高效的动画，从而能够在现实世界设置下对模型进行标准化评估。我们对9个视觉导航模型在330个单元测试场景、800个行人反应场景以及105个长视距场景中进行了全面评估。我们的研究结果表明，行人交互和长视距鲁棒性仍然是现有模型的关键瓶颈，而利用合成数据扩大人行道训练成为了一种有前景的解决方案。
AI.summary: 本文提出了SidewalkBench，这是一个基于NVIDIA Isaac Sim的城市人行道视觉导航综合基准，集成了高保真场景和动态行人行为，并通过对现有模型的广泛评估揭示了当前视觉导航技术在人行道导航中的瓶颈与改进方向。
AI.keywords: SidewalkBench, 视觉导航, 城市人行道, 仿真基准, 动态行人行为
AI.comments: SidewalkBench填补了城市人行道视觉导航标准化基准的空白，结合了高仿真模拟和丰富的动态人群行为测试，对评估和提升机器人在复杂城市环境中的导航能力具有重要意义。

title: WireCraft: A Simulation Benchmark for Industrial DLO Manipulation
comments: Accepted at CoRL 2026 (Spotlight). Camera-ready version with additional simulation and real-robot experiments. 29 pages including references and appendices
summary: Deformable Linear Objects (DLOs), such as wires and cables, are central to industrial assembly. Unlike rigid objects, whose state is captured by a 6-DoF pose, DLOs have an infinite-dimensional configuration space and deform continuously under contact with grippers, fixtures, and the workspace, making them a demanding benchmark for general dexterous manipulation. Despite their importance, policy development and comparison remain difficult: existing benchmarks are often tied to specific hardware setups, lack modular and customizable task assets, or study generic deformable-object tasks without the fixtures relevant to real-world industrial wire manipulation. Few benchmarks align simulation, real-world data, and shared evaluation protocols. To bridge this gap, we introduce WireCraft, a simulation benchmark for industrial DLO manipulation with configurable difficulty and assets, spanning three task families: connector insertion, clip routing, and channel seating. It supports two complementary DLO physics models, articulated and deformable, and the released trajectories come from both simulation and a physical UR5. We benchmark reinforcement learning (RL), imitation learning (IL), and vision-language-action (VLA) policies under shared metrics. Privileged state-based RL solves a representative setting in each task family with over 82% success, confirming the tasks are well-posed. Image-based policies remain less successful across the evaluated tasks, with ACT and DiT VLA falling below privileged State PPO. On a physical UR5, supplementing real demonstrations with simulated data improves success by 15-65 percentage points in the best-performing mixture for each task. These results indicate that industrial DLO manipulation, though tractable under privileged state, remains an open challenge for current vision-based learning.
comment: Accepted at CoRL 2026 (Spotlight). Camera-ready version with additional simulation and real-robot experiments. 29 pages including references and appendices

AI.title_translation: WireCraft：用于工业DLO操作的仿真基准
AI.tldr: 本文提出了工业柔性线性物体（DLO）操作的仿真基准WireCraft，发现特权状态强化学习表现优异而视觉策略仍具挑战，且仿真数据可显著提升真实机器人的任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有的DLO操作基准往往局限于特定的硬件设置，缺乏模块化和可定制的任务资产，或者未考虑真实工业环境中的夹具，且很少将仿真、真实世界数据和共享评估协议对齐。为了弥补这一空白，开发了WireCraft。
AI.method: 引入WireCraft仿真基准，包含三种任务家族（连接器插入、夹子布线、通道就座），支持铰链和可变形两种DLO物理模型，并收集了仿真与物理UR5的轨迹数据，以此基准评估了强化学习（RL）、模仿学习（IL）和视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略。
AI.result: 特权状态基RL在每个任务家族中实现了超过82%的成功率；基于图像的策略（如ACT和DiT VLA）表现较差；在物理UR5上，用仿真数据补充真实演示可将最佳表现混合模型的成功率提高15至65个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 工业DLO操作在特权状态下可行，但对于当前的视觉基础学习来说仍然是一个开放的挑战，而结合仿真数据能显著提升真实机器人的操作成功率。
AI.translation: 可变形线性物体（DLO），如电线和电缆，是工业装配的核心。与刚体（其状态由6自由度位姿捕获）不同，DLO具有无限维的构型空间，并且在与夹具、夹具和工作空间的接触下会连续变形，这使其成为通用灵巧操作的一个严峻基准。尽管它们很重要，但策略开发和比较仍然很困难：现有的基准通常与特定的硬件设置绑定，缺乏模块化和可定制的任务资产，或者研究通用的可变形物体任务而没有与现实世界工业电线操作相关的夹具。很少有基准能够对齐仿真、真实世界数据和共享评估协议。为了弥补这一差距，我们推出了WireCraft，这是一个用于工业DLO操作的仿真基准，具有可配置的难度和资产，涵盖三个任务家族：连接器插入、夹子布线和通道就座。它支持两种互补的DLO物理模型（关节式和可变形），发布的轨迹来自仿真和物理UR5。我们在共享指标下对强化学习（RL）、模仿学习（IL）和视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略进行了基准测试。基于特权状态的RL在每个任务家族的代表性设置中解决了问题，成功率超过82%，证明了这些任务是适定的。在评估的任务中，基于图像的策略仍然不太成功，ACT和DiT VLA低于特权状态PPO。在物理UR5上，用仿真数据补充真实演示可使每个任务中表现最好的混合模型的成功率提高15-65个百分点。这些结果表明，工业DLO操作虽然在特权状态下是可行的，但对于当前的视觉学习来说仍然是一个开放的挑战。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了WireCraft，这是一个针对工业可变形线性物体（DLO）操作的仿真基准。它具有可配置的难度和资产，涵盖三个任务家族，支持两种物理模型，并提供了仿真和真实机器人的轨迹。通过对RL、IL和VLA策略的基准测试，表明特权状态下的RL效果较好，但视觉策略仍面临挑战，同时引入仿真数据能有效提升真实机器人的任务成功率。
AI.keywords: Deformable Linear Objects, Simulation Benchmark, Industrial Manipulation, Reinforcement Learning, Vision-Language-Action Models
AI.comments: 该论文填补了工业柔性线性物体（DLO）操作仿真基准的空白，结合了多种物理模型、任务家族及仿真与真实数据，为评估RL、IL和VLA算法提供了标准化平台，突显了基于视觉的学习在DLO操作中的挑战与仿真数据对现实物理机器人的显著增益。

title: PragReST: Self-Reinforcing Counterfactual Reasoning for Pragmatic Language Understanding
comments: EMNLP Camera-Ready. First two authors contributed equally. Code and models: https://github.com/jihyung803/PragReST
summary: Natural language understanding often depends on meanings that are implied rather than explicitly stated, requiring pragmatic reasoning. Despite strong performance on math and logical reasoning, large language models (LLMs) still struggle with making pragmatic inferences, often choosing literal interpretations. To improve LLM pragmatic reasoning, we introduce PragReST, a self-supervised framework that constructs pragmatic QA data, generates counterfactual reasoning traces, and trains models to internalize them through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning, without human-labeled training data or distillation from a stronger teacher. Across four pragmatic benchmarks (PragMega, Ludwig, MetoQA, and AltPrag), PragReST improves over backbone models, task-specific pragmatic tuning baselines, and non-counterfactual variants of the same pipeline. On accuracy-based benchmarks, PragReST improves over the instruct backbone by 5.37 and 5.50% (absolute) for Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-14B, respectively. Our error analysis and ablations underscore the importance of counterfactual reasoning: PragReST primarily reduces errors caused by failures to contrast observed utterances with plausible alternatives, and removing counterfactual reasoning substantially reduces performance. Moreover, our training preserves out-of-domain performance on general-knowledge and mathematical reasoning benchmarks.
comment: EMNLP Camera-Ready. First two authors contributed equally. Code and models: https://github.com/jihyung803/PragReST

AI.title_translation: PragReST：用于语用语言理解的自我增强反事实推理
AI.tldr: 提出PragReST自监督反事实推理框架，在无需人工标注数据的情况下，显著提升了大语言模型的语用理解能力，克服了其倾向于字面解释的缺陷。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在数学和逻辑推理方面表现出色，但往往受限于字面解释，难以进行依赖隐含意义的语用推理。
AI.method: 引入了PragReST自监督框架，该框架构建语用问答数据，生成反事实推理轨迹，并通过监督微调和强化学习使模型内部化这些推理能力，无需人工标注或教师模型蒸馏。
AI.result: 在四个语用基准测试（PragMega、Ludwig、MetoQA和AltPrag）中，PragReST显著优于骨干模型、任务特定微调基线以及非反事实变体。准确率方面，Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-14B模型在使用PragReST后绝对准确率分别提升了5.37%和5.50%，同时保留了通用知识和数学推理的域外性能。
AI.conclusion: PragReST框架通过自监督数据构建与反事实推理训练，有效提升了大语言模型理解隐含意义的语用推理能力，且不损害其通用推理性能。
AI.translation: 自然语言理解通常依赖于暗示而非明确陈述的含义，这需要语用推理。尽管大语言模型（LLM）在数学和逻辑推理方面表现出强劲的性能，但它们仍然难以进行语用推理，常常选择字面解释。为了提升LLM的语用推理能力，我们推出了PragReST，这是一个自监督框架，它构建语用QA数据，生成反事实推理轨迹，并通过监督微调和强化学习训练模型将其内部化，而无需人工标注的训练数据或来自更强教师模型的蒸馏。在四个语用基准（PragMega、Ludwig、MetoQA和AltPrag）上，PragReST超越了骨干模型、特定任务的语用微调基线以及同一管道的非反事实变体。在基于准确率的基准上，Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-14B的instruct骨干模型的准确率分别绝对提高了5.37%和5.50%。我们的错误分析和消融实验强调了反事实推理的重要性：PragReST主要减少了因未能将观察到的语句与合理的替代方案进行对比而导致的错误，并且去除反事实推理会大幅降低性能。此外，我们的训练保留了模型在通用知识和数学推理基准上的域外性能。
AI.summary: 论文提出了PragReST，一个用于提升大语言模型语用理解能力的自增强反事实推理框架。该框架无需人工标注数据，利用自监督方式生成语用QA数据及反事实推理轨迹，通过监督微调和强化学习训练模型，显著提升了模型对隐含意义的理解准确率，同时保持了通用能力。
AI.keywords: Pragmatic Language Understanding, Counterfactual Reasoning, Self-Reinforcing, Large Language Models, Reinforcement Learning
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种自增强的反事实推理框架PragReST，解决了大语言模型在语用理解（即理解言外之意）上面临的字面解释偏差问题。无需人工标注数据或更强教师模型的蒸馏，该方法通过自我监督构建数据并结合监督微调与强化学习，在多个语用基准测试中取得了显著性能提升，同时保持了模型在通用知识和数学推理领域的域外泛化能力，具有很高的实用价值。

title: Beyond Tokenization: Direct Timestep Embedding and Contrastive Alignment for Time-Series Question Answering
summary: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have given rise to time-series question answering (TSQA), which formulates time-series analysis as natural-language question answering. However, directly feeding raw numerical series into LLMs suffers from a tokenization bottleneck: Byte Pair Encoding fragments continuous values into unstable tokens whose embeddings lack meaningful metric structure, resulting in the loss of magnitude, scale, and trend information. Prior methods use patch-based encoders that split the series into fixed windows, locking in one granularity that breaks patterns and hides exact timesteps, through a separate module that rarely transfers across datasets with different lengths or sampling rates. To address this challenge, we propose CADE (Contrastive Alignment with Direct Embedding), a novel framework for TSQA built upon two key components: direct timestep embedding and semantic alignment. The proposed framework maps each timestep directly into the LLM embedding space through a point-wise linear encoder and MLP projector, preserving exact index-level access while eliminating the need for patching and padding. To further bridge the semantic gap between time-series and language representations, we introduce a novel one-directional supervised contrastive loss that aligns time-series embeddings with frozen class-name text anchors. Experimental results on the public Time-MQA benchmark demonstrate that our framework consistently improves performance across six TSQA tasks, outperforming both open-source and proprietary LLM baselines.

AI.title_translation: 超越分词：时间序列问答的直接时间步嵌入与对比对齐
AI.tldr: 论文提出了CADE框架，通过直接时间步嵌入和对比对齐技术，解决了大语言模型处理时间序列时的分词瓶颈问题，显著提升了时间序列问答的性能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在时间序列问答（TSQA）中直接处理原始数值序列时会遇到“分词瓶颈”：字节对编码将连续值分割为不稳定的标记，导致幅度、尺度和趋势信息的丢失；而传统基于分块的方法则会破坏局部模式、隐藏精确的时间步，且难以泛化到不同长度或采样率的数据集。
AI.method: 提出了CADE（Contrastive Alignment with Direct Embedding）框架，包含两项核心组件：一是通过逐点线性编码器和MLP投影器将每个时间步直接映射到大语言模型嵌入空间（无需分块和填充）；二是引入单向监督对比损失，将时间序列嵌入与冻结的类别名称文本锚点进行对齐。
AI.result: 在公开的Time-MQA基准数据集上的实验结果表明，该框架在六个TSQA任务上均持续提升了性能，表现优于开源和闭源的大语言模型基线。
AI.conclusion: CADE框架通过直接时间步嵌入和对比语义对齐，有效解决了大语言模型在时间序列问答中的分词瓶颈和跨模态语义鸿沟问题，在各项任务上显著优于现有基线。
AI.translation: 大语言模型的最新进展催生了时间序列问答（TSQA），它将时间序列分析公式化为自然语言问答。然而，直接将原始数值序列输入大语言模型会遭受分词瓶颈：字节对编码将连续值碎片化为不稳定的标记，其嵌入缺乏有意义的度量结构，从而导致幅度、尺度和趋势信息的丢失。先前的方法使用基于分块的编码器将序列分割为固定窗口，这锁定了一种会破坏模式并隐藏精确时间步的单一粒度，且通过很难在具有不同长度或采样率的数据集之间迁移的独立模块来实现。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了CADE（具有直接嵌入的对比对齐），这是一个建立在两个核心组件之上的新型TSQA框架：直接时间步嵌入和语义 alignment（对齐）。所提出的框架通过逐点线性编码器和MLP投影器将每个时间步直接映射到大语言模型嵌入空间中，在保留精确的索引级访问的同时消除了对分块和填充的需求。为了进一步弥合时间序列与语言表示之间的语义鸿沟，我们引入了一种新颖的单向监督对比损失，将时间序列嵌入与冻结的类别名称文本锚点对齐。公开的Time-MQA基准测试上的实验结果表明，我们的框架在六个TSQA任务上持续提升了性能，表现优于开源和闭源的大语言模型基线。
AI.summary: 该论文针对大语言模型在时间序列问答中面临的分词瓶颈与分辨率丢失问题，提出了一种名为CADE的新框架。该框架通过直接时间步嵌入和监督对比语义对齐，在无需分块的前提下精确保留了时间序列的特征，并在多个基准任务上超越了现有基线。
AI.keywords: Time-Series Question Answering, Large Language Models, Tokenization Bottleneck, Contrastive Alignment, Direct Timestep Embedding
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地跳过了传统的时间序列分块与文本分词瓶颈，提出了直接时间步嵌入与对比对齐方法，在时间序列问答任务上取得了优异的性能，具有很强的实用价值和泛化能力。

title: Evidence-Bound Gateway-Path Provenance for Third-Party LLM Inference
comments: 13 pages, 4 figures. Expanded protocol model and security analysis of authorization, request/stream binding, charge integrity, metadata leakage, and runtime lifecycle; existing measurements retained
summary: Third-party LLM gateways select providers, models, endpoints, and fallback paths while also authoring the records used to explain and bill those decisions. We present evidence-bound gateway-path provenance, which makes these decisions subject to client-verifiable request contracts. An attested mediation runtime intersects a signed service policy with the client's authorization, constructs provider-facing calls, and protects streamed responses. The contract distinguishes initial routes from fallback destinations and admits each transition only after an authorized failure. A signed close-out binds the execution trace, provider-reported usage, authorized pricing, and complete response. We formalize the protocol state machine and establish authorization preservation, execution and stream binding, charge integrity, and channel confidentiality relative to the public receipt metadata. The analysis also characterizes replay, runtime replacement, and the information disclosed by public payload commitments. Controlled software-path measurements show 0.442 ms paired p95 latency overhead at concurrency one, peak throughput of 10.65 thousand requests/s, and stream close-out below 0.4 ms p95. An AWS Nitro Enclaves prototype completed 30 live single-route streaming requests with attestation-bound session and signing keys. The design separates gateway administration from payload processing and supplies a verifiable account of each confirmed execution.
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures. Expanded protocol model and security analysis of authorization, request/stream binding, charge integrity, metadata leakage, and runtime lifecycle; existing measurements retained

AI.title_translation: 面向第三方LLM推理的证据绑定网关路径溯源
AI.tldr: 提出了一种用于第三方LLM推理的证据绑定网关路径溯源机制，确保路由决策和计费对客户端透明且可验证。
AI.motivation: 第三方LLM网关在选择提供商、模型、端点及故障转移路径时，同时拥有解释和计费决策记录的权力，缺乏透明度，无法保证客户端对决策的验证。
AI.method: 提出了一种基于证据绑定的网关路径溯源协议，利用受信的调解运行时将签名的服务策略与客户端授权相交，构建面向提供商的调用，保护流式响应，并通过带签名的结算凭证绑定执行轨迹、使用量、定价和完整响应。
AI.result: 控制软件路径测量显示在并发为1时p95延迟开销为0.442毫秒，峰值吞吐量达每秒10.65千个请求，流关闭p95低于0.4毫秒；AWS Nitro Enclaves原型成功完成了30个实时单路由流式请求。
AI.conclusion: 证据绑定网关路径溯源（EBGP）设计成功分离了网关管理与载荷处理，能够提供每次已确认执行的可验证审计账目，且性能开销极低。
AI.translation: 第三方LLM网关负责选择提供商、模型、端点以及故障转移路径，同时还编写用于解释和计费这些决策的记录。我们提出了证据绑定网关路径溯源（evidence-bound gateway-path provenance），使这些决策服从于客户端可验证的请求合同。一个经过认证的中介运行时将签名的服务策略与客户端的授权相交，构建面向提供商的调用，并保护流式响应。该合同区分了初始路由与故障转移目的地，并且仅在授权失败后才允许每次转换。签名的结算凭证（close-out）将执行轨迹、提供商报告的使用量、授权定价和完整响应绑定在一起。我们形式化了协议状态机，并确立了相对于公共收据元数据的授权保留、执行和流绑定、计费完整性以及通道机密性。分析还描述了重放、运行时替换以及公共有效负载承诺所泄露的信息。受控软件路径测量显示，在并发数为1时，配对的p95延迟开销为0.442毫秒，峰值吞吐量为每秒10.65千个请求，流结算的p95低于0.4毫秒。一个AWS Nitro Enclaves原型完成了30个带有认证绑定会话和签名密钥的实时单路由流式请求。该设计将网关管理与有效负载处理分离，并为每次确认的执行提供可验证的账目。
AI.summary: 本文提出了证据绑定的网关路径溯源（evidence-bound gateway-path provenance）机制，使第三方LLM网关的路由决策、故障转移和计费对客户端而言可验证，通过可信 mediation 运行时、密码学签名和严格的协议状态机，保障了授权保留、执行绑定、计费完整性和通道机密性。
AI.keywords: LLM网关, 溯源, 可信执行环境, 客户端验证, 计费完整性
AI.comments: 本文针对第三方LLM网关的信任与计费问题，创新性地提出了基于证据绑定的网关路径溯源机制（EBGP），通过可信执行环境、密码学签名和状态机形式化，实现了客户端可验证的路由决策、故障转移和计费完整性，兼具高吞吐和低延迟，对构建安全可信的AI基础设施具有重要意义。

title: Lychee-Reranker: Fast but Not Late Interaction for Compressed Document Reranking
summary: As retrieval systems scale, effective and efficient reranking becomes increasingly important. However, most existing encoder- and decoder-based rerankers jointly process every query--passage pair, tightly coupling their online computation and limiting deployment efficiency and flexibility. We present Lychee-Reranker, a fast but not late-interaction (FBNL) reranker that decouples query and passage computation while retaining expressive relevance modeling. Built on an encoder--decoder architecture, Lychee-Reranker pre-encodes passages using Matryoshka embedding pooling, while its decoder models system and user instructions together with query intent; cross-attention then captures fine-grained relevance between the resulting query context and passage representations. Together, these designs offer four key advantages: (i) efficiency from offline passage encoding, (ii) expressiveness from cross-attention, (iii) compactness from Matryoshka embedding pooling, and (iv) test-time compute through an adjustable compute budget. We instantiate Lychee-Reranker in three sizes, Nano, Small, and Large, with 0.27B, 1B, and 4B activated parameters, respectively. Extensive experiments on BEIR, MIRACL, and LMEB demonstrate strong reranking performance with superior efficiency. On BEIR and MIRACL, our models achieve competitive performance in multi-domain and multilingual reranking, on par with strong industrial rerankers such as the Qwen3/BGE-Reranker series. On LMEB-Dialogue, a compact embedding model paired with our Nano reranker, which has only 0.27B activated parameters, remains competitive with 7--12B embedding models. Lychee-Reranker was previously known as KaLM-Reranker-V1. Data and models are available at https://huggingface.co/collections/KaLM-Embedding/lychee-kalm-reranker-and-jev. The code is available at https://github.com/HITsz-TMG/Lychee-Reranker.

AI.title_translation: Lychee-Reranker：用于压缩文档重排序的快速但非晚期交互模型
AI.tldr: 提出了一种名为Lychee-Reranker的高效重排序模型，通过解耦查询与段落计算并结合Matryoshka嵌入池化和交叉注意力，在保证卓越性能的同时大幅提升了推理效率。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于编码器和解码器的重排序器通常联合处理每个查询-段落对，导致在线计算紧密耦合，限制了部署的效率与灵活性，因此需要一种既高效又保留表达性相关性建模的新型重排序方法。
AI.method: 基于编码器-解码器架构，使用Matryoshka嵌入池化预编码段落（实现离线段落编码），并在解码器中将系统和用户指令与查询意图共同建模，通过交叉注意力捕捉查询上下文与段落表示之间的细粒度相关性。
AI.result: 在BEIR、MIRACL和LMEB等数据集上的广泛实验表明，该模型在多领域和多语言重排序中取得了与Qwen3/BGE-Reranker等强力工业级重排序器相媲美的强大性能，且具备卓越的计算效率。
AI.conclusion: Lychee-Reranker通过解耦查询与段落计算、利用Matryoshka嵌入池化压缩特征，并在解码端引入交叉注意力，成功实现了高效且具有极高表现力的文档重排序，在多个基准测试中展现出与顶尖工业级重排序器相媲美的性能。
AI.translation: 随着检索系统的规模不断扩大，有效且高效的重排序变得愈发重要。然而，大多数现有的基于编码器和解码器的重排序器会联合处理每个查询-段落对，从而紧密耦合了它们的在线计算，限制了部署效率和灵活性。我们提出了Lychee-Reranker，这是一种快速但非晚期交互（FBNL）的重排序器，它在保留富有表现力的相关性建模的同时，解耦了查询和段落的计算。Lychee-Reranker基于编码器-解码器架构，使用Matryoshka嵌入池化预编码段落，其解码器则将系统和用户指令与查询意图共同建模；随后通过交叉注意力捕获生成的查询上下文与段落表示之间的细粒度相关性。这些设计共同带来了四个关键优势：(i) 离线段落编码带来的高效性，(ii) 交叉注意力带来的表达性，(iii) Matryoshka嵌入池化带来的紧凑性，以及 (iv) 通过可调节计算预算实现的测试时计算。我们实例化了Nano、Small和Large三种尺寸的Lychee-Reranker，激活参数量分别为0.27B、1B和4B。在BEIR、MIRACL和LMEB上的广泛实验表明，该模型具有强大的重排序性能和卓越的效率。在BEIR和MIRACL上，我们的模型在多领域和多语言重排序中取得了极具竞争力的表现，可与Qwen3/BGE-Reranker系列等强劲的工业级重排序器相媲美。在LMEB-Dialogue上，仅配有0.27B激活参数的Nano重排序器的紧凑型嵌入模型，依然能够与7-12B的嵌入模型保持竞争力。Lychee-Reranker此前被称为KaLM-Reranker-V1。数据和模型可在https://huggingface.co/collections/KaLM-Embedding/lychee-kalm-reranker-and-jev获取，代码可在https://github.com/HITsz-TMG/Lychee-Reranker获取。
AI.summary: Lychee-Reranker是一种新型的高效重排序模型，通过解耦查询和段落计算（FBNL架构）、采用Matryoshka嵌入池化和交叉注意力机制，实现了高效的离线段落编码、紧凑的存储以及灵活的测试时计算预算，在多个基准测试中展现出卓越的性能与效率。
AI.keywords: 重排序器, 编码器-解码器架构, 矩阵娃嵌入池化, 交叉注意力, 检索系统
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种名为Lychee-Reranker的新型重排序模型，创新性地采用“非晚期交互”（Fast but Not Late Interaction, FBNL）架构，结合了离线段落编码、Matryoshka嵌入池化以及交叉注意力机制，在保证高精度的同时大幅提升了检索部署效率与灵活性。

title: Group-Graph Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Group-based Reinforcement Learning (RL) has significantly enhanced Large Language Models (LLMs) in agentic scenarios. To achieve finer-grained policy updates, recent agentic RL frameworks have shifted from trajectory-level to step-level training. However, long-horizon agentic RL suffers from severe reward sparsity and delay, as feedback is often deferred for dozens of interaction steps. While existing step-level frameworks refine training granularity, their credit assignment remains coarse-grained and still treats agent exploration as isolated, linear trajectories. This oversimplified perspective ignores the inherent graph structure of state transitions, leading to high-variance state-value estimation and myopic, localized credit assignment. To overcome these critical bottlenecks, we propose Group-Graph Policy Optimization (G2PO), a novel group-based RL algorithm tailored for multi-turn agentic tasks. G2PO explicitly transforms linear interaction trajectories into a global state-transition graph. By aggregating identical observations across different trajectories, we introduce group-aggregation state-value estimation that reduces sampling variance and trajectory-dependent bias. Furthermore, we redefine agent actions as transitions between state nodes and propose an edge-centric advantage estimation strategy. By globally standardizing Temporal Difference (TD) errors across the entire graph, G2PO explicitly identifies and prioritizes critical transitions that drive absolute task progress. Extensive experiments on representative long-horizon benchmarks-WebShop, ALFWorld, and AppWorld-demonstrate that G2PO substantially outperforms state-of-the-art prompt-based and RL baselines, achieving remarkable success rate improvements of up to 22.2% over GRPO.

AI.title_translation: 面向长视野智能体强化学习的群图策略优化
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为G2PO的新型群组图强化学习算法，通过将交互轨迹转化为全局状态转移图来解决长视野任务中的奖励稀疏和信用分配难题，在多个基准测试中大幅超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于步骤的智能体强化学习框架仍然将智能体探索视为孤立的线性轨迹，导致状态价值估计方差大以及信用分配过于局限短视，难以解决长视野智能体强化学习中严重的奖励稀疏和延迟问题。
AI.method: 提出Group-Graph Policy Optimization (G2PO)算法，将线性交互轨迹转化为全局状态转移图，通过聚合不同轨迹的相同观测来进行状态价值估计，并提出基于边的优势估计策略及全局标准化时间差分（TD）误差来优先处理关键转移。
AI.result: 在WebShop、ALFWorld和AppWorld等长视野基准测试上的广泛实验表明，G2PO显著优于当前最先进的基于提示词和强化学习的基线方法，成功率较GRPO提升高达22.2%。
AI.conclusion: 提出的Group-Graph Policy Optimization (G2PO)算法能够有效应对长视野智能体强化学习中的奖励稀疏和信用分配难题，在多个代表性基准测试中展现出显著的性能优势。
AI.translation: 基于群组的强化学习（RL）显著增强了大语言模型（LLM）在智能体场景中的能力。为了实现更细粒度的策略更新，近期的智能体RL框架已从轨迹级别转向步骤级别训练。然而，长视野智能体RL遭遇了严重的奖励稀疏与延迟问题，因为反馈通常被推迟数十个交互步骤。现有的步骤级框架虽然细化了训练粒度，但其信用分配仍然较为粗糙，且将智能体探索视为孤立的线性轨迹。这种过分简化的视角忽视了状态转移固有的图结构，导致高方差的状态价值估计以及短视、局限的信用分配。为了克服这些关键瓶颈，我们提出了群图策略优化（G2PO），这是一种专为多轮智能体任务量身定制的新型群组RL算法。G2PO显式地将线性交互轨迹转换为全局状态转移图。通过聚合不同轨迹中的相同观测，我们引入了群组聚合状态价值估计，从而降低了采样方差和轨迹依赖偏差。此外，我们将智能体动作重新定义为状态节点之间的转移，并提出了以边为中心的优势估计策略。通过在整个图中全局标准化时序差分（TD）误差，G2PO能够显式识别并优先处理推动绝对任务进展的关键转移。在WebShop、ALFWorld和AppWorld等代表性长视野基准测试上的大量实验表明，G2PO大幅超越了当前最先进的基于提示词和RL的基线方法，成功率比GRPO显著提升了高达22.2%。
AI.summary: 本文针对长视野智能体强化学习中奖励稀疏和信用分配局限的问题，提出了Group-Graph Policy Optimization (G2PO)算法。该算法将线性交互轨迹转换为全局状态转移图，利用图结构进行群组聚合状态价值估计和基于边的优势估计，从而在多个长视野基准测试中取得了显著的性能提升。
AI.keywords: 强化学习, 大语言模型, 信用分配, 状态转移图, 智能体任务
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地将传统基于轨迹的智能体强化学习建模为全局状态转移图，有效解决了长视野任务中的奖励稀疏和信用分配不准的问题，具有极高的理论和应用价值。

title: AgentOdyssey: Open-Ended Long-Horizon Text Game Generation for Test-Time Continual Learning Agents
comments: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 | Project page: https://agentodyssey.github.io/
summary: For agents to learn continuously from interaction with the world at test time, they must be able to explore effectively, acquire new world knowledge and skills, retain relevant episodic experiences, and plan over long horizons. To evaluate these key abilities of test-time continual learning agents, we introduce AgentOdyssey, a novel evaluation framework that procedurally generates open-ended text games with rich entities, world dynamics, and long-horizon tasks. Critically, AgentOdyssey goes beyond the conventional machine learning assumption that learning does not occur at test time by placing agents in a continuous, long-horizon setting that interleaves learning and inference throughout deployment. We further propose a multifaceted evaluation methodology that measures not only game progress but also offers diagnostic tests on world knowledge acquisition, episodic memory, object and action exploration, action diversity, and model cost. We evaluate diverse agent paradigms across six generated games. Our experimental results reveal critical limits in agents' key abilities, as well as factors that influence their meaningful horizon. Although performance scales with stronger base models, even the top agent remains far below human performance on a demanding long-horizon game, leaving substantial headroom for improvement. Additionally, a focused study of agent test-time training finds that, although short-term memory is beneficial, agents trained with supervised fine-tuning still suffer from catastrophic forgetting, suggesting that effective parametric continual learning remains an open challenge for test-time agents.
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 | Project page: https://agentodyssey.github.io/

AI.title_translation: AgentOdyssey：面向测试时持续学习智能体的开放式长视野文本游戏生成
AI.tldr: 本文推出了AgentOdyssey框架，用于生成长视野文本游戏并评估测试时持续学习Agent，揭示了当前Agent在持续学习、长视野规划和抗遗忘方面的重大局限。
AI.motivation: 为了评估测试时持续学习Agent在与世界交互时的核心能力（如有效探索、获取新知识、保留情景经验以及长视野规划），并突破传统机器学习假设测试时不进行学习的局限。
AI.method: 引入AgentOdyssey框架，程序化生成包含丰富实体、世界动态和长视野任务的开放式文本游戏；提出多维度评估方法，从游戏进展、世界知识获取、情景记忆、探索、动作多样性及模型成本等方面进行诊断。
AI.result: 实验表明现有Agent在关键能力上存在严重不足，尽管更强的基座模型能提高性能，但顶级Agent在严苛的长视野游戏中仍远逊于人类；使用监督微调进行测试时训练的Agent虽然短期记忆有用，但仍遭遇灾难性遗忘。
AI.conclusion: 现有Agent在测试时持续学习和长视野规划能力上存在显著局限（如灾难性遗忘），尽管更强的基座模型能提升性能，但离人类水平仍有巨大差距，参数化持续学习仍是未来亟待攻克的开放性挑战。
AI.translation: 为了让智能体在测试时通过与世界的交互实现持续学习，它们必须具备有效探索、获取新的世界知识和技能、保留相关情景经验以及进行长视野规划的能力。为了评估测试时持续学习智能体的这些核心能力，我们推出了AgentOdyssey，这是一个新颖的评估框架，可通过程序化生成具有丰富实体、世界动态和长视野任务的开放式文本游戏。至关重要的是，AgentOdyssey超越了传统机器学习中“测试时不进行学习”的假设，将智能体置于交织着学习和推理的连续、长视野部署环境中。我们进一步提出了一个多面评估方法，不仅衡量游戏进展，还对世界知识获取、情景记忆、物体与动作探索、动作多样性以及模型成本进行诊断测试。我们在六个生成的游戏中评估了多种智能体范式。实验结果揭示了智能体关键能力的严重局限性，以及影响其有效视野的因素。尽管性能随着更强基座模型的应用而提升，但在要求苛刻的长视野游戏中，即使是顶尖的智能体也远低于人类表现，留下了巨大的改进空间。此外，对智能体测试时训练的专项研究发现，尽管短期记忆是有益的，但通过监督微调训练的智能体仍然遭受灾难性遗忘，这表明有效的参数化持续学习对测试时智能体而言仍然是一个开放的挑战。
AI.summary: 本文提出了AgentOdyssey框架，用于程序化生成开放式长视野文本游戏，以评估测试时持续学习Agent的探索、知识获取、记忆和规划能力。多维度评估与实验揭示了当前Agent在长视野任务和参数化持续学习（如灾难性遗忘）方面的重大局限与提升空间。
AI.keywords: AgentOdyssey, 测试时持续学习, 长视野文本游戏, 灾难性遗忘, 智能体评估
AI.comments: AgentOdyssey是一个极具创新性的长视野文本游戏生成与评测框架，直接切中当前大模型在测试时持续学习、长视野规划及灾难性遗忘方面的痛点。该研究通过程序化生成丰富多变的动态世界，提供了一个多维度的诊断测试体系，为未来具身智能和自主Agent的持续进化研究奠定了重要基础。

title: Learning Asynchronous Upper-body Task-space Trajectory Tracking Policy for Humanoid Robots
summary: High-level humanoid planners often output sparse task-space, low-rate trajectories, whereas whole-body controllers run at high frequency. This creates temporal asynchrony between the planning and execution, and structural incompleteness for full-body control. We propose an asynchronous upper body task-space tracking framework for humanoids. A student policy is initialized by teacher-student distillation, conditioned on the full cached future trajectory and an execution-time index, and trained with a sliding-window global reward to reduce frame drift without explicit frame estimation. For task-specific post-training, an MPC module completes sparse references into floating-base and upper-body guidance, while action- and FK level self-guidance constrain policy drift. Simulation and Unitree G1 hardware experiments show improved tracking under low update rates, stronger performance than synchronous and decoupled baselines, and safer adaptation to out-of-distribution motions.

AI.title_translation: 学习用于人形机器人的异步上半身任务空间轨迹跟踪策略
AI.tldr: 提出了一种针对人形机器人的异步上半身任务空间轨迹跟踪框架，解决了高层低频规划与底层高频控制之间的时序异步与结构不完整问题。
AI.motivation: 高层人形机器人规划器通常输出稀疏且低频的任务空间轨迹，而全身控制器则以高频运行，这导致了规划与执行之间的时序异步以及全身体制控制的结构不完整性。
AI.method: 提出一个异步上半身任务空间跟踪框架，利用教师-学生蒸馏初始化学生策略（基于完整缓存的未来轨迹和执行时间索引），采用滑动窗口全局奖励训练以减少帧漂移，并引入MPC模块进行任务后训练，同时结合动作与FK级自引导来约束策略漂移。
AI.result: 仿真和Unitree G1硬件实验表明，该方法在低更新率下改善了轨迹跟踪效果，性能优于同步和解耦基线，并能更安全地适应分布外运动。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效解决了人形机器人高低层控制间的异步与不完整问题，在仿真和Unitree G1硬件实验中均展现出优异的跟踪性能与安全性。
AI.translation: 高级人形机器人规划器通常输出稀疏的任务空间低速率轨迹，而全身控制器则以高频率运行。这导致了规划与执行之间的时间异步性，以及全身体制控制的结构不完整性。我们提出了一种针对人形机器人的异步上半身任务空间跟踪框架。学生策略通过教师-学生蒸馏进行初始化，以完整的缓存未来轨迹和执行时间索引为条件，并使用滑动窗口全局奖励进行训练，以减少帧漂移而无需显式帧估计。为了进行特定任务的后训练，MPC模块将稀疏参考补全为浮动基座和上半身引导，同时动作级和FK级的自引导约束了策略漂移。仿真和Unitree G1硬件实验表明，该方法在低更新率下改善了跟踪效果，性能优于同步和解耦基线，并能更安全地适应分布外运动。
AI.summary: 本文针对人形机器人规划与执行之间的时序异步与结构不完整问题，提出了一种异步上半身任务空间轨迹跟踪框架。通过教师-学生蒸馏、滑动窗口全局奖励以及MPC后训练等技术，实现了低频规划到高频控制的高效稳定映射，并在Unitree G1硬件上验证了其优越性。
AI.keywords: 人形机器人, 异步轨迹跟踪, 教师-学生蒸馏, 模型预测控制, 任务空间控制
AI.comments: 该论文针对人形机器人高层规划与底层控制之间的频率不匹配与结构不完整问题，提出了一种创新的异步上半身任务空间轨迹跟踪框架，兼具理论深度与出色的硬件泛化能力。

title: Paved with True Intents: Intent-Aware Training Improves LLM Safety Classification Across Training Regimes
summary: We argue that safety classifiers should model user intent as an explicit signal between the prompt and the final label. To study this, we introduce AIMS, a human-annotated dataset of 1,724 difficult safety prompts, each paired with an intent description and harm label. We use AIMS to evaluate intent-aware training across supervised fine-tuning, preference learning, reasoning distillation, and reinforcement learning. Despite its size, AIMS enables competitive safety classifiers across training regimes: DPO from model-generated intent errors improves over SFT, and intent-conditioned distillation outperforms reasoning-only distillation in most teacher-student pairs. Most notably, directly rewarding intent faithfulness with GRPO yields the strongest average performance across five external safety benchmarks, while our intent-aware models form the inference latency-F1 Pareto frontier. These results show that faithful intent modeling is a compact, high-quality supervision signal for more robust safety classifiers.

AI.title_translation: 铺就真实意图：意图感知训练跨训练机制提升大语言模型安全分类能力
AI.tldr: 通过在安全分类训练中显式引入用户意图建模（AIMS数据集），论文证明了意图感知训练能显著提升大语言模型安全分类器的鲁棒性、准确率和推理效率。
AI.motivation: 作者认为安全分类器应当将用户意图显式建模为提示词与最终标签之间的信号，以解决传统安全分类在复杂提示下的不足，提升分类器的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 引入了一个包含1,724个困难安全提示的人工标注数据集AIMS，并在监督微调、偏好学习、推理蒸馏和强化学习（如GRPO）等多种训练机制下评估了意图感知训练的效果。
AI.result: 使用AIMS可以在多种训练范式下训练出具有竞争力的安全分类器；直接通过GRPO奖励意图忠实度取得了五个外部安全基准测试中的最佳平均性能，且意图感知模型构成了推理延迟与F1值的帕累托前沿。
AI.conclusion: 忠实的意图建模是构建更强健、高效的安全分类器的一种紧凑且高质量的监督信号，适用于多种训练机制。
AI.translation: 我们认为安全分类器应该将用户意图建模为提示词和最终标签之间的显式信号。为了研究这一点，我们推出了AIMS，这是一个包含1,724个困难安全提示的人工标注数据集，每个提示都配有意图描述和危害标签。我们使用AIMS在监督微调、偏好学习、推理蒸馏和强化学习中评估了意图感知训练。尽管规模不大，但AIMS在各种训练机制下都能实现有竞争力的安全分类器：通过模型生成的意图误差进行DPO优于SFT，并且意图条件蒸馏在大多数师生对中优于纯推理蒸馏。最值得注意的是，直接用GRPO奖励意图忠实度在五个外部安全基准测试中产生了最强的平均性能，而我们的意图感知模型形成了推理延迟-F1的帕累托前沿。这些结果表明，忠实的意图建模是用于更强大安全分类器的紧凑、高质量的监督信号。
AI.summary: 该论文提出安全分类器应当显式建模用户意图，并为此引入了AIMS数据集。研究表明，跨不同训练机制采用意图感知训练能够显著提升大语言模型安全分类器的鲁棒性、准确性及推理效率。
AI.keywords: 大语言模型安全, 安全分类器, 用户意图建模, 监督微调, 强化学习
AI.comments: 该论文提出了一种新颖的意图感知训练方法（AIMS），将用户意图作为显式信号引入大语言模型（LLM）的安全分类中。创新之处在于证明了显式建模意图可以作为一种紧凑且高质量的监督信号，在多种训练范式下显著提升安全分类器的鲁棒性和泛化能力。其局限性可能在于人工标注数据集规模相对较小，且依赖于意图描述的准确性。

title: PinNet: Keypoint-Aware Learned Local Descriptors with Geometric Embedding for Loop Closure in LiDAR SLAM
summary: Loop closure is essential to reduce drift and build globally consistent maps in large-scale environments. However, reliable loop closure with only geometric information from, e.g., a LiDAR sensor, remains challenging due to the difficulty of constructing discriminative geometric features. We present PinNet, a neural network that produces local geometric descriptors from point clouds for place recognition and scanto-scan registration. PinNet incorporates a neural network that generates keypoints and their corresponding descriptors, together with a plane-based geometric self-attention module that models inter-keypoint spatial relationships to enhance descriptor discriminability for loop-closure detection and point-cloud registration. The approach is comprehensively evaluated on multiple datasets collected with different LiDAR sensors. Experimental results demonstrate strong place-recognition performance, precise relative pose estimation, and successful single-shot localization in different environments.

AI.title_translation: PinNet：用于LiDAR SLAM中回环检测的具有几何嵌入的感知关键点学习局部描述子
AI.tldr: PinNet是一个通过几何自注意力机制增强局部描述子判别力的新型神经网络，可显著提升LiDAR SLAM的回环检测与配准性能。
AI.motivation: 由于仅使用激光雷达等几何信息构建具有区分度的几何特征十分困难，导致基于几何信息的回环检测在大规模环境中仍然具有挑战性，因此需要开发更具判别力的局部几何描述子来减少漂移并构建全局一致的地图。
AI.method: 提出PinNet神经网络，包含生成关键点与对应描述子的网络模块，以及一个利用平面进行几何自注意力的模块，用于建模关键点间的空间关系，从而增强描述子的判别力。
AI.result: 在多个不同激光雷达传感器收集的数据集上的实验表明，PinNet具有强大的地点识别性能、精确的相对位姿估计能力以及在不同环境中的成功单次定位能力。
AI.conclusion: PinNet是一个高效且鲁棒的基于LiDAR的局部描述子生成网络，能够显著提升大规模SLAM系统中的回环检测和位姿估计精度。
AI.translation: 回环检测对于减少大规模环境中的漂移和构建全局一致的地图至关重要。然而，由于难以构建具有判别力的几何特征，仅使用来自激光雷达传感器等几何信息进行可靠的回环检测仍然具有挑战性。我们提出了PinNet，这是一个神经网络，它从点云生成局部几何描述子，用于地点识别和扫描到扫描的配准。PinNet集成了一个生成关键点及其对应描述子的神经网络，以及一个基于平面的几何自注意力模块，该模块对关键点间的空间关系进行建模，以增强用于回环检测和点云配准的描述子判别力。该方法在使用不同激光雷达传感器收集的多个数据集上进行了全面评估。实验结果证明了其强大的人群（地点）识别性能、精确的相对位姿估计以及在不同环境中成功的单次定位。
AI.summary: PinNet是一种用于激光雷达SLAM中回环检测和点云配准的神经网络，它通过结合关键点生成和平面几何自注意力模块来增强局部几何描述子的空间判别力，并在多个数据集上验证了其卓越的性能。
AI.keywords: LiDAR SLAM, 局部描述子, 回环检测, 点云配准, 几何嵌入
AI.comments: PinNet通过结合关键点生成与基于平面的几何自注意力模块，有效提升了LiDAR点云局部描述子的判别力，在回环检测和点云配准任务中表现优异。其创新点在于显式建模了关键点之间的空间几何关系。

title: SPACE: Swarm Pheromone Fields for Adaptive Collision-Aware Exploration
comments: Accepted to IEEE ROBIO 2026. 7 pages, 4 figures
summary: Massive robot swarms can explore unknown environments quickly, but adding robots eventually stops helping. Doorways and dense traffic create congestion, increasing inter-robot contacts and reducing the value of each additional robot. We study this safety-efficiency tradeoff for ground swarms of tens to hundreds of robots. We present SPACE, Swarm Pheromone Fields for Adaptive Collision-Aware Exploration. Inspired by ant foraging, SPACE maintains a shared environmental field with an attractive frontier pheromone, a repellent explore pheromone, and a fast robot-density field. Robots use local field guidance on a synchronized shared map. We evaluate SPACE on real building floorplans, namely sixteen home layouts from the HouseExpo dataset and eight campus floors from the KTH dataset, with swarms of up to two hundred and fifty-six robots. At congested swarm sizes, SPACE attains the lowest inter-robot contact rate on HouseExpo and lies on the empirical Pareto frontier on KTH, together with handed lane formation at sizes where Lane has fewer contacts. Relative to a greedy nearest-frontier planner, SPACE reduces the contact rate by four to seventeen times while keeping coverage time within about two percent. The results indicate that, at this scale, coordination mainly improves safety rather than coverage time.

AI.title_translation: SPACE：用于自适应防撞探索的集群信息素场
AI.tldr: 提出了一种受蚂蚁启发的信息素场方法（SPACE），在保持高效环境覆盖率的同时，将大规模机器人集群的碰撞率降低了4到17倍。
AI.motivation: 大规模机器人集群在探索未知环境时，狭窄过道和密集交通会导致交通拥堵、机器人间接触增加，从而削弱增加机器人的边际效益，因此需要研究安全与效率的权衡问题。
AI.method: 提出SPACE（群信息素场自适应防撞探索）方法，受蚂蚁觅食启发，维护一个包含吸引性前沿信息素、排斥性探索信息素和快速机器人密度场的共享环境场，机器人在同步共享地图上利用局部场引导进行导航。
AI.result: 在HouseExpo和KTH数据集的大量实验表明，相比贪婪最近前沿规划器，SPACE将碰撞率降低了4到17倍，同时将覆盖时间保持在约2%的范围内。
AI.conclusion: SPACE算法通过结合信息素场与密度场，在保证高效探索的同时显著降低了大规模机器人集群的碰撞率，证明了在集群规模较大时，协调机制的核心价值在于提升安全性而非缩短覆盖时间。
AI.translation: 大规模机器人集群可以快速探索未知环境，但增加机器人最终会停止带来帮助。门口和密集的交通会造成拥堵，增加机器人之间的接触，并降低每个额外机器人的价值。我们研究了数十到数百个机器人的地面集群的安全-效率权衡。我们提出了SPACE（Swarm Pheromone Fields for Adaptive Collision-Aware Exploration）。受到蚂蚁觅食的启发，SPACE维护了一个共享的环境场，其中包含具有吸引力的前沿信息素、排斥性的探索信息素和一个快速的机器人密度场。机器人在同步共享地图上使用局部场引导。我们在真实的建筑平面图上评估了SPACE，即来自HouseExpo数据集的十六个家庭布局和来自KTH数据集的八个校园楼层，集群规模高达二百五十六个机器人。在拥堵的集群规模下，SPACE在HouseExpo上获得了最低的机器人间接触率，并位于KTH的经验帕累托前沿上。相对于贪婪的最近前沿规划器，SPACE将接触率降低了四到十七倍，同时将覆盖时间保持在大约百分之二以内。结果表明，在此规模下，协调主要提高安全性而不是覆盖时间。
AI.summary: 本文提出了SPACE算法（Swarm Pheromone Fields for Adaptive Collision-Aware Exploration），受蚁群觅食启发，通过共享的前沿信息素、探索信息素和密度场来协调大规模地面机器人的探索。实验证明，该方法在保持高效环境覆盖的同时，显著降低了机器人间的碰撞率。
AI.keywords: 机器人集群, 探索, 信息素场, 避碰, 蚁群启发
AI.comments: 本文受蚂蚁觅食行为启发，创新性地结合了引力前沿信息素、斥力探索信息素和快速机器人密度场，有效地解决了大规模地面机器人集群在狭窄区域探索时的拥堵与碰撞问题，兼顾了安全与效率的权衡。

title: Beyond Compilation: Evaluating Faithful Natural-Language-to-Lean Statement Formalization
comments: v4: adds a decomposition of each measured gap into translation errors and other rejections, using a two-stage LLM review validated on human labels, and results for two models released later. 37 pages, 6 figures, 38 tables
summary: Lean verifies that a generated declaration is well typed, but cannot check whether it states what the user intended. We measure how far compilation overstates faithfulness in statement autoformalization without canonical Lean targets. Our criterion requires Lean compilation and agreement of two LLM judges from different model families. On an independent random audit, it agrees with the human majority on 91.5% of cases; it rarely accepts an unfaithful output but rejects some faithful ones. Across eight systems on 227 university-level statements, the gap between compiling and accepted outputs ranges from 1.3 to 29.5 percentage points: our tool-augmented agent compiles 87.2% of the statements, but only 57.7% are accepted. Human review of all the agent's rejections confirms that 23.8 of its 29.5 points are real translation errors. For the gaps of the seven one-shot systems, a two-stage review by Claude Opus 5.5 with Lean and GPT-6.1 Sol, validated on these human labels, finds that 78-100% are real translation errors for six of them. When GPT-5.2, one of the two judges, grades the translations of two models released after it, GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5, it accepts 83% of the statements for each, against 21% for one-shot GPT-5.2. For these two models, the same review classifies only 4 of their 54 rejections (7%) as translation errors, so most of their measured gap is judge errors rather than translation errors. This is consistent with these systems erring less while the judge does not: the fewer errors a system makes, the smaller the share of its rejections that are translation errors. Finally, a 2^3 tool ablation of the agent shows that Lean feedback drives most of its compilation gain, and that nearly half of this gain fails the semantic criterion. Code and data are available at https://github.com/grenadeComing/beyond-compilation.
comment: v4: adds a decomposition of each measured gap into translation errors and other rejections, using a two-stage LLM review validated on human labels, and results for two models released later. 37 pages, 6 figures, 38 tables

AI.title_translation: 超越编译：评估忠实的自然语言到Lean语句形式化
AI.tldr: 本研究表明，将自然语言自动形式化为Lean语句时，单纯依赖编译成功会严重高估其语义忠实度，并提出了一种基于多LLM裁判共识的新评估方法来缩小这一差距。
AI.motivation: Lean虽然能够验证生成的声明类型是否正确，但无法检查其是否符合用户的真实意图，因此单纯依赖编译成功会高估语句形式化的忠实度，需要更可靠的语义评估方法。
AI.method: 提出了一种要求Lean编译且获得两个不同系列LLM裁判一致同意的评估标准；结合人工审计、多阶段LLM裁判审查以及工具消融实验对八个系统在227个大学级陈述上的表现进行评估。
AI.result: 在227个大学级陈述中，编译成功率与通过语义标准接受率之间的差距在1.3到29.5个百分点之间；工具增强型Agent编译了87.2%的陈述，但仅有57.7%被接受，且经人工确认大部分拒绝属于真实的翻译错误。
AI.conclusion: 单纯依靠Lean编译成功会高估形式化语句的忠实度；引入多LLM裁判的语义标准能够有效识别翻译错误，并揭示了不同系统在自动形式化上的真实差距。
AI.translation: Lean可以验证生成的声明类型是否正确，但无法检查它是否表达了用户的意图。我们衡量了在没有规范Lean目标的情况下，编译在多大程度上夸大了语句自动形式化中的忠实度。我们的标准要求Lean编译以及来自不同模型系列的两个LLM裁判达成一致。在独立随机审计中，它在91.5%的案例中与人类多数意见一致；它很少接受不忠实的输出，但会拒绝一些忠实的输出。在227个大学级语句的八个系统中，编译输出与接受输出之间的差距从1.3到29.5个百分点不等：我们的工具增强型智能体编译了87.2%的语句，但只有57.7%被接受。对该智能体所有拒绝的人工审查证实，其29.5个点中有23.8个是真正的翻译错误。对于七个单次（one-shot）系统的差距，通过使用Lean和GPT-6.1 Sol进行克劳德（Claude）Opus 5.5的两阶段审查（经人类标签验证），发现其中六个系统有78-100%是真正的翻译错误。当作为两个裁判之一的GPT-5.2对发布于其后的两个模型（GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5.5）的翻译进行打分时，它对每个模型接受了83%的语句，而单次GPT-5.2为21%。对于这两个模型，同样的审查将它们的54次拒绝中只有4次（7%）归类为翻译错误，因此它们测得的大部分差距是裁判错误而不是翻译错误。这与这些系统犯错更少而裁判没有保持一致：系统犯的错误越少，其拒绝中属于翻译错误的比例就越小。最后，对智能体的2^3工具消融实验表明，Lean反馈推动了其大部分编译增益，并且近一半的增益未通过语义标准。代码和数据可在 https://github.com/grenadeComing/beyond-compilation 获取。
AI.summary: 该论文评估了自然语言到Lean定理证明器中语句形式化的忠实度，发现仅靠编译通过会高估真实翻译质量。研究提出了一种结合Lean编译与多LLM裁判共识的评估准则，发现在多个系统中存在显著的“编译成功”与“语义忠实”差距，并通过消融实验证明了Lean反馈的作用。
AI.keywords: 自然语言到Lean, 形式化验证, 大语言模型, 语义忠实度, 自动形式化评估
AI.comments: 该论文超越了单纯的编译检查，引入了一种基于多LLM裁判共识的语义忠实度评估方法，揭示了自然语言到Lean形式化中“编译成功”与“语义正确”之间的显著差距，对未来形式化验证评估具有重要指导意义。

title: Teaching LLMs to Recommend and Defer in Underrepresented Epilepsy Care
summary: Specialist epilepsy expertise is scarce in resource-constrained settings. Clinical decision-support systems must adapt to local prescribing practices and recognize when specialist review is needed. We study pediatric epilepsy care in Uganda, predicting anti-seizure medication regimens from longitudinal clinic notes. General-purpose language models achieve non-trivial agreement with physician prescriptions, but neurologists' review reveals Western prescribing defaults that do not account for local practices. We introduce MANANA, a non-parametric prompt-learning framework that learns local prescribing guidance from a small patient-level training set. MANANA turns prescription errors into auditable prompt memory, with single-agent and multi-agent variants, and improves over classical ML models, direct LLM prompting, and prompt-optimization baselines across two independently collected Ugandan cohorts. The learned prompt trajectory also provides a basis for estimating uncertainty. Bayesian prompt averaging (BPA) combines predictions across this trajectory to produce prescription likelihoods and a deferral signal. Using the same MANANA-Multi trajectory, BPA improves top-1 physician-regimen agreement from 66% to 70% on Cohort A and from 73% to 75% on Cohort B while preserving top-3 coverage. On Cohort B, its most confident half of cases achieves 95% precision, and its most confident quarter achieves 99% precision, supporting deferral of lower-confidence cases for specialist review. These results suggest a path toward locally adapted clinical LLM systems that learn from limited site-specific data and focus scarce specialist attention on uncertain cases.

AI.title_translation: 教导大语言模型在代表性不足的癫痫护理中进行推荐与推迟
AI.tldr: 本文开发了MANANA框架和BPA方法，使大语言模型能够适应乌干达等资源受限地区的本地癫痫处方习惯，并在不确定时将病例推迟给专科医生审核。
AI.motivation: 资源匮乏地区缺乏专科癫痫专业知识，通用大语言模型虽然能与医师处方达成一定共识，但存在未能考虑当地实际情况的“西方处方默认偏差”，因此需要开发能适应地方处方实践并在必要时识别专科审核需求的临床决策支持系统。
AI.method: 提出MANANA（一个非参数提示学习框架，包含单智能体和多智能体变体），将处方错误转化为可审计的提示内存；并引入贝叶斯提示平均（BPA）来组合预测、生成处方可能性和推迟信号。
AI.result: MANANA在两个独立收集的乌干达队列中优于经典机器学习模型、直接提示及提示优化基线；结合BPA后，队列A的Top-1医师处方契合度从66%提升至70%，队列B从73%提升至75%，且队列B中最自信的一半和四分之一案例分别达到了95%和99%的准确率。
AI.conclusion: MANANA框架成功实现了让大语言模型适应资源匮乏地区的本土癫痫护理，通过学习局部处方习惯并提供可靠的专家转诊推迟信号，为本地化临床LLM系统开发开辟了新途径。
AI.translation: 在资源受限的环境中，专科癫痫专业知识十分稀缺。临床决策支持系统必须适应当地的处方习惯，并识别何时需要专科医生审核。我们研究了乌干达的儿童癫痫护理，根据纵向诊所病历预测抗癫痫药物方案。通用语言模型与医师处方达到了非同小可的一致性，但神经科医生的审查揭示了未考虑当地做法的西方处方默认倾向。我们介绍了 MANANA，这是一个非参数提示学习框架，它从小规模患者级训练集中学习本地处方指导。MANANA 将处方错误转化为可审计的提示内存（包含单智能体和多智能体变体），在两个独立收集的乌干达队列中，其性能优于经典机器学习模型、直接大语言模型提示和提示优化基线。学习到的提示轨迹也为估计不确定性提供了基础。贝叶斯提示平均（BPA）结合了该轨迹中的预测，以产生处方可能性和推迟信号。使用相同的 MANANA-Multi 轨迹，BPA 在队列 A 上的 Top-1 医师方案一致性从 66% 提高到 70%，在队列 B 上从 73% 提高到 75%，同时保持了 Top-3 覆盖率。在队列 B 中，置信度最高的一半病例达到了 95% 的准确率，置信度最高的三分之一（应为四分之一）达到了 99% 的准确率，这支持将较低置信度的病例推迟给专科医生审核。这些结果表明了一条通往本地适应的临床大语言模型系统的道路，该系统可以从有限的特定站点数据中学习，并将稀缺的专科医生注意力集中在不确定的病例上。
AI.summary: 本文研究了乌干达儿童癫痫护理中的大语言模型应用，针对通用LLM存在的地区适应性问题，提出了MANANA提示学习框架和贝叶斯提示平均（BPA）方法。该方法能够从有限的本地数据中学习处方指南，提高处方准确性，并准确识别低置信度病例以推迟给专科医生审核。
AI.keywords: 癫痫护理, 大语言模型, 提示学习, 临床决策支持, 资源受限环境
AI.comments: 该论文创新性地提出了一种名为MANANA的非参数提示学习框架，不仅能够适应特定地区的临床处方习惯，还能通过贝叶斯提示平均（BPA）提供不确定性估计，从而实现“推荐与推迟（recommend and defer）”机制，将宝贵的专科医生资源留给高不确定性病例，对资源匮乏地区的医疗AI应用具有重要价值。

title: PruneGround: Plug-and-play Spatial Pruning for 3D Visual Grounding
summary: 3D Visual Grounding (3DVG) aims to localize target objects in 3D scenes given natural language descriptions. Existing approaches typically perform reasoning over the entire scene, leading to ambiguous predictions and high computational cost, especially in cluttered environments. We observe that many referential expressions rely on local spatial context and often correspond to restricted spatial regions rather than the full scene. Motivated by this insight, we propose PruneGround, an effective plug-and-play framework for 3DVG built upon three key components. First, we introduce Language-Guided Spatial Pruning (LGSP), which leverages a frozen Vision Language Model (VLM) to identify language-relevant regions, thereby reducing spatial computation and grounding candidates in the narrower search space. Second, we propose MultiView-Conditioned Description Reformulation (MCDR), which decomposes complex expressions into simplified target--anchor relations and augments missing spatial cues through multi-view reasoning. Finally, we propose LLM-Grounder, which repurposes a detection-pretrained spatial LLM into a language-conditioned grounding model by aligning point cloud and linguistic representations within the pruned region. Extensive experiments on the three most popular point cloud benchmarks demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art results on all three ScanRefer settings and on 9 out of 10 Nr3D/Sr3D settings. Code and models are publicly available: https://github.com/leduckhai/PruneGround

AI.title_translation: 即插即用三维空间剪枝用于三维视觉定位
AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种名为PruneGround的新型三维视觉定位（3DVG）框架，通过语言引导的空间剪枝来减少计算量并提高精度，特别是在杂乱环境中。它利用冻结的视觉语言模型识别相关区域，分解复杂表达，并通过空间语言模型进行精确定位。实验结果表明，该方法在多个基准测试中取得了最先进的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有三维视觉定位方法在处理杂乱场景时存在模糊预测和高计算成本问题。研究者观察到，许多指代表达式依赖于局部空间上下文，并且通常对应于受限的空间区域，而非整个场景。
AI.method: 提出PruneGround框架，包含三个关键组件：1. 语言引导空间剪枝（LGSP）：利用冻结的视觉语言模型识别与语言相关的区域，缩小搜索空间。2. 多视图条件描述重构（MCDR）：分解复杂表达为目标-锚点关系，并通过多视图推理补充空间线索。3. LLM-Grounder：将检测预训练的空间语言模型调整为语言条件定位模型，在剪枝区域内对点云和语言表示进行对齐。
AI.result: 在ScanRefer的三个最流行设置上均达到最先进结果，并在Nr3D/Sr3D的10个设置中的9个上取得优异成绩。
AI.conclusion: PruneGround通过语言引导的空间剪枝有效解决了三维视觉定位中的计算成本和模糊性问题，并在多个基准测试中取得了最先进的性能。
AI.translation: 三维视觉定位（3DVG）旨在根据自然语言描述在三维场景中定位目标对象。现有方法通常对整个场景进行推理，导致预测模糊且计算成本高，尤其是在杂乱的环境中。我们观察到，许多指代表达式依赖于局部空间上下文，并且通常对应于受限的空间区域，而不是整个场景。基于这一见解，我们提出了PruneGround，一个基于三个关键组件的有效的三维视觉定位即插即用框架。首先，我们引入了语言引导空间剪枝（LGSP），它利用一个冻结的视觉语言模型（VLM）来识别与语言相关的区域，从而减少空间计算量并将定位候选对象限制在更窄的搜索空间内。其次，我们提出了多视图条件描述重构（MCDR），它将复杂表达式分解为简化的目标-锚点关系，并通过多视图推理来补充缺失的空间线索。最后，我们提出了LLM-Grounder，它通过在剪枝区域内对齐点云和语言表示，将一个经过检测预训练的空间语言模型重新用作一个语言条件定位模型。在三个最流行的点云基准测试上的广泛实验表明，我们的方法在ScanRefer的所有三个设置以及Nr3D/Sr3D的9个设置上都取得了最先进的结果。代码和模型可公开获取：https://github.com/leduckhai/PruneGround
AI.summary: PruneGround是一个创新的即插即用三维视觉定位框架，通过语言引导的空间剪枝技术，有效解决了现有方法在处理复杂三维场景时的计算效率和定位精度问题。该框架利用视觉语言模型识别关键区域，重构语言描述以补充空间信息，并最终使用空间语言模型进行精确定位，在多个标准数据集上取得了领先的性能。
AI.keywords: 三维视觉定位, 空间剪枝, 视觉语言模型, 语言引导, 点云

title: APeB: Benchmarking Personalization Ability of Large Language Model Agents
comments: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. Code and data:https://voxxxx1874.github.io/APeB-Website/
summary: LLM-powered agents struggle with personalization when users issue raw, underspecified queries. In this setting, agents must infer latent intent, extract preferences from noisy interaction histories, and select among competing alternatives. Existing benchmarks rarely test this capability, as they often rely on user-refined queries or simplified histories. We introduce personalized product search (PPS), a testbed for agentic personalization under raw queries and diverse histories. We construct Agent Personalized Benchmark (APeB) from action logs, pairing underspecified intents with rich histories and user-viewed candidate items. Evaluating state-of-the-art LLMs with multi-step agent workflows, we find that models handle explicit queries well but struggle with early-stage queries requiring intent and preference discovery. Rubric analysis attributes this gap mainly to ineffective history use. A simple history-aware query-refinement pipeline, VQRA, yields consistent gains, highlighting the need for dedicated history-utilization modules in personalized agents.

title: TORINO: Token Reduction via Interpretable Concept Overlap in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities across different tasks, but their computational cost is dominated by the large number of visual tokens fed to the language model. Existing token reduction methods rely on attention-based scores or pairwise similarity, without an explicit semantic representation of each token. We introduce TORINO (TOken Reduction via Interpretable coNcept Overlap), a plug-and-play framework for adaptive visual token reduction in VLMs that requires no fine-tuning of the underlying model. TORINO leverages Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to project visual tokens into an interpretable latent space where token relationships can be analyzed through shared concept activations. Specifically, we define concept overlap as the degree of agreement between active SAE latents and use it to group tokens that share semantic content. Reduction within each group is then performed by either pruning or merging, providing a unified framework that preserves semantically important visual information while removing redundancy. Unlike fixed-budget approaches, TORINO dynamically adapts the reduction rate to input complexity, allowing different images to retain different numbers of tokens. Experiments across multiple vision-language benchmarks show that TORINO achieves favorable efficiency-accuracy trade-offs, reducing the number of visual tokens with minimal performance loss. Source code released at https://eidoslab.github.io/TORINO.

title: Is Your NPU Ready for LLMs? Dissecting the Hidden Efficiency Bottlenecks in Mobile LLM Inference
summary: Deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) on mobile devices enhances privacy and reduces latency, but is severely constrained by hardware inefficiencies. We present the first comprehensive, cross-layer measurement study of mobile LLM inference, spanning five mainstream frameworks (e.g., llama.cpp and GENIE) and three hardware backends (CPU, GPU, and NPU). To enable this analysis, we develop PowerBench, a fine-grained profiling tool that measures LLM throughput and provides the first backend-specific energy attribution for mobile LLM inference, going beyond traditional device-level measurements. We further conduct hardware microbenchmarks to characterize the memory-system performance and compute capabilities of mobile CPUs, GPUs, and NPUs. Our study yields three critical insights: (1) Framework-induced performance gaps are substantially amplified on NPUs, reaching up to $10\times$ due to differences in offloading strategies, hardware-underutilizing operators, and activation quantization strategies. (2) We identify a distinct ``phase split,'' in which NPUs excel at compute-bound prefilling, while CPUs outperform all other backends in memory-bound decoding. This split is driven by NPUs' preference for large, fixed-shape workloads, which conflicts with the small-kernel, dynamic nature of decoding. (3) Backend-specific profiling uncovers substantial scheduling headroom missed by prior work. Suboptimal thread configurations, uncoordinated NPU sleep latencies, and CPU polling intervals result in unnecessary energy consumption. For example, tuning CPU frequency alone reduces energy consumption by up to $39.7\%$. Leveraging these findings, we estimate that an energy-oriented configuration can reduce energy consumption by up to $53.2\%$ on the NPU backend across three datasets, highlighting the substantial potential for further efficiency improvements in mobile LLM deployment.

title: NativeMEM: Native Memory Compression for Long-Horizon Robotic Manipulation
comments: Accepted by CoRL 2026. Project Page: https://opendrivelab.com/NativeMEM
summary: How can pretrained Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models retain long-horizon visual histories with high-frequency updates without sacrificing efficiency? Existing approaches rely on external memory management, which restrains either the memory horizon or the reactiveness of pretrained policies. To this end, we present NativeMEM, a VLA policy that features long-term and real-time updated memory. At its core is an efficient memory encoding scheme, Native Memory Compression, which repurposes the VLA's own vision encoder to compress each historical frame from each camera view into a single token. Appended to the input sequence, these memory tokens enable the pretrained VLA to attend over long-term history with negligible latency overhead, requiring neither an external planner nor a freshly initialized memory module. To align the memory tokens with the pretrained policy, we first develop a generic memory tokenizer under the supervision of a frozen VLA on memory-demanding data, and then unfreeze the VLA for task-specific fine-tuning. NativeMEM consistently outperforms prior methods, boosting success rates from 32.4% to 84.0% in simulation and up to 98.7% on real robots, while maintaining low inference latency and GPU memory usage. Notably, NativeMEM exhibits high data efficiency by achieving competitive results with prior arts using only 20% of the training data.

title: Diagnosing and Repairing Persona Collapse in LLM Advice
summary: A good advisor comforts someone in crisis, challenges someone in denial, and gives practical guidance on a logistical question. We ask whether large language models (LLMs) vary their approach in this way. We define five advisory personas based on how comforting or challenging a reply is, and whether it supports a realistic understanding of the situation and informed decision-making. Across 1,280 Reddit situations in 14 advice contexts, human replies vary systematically, while three frontier LLMs default to a standard reassuring persona. We call this narrowing persona collapse. Training models to imitate human replies broadens persona use but often turns support into enabling, and challenge into cynicism. In a blinded study (N=178), expert raters judge these replies less favorably than the baseline model's on both immediate preference and potential longer-term help. We compare 13 training methods to investigate how models can learn different approaches without sacrificing advice quality. The best combination of persona fit and advice quality comes from learning from model-written replies guided by human examples, followed by reinforcement learning with quality feedback. In a second human study (N=159), raters place this model above the baseline for anticipated longer-term help. We find that models encode information about when to comfort, challenge, or give practical guidance, but their replies do not reliably reflect these distinctions. Our training narrows this representation-action gap, while activation steering alone does not reliably improve advice quality. Better LLM advice requires learning both which persona fits a situation and how to express it constructively.

title: DominoTree: Conditional Tree-Structured Drafting with Domino for Speculative Decoding
comments: 31 pages. Submitted to IEEE Access. v4: adds Qwen3.6-27B results, single-GPU serving re-runs, fused tree-builder kernels and tuned budgets; code and data at https://github.com/slin-zhq/Domino-Tree
summary: Speculative decoding speeds up large language model inference: a small drafter proposes several tokens, and the target model verifies them in one parallel pass. Drafting a tree lets the target verify many alternative continuations at once. DDTree builds such trees from the block-diffusion drafter DFlash, but scores each position independently of the tokens earlier in its branch; Domino conditions on those tokens but drafts only a single chain. DominoTree combines the two: a training-free best-first tree scored by Domino's path-dependent causal correction, restricted to top-M candidates. In a research harness at temperature zero, it averages 5.33x speedup over autoregressive (AR) decoding on Qwen3-4B and 6.89x on Qwen3-8B, peaking at 8.77x; across temperatures it is 20-26% faster than Domino on Qwen3-4B and 27-36% on Qwen3-8B, and 11-20% faster than the stronger of DDTree and its cost-aware variant CaDDTree. A controlled decomposition attributes +10.1% (Qwen3-4B) and +10.7% (Qwen3-8B) accepted length to the correction, and +4.7% and +4.4% to conditioning on the realized path. Served in SGLang on one RTX 5090, it reaches 4.11x and 4.83x AR at batch size 1, 1.17x and 1.09x the speed of Domino's chain, and up to 1.71x AR on 8K-token HELMET summarization, 14-21% above the chain. The lead holds at 2 concurrent requests but reverses from 8 onward, where the chain sustains more goodput despite DominoTree's 28% higher acceptance. DominoTree accepts more tokens than the chain in every serving setting. On the hybrid Gated-DeltaNet Qwen3.6-27B, correct output requires tree-aware recurrent verification; with it, DominoTree matches the chain at batch size 1 (4.58x versus 4.54x AR) and reaches up to 2.11x AR at long context, 15% above the chain.

title: Dual-BEATs: Unlocking Zero-Shot Stereo Audio Perception in Audio Large Language Models via Dithering
comments: 14 pages, 3 figures; minor revision to correct reference metadata and bibliography formatting
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (LLMs) have remarkable semantic audio understanding, yet they remain "spatially agnostic" due to their reliance on mono-channel audio representations. Currently, spatial audio perception methods mainly focus on complex room simulations and custom-trained, geometry-aware stereo encoders, which limits their accessibility and generalizability. In this paper, we introduce the Dual-BEATs architecture, in which the left and right audio channels are routed independently through two identical semantic encoders as an alternative to specialized spatial modules. To circumvent the architectural bottleneck where internal normalization otherwise erases the inter-channel variance of stereo audio, we inject a static, uncorrelated dithering noise floor prior to encoding. This dithering intervention establishes a macro-variance floor that "smuggles" spatial geometry across the normalization layers. Evaluated on a ternary directional classification task (Left, Center, Right), we demonstrate that dithered models achieve exceptional spatial resolution--reaching up to 97.2% localization accuracy even on subtle 0.5 panning amplitudes--and demonstrates robust, zero-shot generalization to entirely unseen spatial configurations. Our results suggest that with the appropriate acoustic regularization, standard multimodal models are natively capable of generalized stereo audio understanding.

title: Critsly: An Artefact-Aware AI Critique Teammate for Design Education and Project-Based Learning
comments: 4 pages, Accepted submission to the 27th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence in Education Interactive Events Track. v2 adds the AIEDx grant acknowledgement for Critsly's development
summary: Critique is central to design education and project-based learning, yet high-quality critique is often scarce, uneven, hard to document, and disconnected from evolving artefacts. We present Critsly, an artefact-aware AI critique workspace that turns AI from a detached feedback tool into a critique teammate in the learner's board context. Critsly combines a visual design canvas with structured AI-supported reflection, multi-perspective critique, action planning, optional peer/jury settings, and educator evidence traces. Unlike chatbot feedback tools that rely on isolated text prompts, Critsly grounds critique in a structured board state containing design intentions, board elements, annotations, links, and prior critique history. Reflecture, Critsly's guided reflection flow, works with Six Thinking Hats-inspired personas, board synthesis, generated action plans, exportable critique records, and educator evidence views in one workflow. The demo follows a learner from design intention to board-aware critique, persona-based evaluation, action-plan generation, and educator-facing evidence. Critsly contributes a working example of AI-supported critique that is more frequent, structured, inspectable, and actionable for learners and educators.

title: Fully Dynamic Edge Connectivity in $\tilde{O}(n^{12/13})$ Time
summary: In the (fully) dynamic edge connectivity problem, the goal is to maintain the edge connectivity $λ_G$ of an $n$-vertex graph $G$ that undergoes edge insertions and deletions. Our main result is a randomized algorithm for maintaining edge connectivity in dynamic simple graphs using worst-case update and query time $\tilde{O}(n^{12/13})$, for all values of $λ_G$. This is the first algorithm that has $o(n)$ update and query time, as all existing algorithms achieve this only when $λ_G$ is below $n^{1/11}$ or above $n^{1/2}$ (up to polylogarithmic factors). We then use the tools developed for this purpose to design two additional algorithms. The first one is a deterministic algorithm for the exact same task, that uses $n^{1+o(1)}$ worst-case update and query time or $\tilde{O}(n)$ amortized update and query time; this gives a polynomial improvement over existing deterministic algorithms. The second one is a deterministic algorithm for the same task but in dynamic unweighted multigraphs, that uses $\tilde{O}(n^{3/2})$ worst-case update and query time.

title: Do Multi-Agent LLMs Explore Each Other?
summary: Exploration is essential for reliable autonomy in multi-agent systems, yet it remains unclear whether large language model (LLM) agents can explore effectively when interacting with one another. We show that modern LLM agents often fail to do so, exhibiting myopic and polarized interaction patterns that lead to suboptimal coordination and increased regret. We formalize this challenge as the Multi-Agent Exploration problem, modeling it as a partially observable stochastic game (POSG), in which agents must probe peers to infer their capabilities and identify effective interaction strategies. To address this, we introduce Multi-Agent Contextual Exploration (MACE), a lightweight framework that explicitly promotes exploration through structured peer selection. Across both contextual and parametric diversity settings, exploration behavior and downstream task performance substantially improve when MACE is applied. We further provide theoretical insight that MACE achieves a sublinear expected-regret bound. Overall, our results highlight a fundamental limitation of current LLM agents and underscore the importance of explicitly guided exploration for reliable multi-agent autonomy.

title: EDAR: Learning Environment-Dependent Action Representations for Robotic Manipulation
summary: Learning effective action representations is critical for robotic manipulation, where raw control trajectories are often noisy, redundant, and difficult to model directly. Existing methods mainly encode the structure of the action stream itself, treating the role of actions in the environment as implicit. Yet manipulation is about changing the world: the same action segment can induce different outcomes under different scene contexts, making action semantics inherently environment-dependent. We propose EDAR, an Environment-Dependent Action Representation that grounds action tokens in both executable control structure and expected visual consequences. By coupling motor commands with their environment-conditioned effects, EDAR encourages the learned action space to capture interaction semantics rather than merely command-level patterns. Experiments on simulated and real-robot manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that EDAR improves downstream policy learning, especially in long-horizon manipulation. These results highlight the importance of grounding action representations in executable control structure and environment-conditioned visual change.

title: Mizzle: A Complete Concurrent Incorrectness Logic with Applications to Agentic Bug Certification
summary:
Large language models are increasingly used to find bugs in real-world programs, but they also produce a flood of false alarms that waste developers' time. We propose to prevent these false alarms by requiring an LLM to accompany each bug report with a machine-checked proof, in a program logic, that the reported bug is real. Unlike a test, such a proof is unaffected by how rarely a concurrency bug manifests, and can certify a bug against a library's specification rather than its implementation. We follow the approach of incorrectness logics, whose under-approximate reasoning establishes that a claimed behavior is genuinely reachable, and hence a true positive. In our case, however, the logic must model a realistic programming language, be mechanized so that proofs can be checked, and be complete, so that no real bug is ruled out for want of a derivation.
  We present Mizzle, an incorrectness separation logic for concurrent programs written in a substantial subset of OCaml, parametric in the notion of incorrectness. We mechanize Mizzle in the Rocq proof assistant on top of the Iris framework, and we prove that it is both sound, so that it never justifies a false alarm, and complete, so that every incorrect execution admits a derivation. We instantiate Mizzle with three notions of incorrectness: stuckness (triggering undefined behavior), the presence of a memory race (in a sequentially consistent setting), and the non-linearizability of a data structure. We show that an LLM agent can use Mizzle to certify seeded memory races and linearizability bugs for under a dollar per bug on average. We also report two previously unknown linearizability bugs in an OCaml library of concurrent data structures.
